description.zh: 本課程包含兩個部分。一、討論各種纖維之化學組成、合成與成形之理論，同時針對纖維之性質、纖維改質與組成、合成、成形間之關係與影響因素及檢測加以講授。 二、說明纖維之形態與微觀及巨觀結構、纖維長度分佈與斷面、密度、吸水性與膨潤性、機械性質、光學性質、熱性質，黏彈性質，及電氣性質等物理性質及其測試。
description.en: This course includes two parts. Part 1: A major object of this course is to provide a background in fiber compositions, synthesis, spinning and characterization. A second goal is to introduce factors that influence fiber compositions, formation and properties and their testing. Part 2: The course interprets the following subjects, such as: (1) Morphology of the fibers. (2) Microstructure and macrostructure of fibers. (3) Staple fiber length and cross-section. (4) Fiber density and absorption. (5) Mechanical properties. (6) Optical properties. (7) Thermal properties. (8) Fiber Viscoelasticity. (9) Electrical properties etc and their testing.

description.zh:
本課程探討現代通訊的基本原理，內容重點放在類比通訊的調變技巧與雜訊分析．課程大綱包括：
1.簡介
2.信號與系統
3.機率、隨機程序與雜訊
4.振幅調變：雙旁波帶、調幅、單旁波帶與殘旁波帶
5.角度調變：頻率調變與相位調變
6.脈波調變：脈幅調變、脈寬調變、脈位調變、脈碼調變與步差調變
7.數位通訊簡介
對於數位通訊有進一步興趣的同學可繼續選修『數位通訊系統』課程
description.en:
Fundamental principles of modern communication will be investigated in depth in this course, with emphasis on analog communications.Basic modulation techniques will be introduced with nosie analysis.Contents include
1.Introduction 
2.Signals and Systems
3.Probability ,Random Process,and Nosie
4.Amplitude Modulations:DSB,AM,SSB,and VSB
5.Angle Modulations:FMand PM
6.Pulse Modulations:PAM,PWM,PPM,PCM,and DM
7.Intorduction to Digital Communication 
Students who want to know more details sbout digital commmunication are encouraged to take the course Digital Communication Systems

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討現代通訊的基本原理，內容為類比通訊調變技術,類比訊號及數位訊號轉換技術, 與數位通訊調變技術. 重點放在這些技術的工程內容.

對於數位通訊有進一步興趣的同學可下學期繼續選修『數位通訊系統』課程, 『數位通訊系統』會著重於對數位通訊調變技術更精確的分析.

沒有修過信號與系統的同學仍然可以修本課程, 只是在前1/3學期要比較努力一下.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control.  In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided.  This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course lets the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department.  Besides, the way to manage the products or the service quality, tools and methods of quality control, the way to improve the quality, quality representation method, evaluation of quality control, related regulations and future trends are also included.

syllabi.outline: This course enables students to understand the concepts, principles, and domains of quality management. It covers the organization and functions of the quality management department, how to manage the quality of products or services, quality management tools and methods, methods for continuous quality improvement, quality representation methods, how to evaluate the effectiveness of quality management, relevant regulations, and future trends in quality management. The course content includes quality responsibility, total quality management, basic statistics, control charts, probability theory, attribute control charts, acceptance sampling, reliability, and more.
syllabi.schedule:
Chapter 1- Modern Quality Management and Improvement
Chapter 2- The DMAIC Problem Solving Process
Chapter 3- Statistical Models or Quality Control and Improvement
Chapter 4- Statistical Inference in Quality Control and Improvement
Chapter 5- How SPC Works
Chapter 6- Variables Control Charts
Midterm exam
Chapter 7- Attributes Control Charts
Chapter 8- Determining Process and Measurement Systems Capability
Chapter 9- Time-Weighted Control Charts
Chapter 13- Basic Experimental Design for Process Improvement
Chapter 15- Basic Acceptance sampling Procedures
Final exam
syllabi.assessment: midterm 30%, final exam 40%, attendance and particiation 30%
syllabi.materials: Statistical Quality Control – A Modern Introduction; by D. Montgomery 東華書局 新月圖書

description.zh: 本課程適用於一般大專之決策分析課程。其目的在說明決策理論之基本觀念，及其在真實世界裡相關決策問題之分析。本課程授課主題包括：不考慮機率之決策問題、與機率有關之決策問題、獲取額外資訊之決策分析、效益分析、遊戲理論。相關之授課內容包括：機率分配、期望值方法、貝氏分析、完全資訊與額外資訊之期望值。
description.en:
This is an undergraduate course dealing with decison making and analysis.The objective of this course is to interpret the basic concepts of decision theory and its applications on some real world decision analysis problims.The main topics of this course include decision making without probability,decision making with probability,decison analysis with additional information,utility theory,game
theory.The related studies includes prlbability distribution,expected value approach,Bayesian analysis,expected value of perfect informatin and sample information.

syllabi.outline: This course provides an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory and their applications on the real-world decision problems. Students will learn about the identification and modeling of decision problems, the modeling and estimation of uncertainties, and the modeling and evaluation of preferences.

Week 14: Risk attitudes
Week 15: Utility axioms, paradoxes, and implications
Week 16: Conflicting objectives I
Week 17: Conflicting objectives II
Week 18: Final exam

description.en: Scheduling consists of planning and prioritizing activities that need to be performed in an orderly sequence of operation. It is a tool that optimizes use of available resources. This course focuses on the basic concept on scheduling. The purpose of this course is to guide the students to learn the basic methodologies of scheduling, and to understand the scheduling application aspects.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control.  In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided.  This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.zh: 本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course lets the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department.  Besides, the way to manage the products or the service quality, tools and methods of quality control, the way to improve the quality, quality representation method, evaluation of quality control, related regulations and future trends are also included.

syllabi.outline: This course enables students to understand the concepts, principles, and domains of quality management. It covers the organization and functions of the quality management department, how to manage the quality of products or services, quality management tools and methods, methods for continuous quality improvement, quality representation methods, how to evaluate the effectiveness of quality management, relevant regulations, and future trends in quality management. The course content includes quality responsibility, total quality management, basic statistics, control charts, probability theory, attribute control charts, acceptance sampling, reliability, and more.
syllabi.schedule:

Chapter 2- The DMAIC Problem Solving Process
Chapter 3- Statistical Models or Quality Control and Improvement
Chapter 4- Statistical Inference in Quality Control and Improvement
Chapter 5- How SPC Works
Chapter 6- Variables Control Charts
Midterm exam
Chapter 7- Attributes Control Charts
Chapter 8- Determining Process and Measurement Systems Capability
Chapter 9- Time-Weighted Control Charts
Chapter 13- Basic Experimental Design for Process Improvement
Chapter 15- Basic Acceptance sampling Procedures

syllabi.outline: 本課程目的在於奠定人因工程學理基礎與應用觀念，建立「以人為本」的產品價值觀。本課程將介紹人體之形態特徵、心理期望、動作行為等人因知識，研究人因資訊應用於工業設計實務上之設計方法或準則以獲得具安全、效率與舒適之產品或環境設計。
syllabi.schedule:
課程分為「人因工程理論」與「人因實驗」兩部分：人因工程理論是為訓練學生瞭解不同領域知識在人因工程的應用；人因實驗則是為培養達成最佳化人因工程設計的能力，並啟發對人因學理的興趣。

Week 1 人因工程導論
Week 2 人類三大系統(一)-感覺系統-理論
Week 3 人類三大系統(一)-感覺系統-理論

Week 5 人類三大系統(二)-資訊處理-理論
Week 6 人類三大系統(二)-資訊處理-理論
Week 7 人類三大系統(二)-資訊處理-個案研究
Week 8 人類三大系統(三)-運動控制-理論(肌肉骨骼)
Week 9 人類三大系統(三)-運動控制-理論(人體尺寸)

description.zh: 整合室內設計基礎課程，如：基礎室內設計原理、基礎圖學、施工圖、手繪透視表現、電腦3D表現、建築構造學、室內建築學、裝飾材料、景觀與室內園藝等課程，以創意激發的訓練為主，透過實際設計程序的演練，習得設計的方法並培養解決問題的能力。
description.en: Integration of the interior design foundation courses, such as: basic interior design principles, basic drawings, work drawings, hand-drew perspective, computer 3D performance, building construction, interior architecture, decoration materials, landscape and indoor gardening etc. The course aims to stimulate creativity and to develop problem-solving abilities through the practices of proper design methods and the actual design process.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年課程視為建築設計之基礎課題，從建築美學之觀點培養基本素養、建築模樣體驗、設計實作再造，達到建築設計基本知識之體態。並結合一年級橫向課程之實作、圖學、設計理論、全能住宅改造等課程，課程規劃以多元建構為主，其養成要點如下:

1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。

2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。

3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。

4. 設計實務養成：為因應環境友善，與環境共存之議題如何運用在設計之中，探討行為模式、機能、線安排空間組織等等，將環境之感受能力，以空間再改造展現能力，由於重於綠材料之實作特色，因此實作養成之重要關鍵之一，需配合全能改造課程。達到創作性實務，可說是實驗性實作的特色課程。

5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。

This course is organized, as a three-year's program that is arranged around a pattern of six semesters. The modular teaching structure is:1. 1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。

2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。

3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。

5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 

■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。            
                                                                                                                            
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。 
 
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。

■	第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。

This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:

■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training in fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space.

■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, the physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type, and form, etc.

■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus on environmental systems or urban structures relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings.

■ Fourth year: Graduation project

本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年課程視為建築設計之基礎課題，從建築美學之觀點培養基本素養、建築模樣體驗、設計實作再造，達到建築設計基本知識之體態。並結合一年級橫向課程之實作、圖學、設計理論、全能住宅改造等課程，課程規劃以多元建構為主，其養成要點如下:
1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。
2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。
3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。
4. 設計實務養成：為因應環境友善，與環境共存之議題如何運用在設計之中，探討行為模式、機能、線安排空間組織等等，將環境之感受能力，以空間再改造展現能力，由於重於綠材料之實作特色，因此實作養成之重要關鍵之一，需配合全能改造課程。達到創作性實務，可說是實驗性實作的特色課程。
5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。
This course is organized, as a three-year's program that is arranged around a pattern of six semesters. The modular teaching structure is:1. First year - An introduction to basic design problem solving : concepts of point, line, plane, and space organization : principles of unity/variety ,order ,balance , proportion ,scale , etc.; orthographic projection and axonometrics ; pattern diagramming ; and basic design consequences of human activity. 
The course as the fundamental of architectural design aims to foster basic knowledge from the perspective of architectural aesthetics, experience, and design execution. Combined with the lateral curriculum of construction, drawing, design theory, and housing renewal projects, the program built upon diversified exposures in 1. aesthetics, 2. architectural drawings and rendering techniques, 3. spatial constructs and logics, 4.  Professional training, 5.  materials and experiments, 6. communication and presentation.

description.zh: 本課程介紹室外空間設計和建造的理論、原則和方法。 通過案例研究，課程旨在擴大學生對場地規劃主要組成部分的理解。主題集中在六個前提：1。 場地規劃相關理論； 2． 場地規劃的設計順序； 3． 場地調查與分析； 4． 規劃設計方法及其評價； 5． 環境影響評價；6.案例研究。
description.en: This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of designing and construction of outdoor spaces. Through cases studies, the courses seeks to expand the students understanding to the major components of site planning.Topics focus on six premises:1. theories in relation to site planning;2. design sequences of site planning;3. investigations and analyses of the sites;4. planning and designing methods and their evaluations;5. environmental impact assessment;6.cases studies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在教授建築物外部空間的分析、規劃與營造方法，內容包括理論、實際案例說明與實作。授課主題涵蓋：1.敷地計畫之相關理論、2.敷地計畫之內容及程序、3.基地調查及分析、4.規劃方法與計畫評估（包括土地使用、外部空間、交通動線、排水、整地、植栽）、5.環境影響評估、6.案例分析。實作部分則將結合USR計劃之進行，讓學生能從實際操作與真實課題中拓展學習的深度。
This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of analyzing and planning the exterior space of buildings. Instructional forms include lecture, case studies, and hands-on practice. The topics covered in the course are as follows: 1. Relevant theories of site planning. 2. Content and procedures of site planning. 3. Site investigation and analysis. 4. Planning methods and project evaluation (including land use, external spaces, traffic flow, drainage, landscaping). 5. Environmental impact assessment. 6. Case studies. In specific, the case study and hands-on practice of this course will be integrated with the program of USR (University Social Responsibility), allowing students to expand their learning depth through practical application and real-world issues.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重施工圖繪製教學、構築實務知識的建立及運用建築資訊模型（Building Information Modeling， BIM）對施工圖變革之介紹。課程將指導學生以電腦輔助軟體繪製一套小住宅圖說，以熟悉施工圖通則與繪圖技巧；講解現行常見施工案例及安排業界工程實務演講，讓學生瞭解建築工程中各種施工內容、注意事項及如何在圖說上繪製清楚；最後，透過ArchiCAD 施工圖講座教學，使學生得以感受當前 BIM 運用下施工圖的變革，除冀望增進學生掌握建築業界施工圖繪製之基礎能力外，亦能藉由不同新工具深化相關能力。

The course aims to teach the regulations of construction drawing, establish the knowledge base of construction tectonics (including the general ways and state-of-the-art), and introduce new ways to integrate constructive information via Building Information Modeling (BIM). 

The course was planned into three phases to respond to such motifs: Firstly, the students will be guided to complete a set of small residential construction drawings with computer-aided software to be familiar with the CNS regulations and enforce the skills of architectural drawings. Secondly, explain the existing general fabrication methods by selected case studies and invite alums who have enriched practices in the industry to share their experiences. The students can deeply understand the reasons for the construction methods and apply them to their designs and drawings. Finally, through arranging ArchiCAD constructive drawings tutorials, students can grasp first-hand applications of construction drawings under BIM to prompt students to build up envisions and adopt new tools and related capabilities for following up on the progress of architectural techniques.

syllabi.outline:
本課程由建築物所受之載重與結構損壞之原因進一步說明結構系統設計之要點與重要性，課程中並針對柱樑構架系統、桁架結構、薄膜結構、薄殼結構等等不同結構，其結構行為以及設計應用之重點。除此之外，課程亦將針對耐震相關技術進行介紹。課程目標包括
1.	建立學生結構系統設計之基本觀念，並訓練將其應用於建築設計之基本能力。
2.	依課程安排培養學生耐風、耐震之觀念，以及瞭解不同結構系統之原理與設計要點。
3.	教導學生結構破壞原因之基本判斷。
syllabi.schedule:
第1周:建築物之載重與各材料之力學特性。
第2、3周:風力與地震力作用下之結構行為，以及耐風與耐震之基本觀念。
第4周:結構系統設計之基本觀念
第5、6周:抗拉結構與抗壓結構
第7、8周:桁架結構與其應用。
第9、10周:柱樑構架結構系統。
第11周:薄膜結構系統。
第12周:薄殼結構系統。
第13周:大垮度空間之結構系統。
第14周:高樓結構系統
第15周:地震防範觀念，以及消能、隔震、減震與制振等防震技術之介紹。
第16周:結構破壞與原因

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:物理或負責教授同意
本課程介紹流體力學，強調應用於流體機械系統的基本工程科學原理。學生將學習粘性和非粘性流體的控制積分和微分方程，並將這些方程應用於內部和外部流動。
This course provides an introduction to fluid mechanics. It stresses fundamental engineering science principles applied to fluid mechanical systems. Students will learn the governing integral and differential equations for viscous and inviscid fluids and will apply these equations to internal and external flows.

syllabi.outline:
本課程屬於流體力學之應用學科，課程內容著重於如何將流體力學的基本原理應用到廣泛使用之流體機械上。其中各章節將介紹各種常用流體機械之結構、操作原理及其分類、相關之流體力學基本原理、定律，以及特性曲線之使用。透過本課程之介紹期望使學生能對流體機械之工作有深刻的瞭解，並知曉如何設計相關之流路或管線以及選用適當之流體機械。教材大綱: 分流力(基本定律、管流、流體量測)、水力機械(泵、水輪機)、空氣機械(送風機、風車)、排量型機械等四大主題來教學。
This course belongs to the applied discipline of fluid mechanics. The content of the course focuses on how to apply the basic principles of fluid mechanics to widely used fluid machinery. Each chapter will introduce the structure, operating principle and classification of various commonly used fluid machinery, related basic principles and laws of fluid mechanics, and the use of characteristic curves. Through the introduction of this course, students are expected to have a deep understanding of the work of fluid machinery, and know how to design related flow paths or pipelines and select appropriate fluid machinery.
This course belongs to the applied discipline of fluid mechanics. The content of the course focuses on how to apply the basic principles of fluid mechanics to widely used fluid machinery. Each chapter will introduce the structure, operating principle and classification of various commonly used fluid machinery, related basic principles and laws of fluid mechanics, and the use of characteristic curves. Through the introduction of this course, students are expected to have a deep understanding of the work of fluid machinery, and know how to design related flow paths or pipelines and select appropriate fluid machinery. Textbook syllabus: Four major themes for teaching are shunt force (basic law, pipe flow, fluid measurement), hydraulic machinery (pump, turbine), air machinery (blower, windmill), and displacement machinery.

description.zh: 本課程介紹語言教學與學習原則，語言習得理論，和語言習得領域重要研究發現。期能建立學生應用語言學知識與日後相關研究的基礎。課程涵蓋主要內容包括：母語習得理論與實踐、第二語言(外語)習得理論與實踐、母語習得與第二語言(外語)習得之相同與相異處、影響語言習得重要因素(情性因素與社會文化因素)、語言學習者策略、對比分析、錯誤分析、語言溝通能力、閱讀理論與實踐、 寫作理論與實踐。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide an overview of the current state of second language acquisition studies and to familiarize students with major language acquisition theories and fundamental principles of language learning and teaching.  The topics that this course primarily deals with include: theories of first language acquisition; theories of second language acquisition; current issues in language acquisition; age and acquisition; learning styles and learner strategies; affective factors in second language acquisition; socio-cultural factors in second language acquisition; learner language and error analysis; communicative competence; the reading process; and the writing process.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Public Speaking and Debates
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Office: 	        General Education Building Rm.805 / Extension: 3941
Term Offered:		Fall, 2022
Course Description: 	This course aims to establish the foundation for English-major students to deliver public speeches in English. Students learn to select topics, collect essential information, analyze the audience, organize materials, improve delivery skills, distinguish different types of speeches, and further to evaluate their own and others’ speeches. Each student is expected to deliver at least 3-4 individual speeches, and 2-3 debates. Speech topics will be discussed and assigned to students. Any modifications of the speech topics will have to be approved by the instructor. All student speech sessions must be videotaped.(see note 1) 
Course Requirements: 	Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
(1)	Attending class regularly and to arrive on time: 
(2)	Delivering speeches as scheduled: 
i.	Students who are scheduled to give an in-class speech (for official grading) need to record a pre-speech on the scheduled day. (see note 2)
ii.	Make-up speech will be only allowed when the failure to perform is due to an officially excused absence or incidents under extreme circumstances
iii.	The ideal time duration for each speech is 4 to 6 minutes. The minimum length of speech time is 3 minutes, and the maximum 6. Violation of the time limit (less than 3 and more than 6) constitutes a failure w/o points awarded. The time length for debates will vary due to the different formats employed.
iv.	It is essential to comply with the prescriptive requirements for each speech. Failure to follow will result in disqualification to complete the speech 
(3)	Submitting to the instructor a speech file with inclusion of the outlined speech as well as the full-length speech script (with citation and references), the speech evaluation sheet, the self-evaluating commentaries of both the current and previous speeches, and also blank A-4 size lined sheets for notes and feedbacks(see Appendix 1 & 2) when presenting the speech. Students who do not have the file ready and fail to comply with the outline format requirements (sampled and specified below_Appendix 3) forfeit the right to deliver the speech and hence receive zero points.  
(4)	Student speakers are also required to display their outline slide(s) during the speech. 
(5)	Evaluating one’s own speech (by the self-evaluation guideline): Student speakers are required to watch their own videotaped speeches (both pre-speech and in-class speech) observe their own speeches, and compile all speech and debate evaluation for submission. Students are strongly advised to use their own videotaping devices for both the pre and in-class speeches. Post-class recordings will be arranged and produced in the Lab, if necessary. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings is required for submission at the semester end.

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

name.en: World Literatures and Cultures in English

description.zh: 本課程旨在藉由各種文化媒體（如文學作品，書報雜誌，期刊論文，電影等影音文字）引導學生選擇性地認識英國、愛爾蘭、美國、加拿大、非洲、澳洲、紐西蘭、印度、巴基斯坦、新加坡、香港、菲律賓、加勒比海等國家或地區的文學與文化。藉由認識上述這些國家或地區的英語文學與文化，擴展學生英語文應用的宏觀視野，並使之具備促進異國情感及文化交流的能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to the selected literatures and cultures of English-speaking countries and areas such as England, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Anglophone Africa, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, Singapore, Hong Kong, the Philippines, and the Caribbean. In this course, world literatures in English, together with various cultural media (including newspaper, magazine and journal articles as well as Internet materials and films), will be examined to introduce students to Anglophone literatures and cultures. Students are expected to acquire via this course a nuanced, discriminating literary and cultural competency. With this cross-cultural literacy, they could help promote international understanding and global cultural exchange.

description.en: The need for information-based support for managers is increasing as the modern management imperatives of reach and to meet their organization's goals. A management information system (MIS) is an integrated user + Machine system that provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Topic of learning:‧Acquiring strategic advantage through information systems.‧Supporting managers and executives through IS applications.‧Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications.‧Attaining and practicing technological leadership.

description.en:
This course reviews and expands upon core topics in probability and
statistics through the study and practice of data analysis. Topics
include numerical and graphical summaries of data, hypothesis testing,
confidence intervals, analysis of variance, and regression. Upon
completion of this course, students should be able to think critically
about data and apply standard statistical inference procedures to draw
conclusions from such analysis.

description.en: This course is designed to introduce concepts and skills essential in the database systems. Relational database will be the main focus with related topics such as relational model, design concepts, and structured query language. The topics to be covered include: introduction to database systems, record storage and file organizations, indexed structures for files, the relational model, relational algebra and calculus, SQL, conceptual and logical design for relational database, functional dependencies, normalization, query optimization and database technology. Advanced topics include object-oriented database, multimedia database, distributed database, and concurrent operations on database.

description.zh: 先修課程：普通物理、工程數學。 從黑體輻射之頻譜分析開始，引入量子化的概念；進而推出物質與波動之二象性。經由波爾之半古典的氫原子模型，結合量子化的概念以解釋原子結構，並引入薛丁格方程式所求得之波函數與電子之空間機率的關係。再由原子進而推廣至分子及固態物理之能帶理論，應用能帶理論於解釋固態晶體之光、電及熱學等特性，並介紹半導體之應用的基本原理。
description.en: From the analysis of the spectrum of black-body radiation, the concept of quantization is introduced and the duality of matter and wave is also introduced. Combining the idea of quantization and the semi-classical hydrogen model of Bohr, the structure of atom is described. Solving the Schrodinger equation, the deduced wave function is related to the probability of finding the electron in space. The concept of atom is expanded to the molecular and the energy band theory of solid state physics. The energy band theory of solid state physics is applied to account the optical, electrical, and thermal properties of solid states, also the fundamental principles of semiconductors are introduced.

description.zh: 本課程介雷射之基本特性及雷射光在光學上的應用，內容包括雷射之時間與空間特性、雷射之模態、干涉、繞射、偏振及透鏡之各種像差等實驗。
description.en: This course introduces the fundamental characteristics of lasers and the applications of lasers in optics. It includes the experiments of the temporal and spatial characteristics of lasers, the mode distribution of lasers, interference, diffraction, and the abberations of lenses.

description.zh: 本課程始自ㄧ系列關於「古代哲學」的演講，特別著重於自然主義哲學家的思想，如泰利斯、巴門尼德斯、赫拉克利圖斯，與德摩克利圖斯。藉此讓我們得以瞭解下述議題: 宇宙的基本物質、變化問題，與原子論。接下來，我們會探討希臘哲學，著重於:辯士學派、蘇格拉底、柏拉圖，與亞里斯多德。我們接著探討希臘化時期的學說: 如犬儒主義、斯多葛主義、伊比鳩魯學派、新柏拉圖主義，與神祕主義。最後我們轉向中世紀哲學，再接著探討文藝復興與巴洛克時期的思想。
description.en: The course starts with a series of lectures on ancient philosophy with an emphasis of thoughts presented by the Naturalistic philosophers who initiate our research interest in the Nature and our surroundings such as Thales, Parmenides, Heraclitus, and Democritus.  By doing so we would learn the following important topics such as the basic matter of the universe, the problem of change, and atomism.  We then shall move onto Greek philosophy with a particular look at the following philosophers: the Sophists, Socratics, Plato, and Aristotles.  Afterwards, we will study the theories and accounts during the Hellenistic period such as Cynicism, Stoicism, Epicureanism, Neo-Platonism, and Mysticism. We then will turn to Medieval philosophy, followed by a close look at thoughts appeared in the Renaissance and Baroque era.

syllabi.outline:
「口語溝通策略與演練」課程旨在於訓練學生的口語溝通技巧，並培養精準的表達能力。口說與閱讀和思考有密切的關係，因此本課程設計以發想力、邏輯思考力、表達力及批判思考力的訓練為基礎，並結合肢體語言和聲調的技巧，使學生能於有趣的教學現場中獲得口語溝通的技巧和表達經驗。
This course aims to introduce different skills related to oral communication strategy, which includes personal communication, power point and oral presentation, stories narration, critical thinking strategies, and the communication ways of TED.

description.zh: 博物館學課程目的在於培養並建構學生對於博物館發展之史觀，透過理論與實務，讓學生學習及了解博物館的功能性、意義與重要性、價值觀轉變以及後現代性和發展趨勢等議題，使同學對於博物館學有一基礎認識。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate and construct students' historical points of view. Students can learn and understand the function, significance and importance, value transformation, postmodernity, and development trends of museums through theory and practice so that students can have a basic understanding of museology.

syllabi.outline:
課程目的在於培養並建構學生對於博物館發展之史觀(historical point of 
view)。課程中將搭配學理論述與實務經驗等，培養學生學習下列相關知識。首先了解博物館定義為何？如何發生與演變，闡明博物館於社會、政治、經濟及宗教等時代演進中博物館概念的發生與建立、性質與功能的變化，及其與社會文化思潮之聯繫；其次，分別由歷史及當代不同文化類型形塑出的博物館，掌握不同文化下博物館樣貌形塑的差異性；最後，透過實際參訪與實務經驗的輔助，了解博物館作為文化機構所賦予之意義與重要性，並透過對博物館教育、觀眾研究及社會議題之關注了解博物館之價值觀轉變以及後現代性，並論及博物館與當代人類學之族群關係、歷史記憶、文化觀光等議題，使同學對於博物館學有一基礎認識。

1.了解博物館的功能性並透過理論與實務之結合掌握要點
2.透過博物館分類了解博物館作為文化機構所賦予之意義與重要性
3.透過博物館觀眾及社會議題之關注了解博物館之價值觀轉變以及後現代性
4.由歷史/當代角度了解全球博物館發展趨勢

description.zh: 陶藝基礎是一門以實作為主，實務講述為輔的陶藝設計創作課程。透過實務教學進行，提供學生陶瓷工藝廣泛多元視角的文化創新課程。課程旨在結合陶藝基礎能力與陶瓷設計產出思維，從介紹陶藝發展、材料種類、技法使用，到進入實作，並導入工藝生活的精神。學生系統性的完成作品後，將透過展演形式發表成果。
description.en: The Ceramics Foundation is a clay creation course supplemented by theory and practice. Through practical teaching, it provides a cultural innovation viewpoint with a wide range of perspectives on the ceramics craftsmanship. The course aims to combine the basic skills of ceramic art with the design thinking, from the ceramic art development, material knowledge, to techniques, and the introducing of the idea of craft in life. After the students have systematically completed the work, they will organize a group exhibition to show the result.

課程以循序漸進的方式，協助學生在陶瓷產品設計上所需能力支持及思維釐清。加強同學在材料運用上的廣度及深度，並學習自行發展主題性創意產出。課堂上以個別指導及分組討論的模式，協助學生發展自我的創作脈絡，以建立自我在產出概念及創意思考上的模式。
課程針對同學在陶瓷成型技術與知識基礎訓練之後，有異於過往以陶藝創作思維及思想批判性為主軸的教育模式，改以陶瓷拉坯文化傳承及鶯歌產業人才創生之社會問題導向，課程內容包括認識鶯歌陶藝發展意識、地方產業沒落問題、地方創生政策、及其他有關文化永續與社會實踐的視野。切入工藝創生與陶瓷文化永續之議題，輔助學生建立工藝與社會人文議題關連性之整合概念。

協助同學探究如何發展自我的文化美學認同，自行尋找答案並解決問題，建立自行發展地方創意性工藝產品設計的能力，捏塑陶藝領域中美感與鶯歌市場接軌的可行性，為本教學預期之培育目標，以引發動機與發現陶藝文化認同之人才培力為出發點。

description.zh: 課程旨在介紹實驗影像的關鍵理論，說明導演與藝術家是如何使用視覺與聲音技術向影像本質提問，以啟動視覺之外感官知覺，進而擴展影像的語言。從早期歐洲前衛電影、城市電影、實驗影像，到台灣近年電影，關切在觀看裡的感官知覺經驗，以回應當代視覺文化裡，數位藝術、新媒體與沈浸式影像創作等的興起。
description.en: The course aims to introduce the key theories of experimental images. Filmmakers and artists employ audio-visual techniques to investigate the nature of images itself, intending to explore sensual perception beyond visuality and expanding the realm of images. Beginning from the early European avant-garde cinema, city symphonies, experimental images to recent Taiwanese films, this course focuses on sensory perception in spectatorship, in response to the emergence of digital art, new media, immersive images, and so on.

syllabi.outline: 課程旨在介紹實驗影像的關鍵理論，說明導演與藝術家是如何使用視覺與聲音技術向影像本質提問，以啟動視覺之外感官知覺，進而擴展影像的語言。從早期歐洲前衛電影、城市電影、實驗影像，到台灣近年電影，關切在觀看裡的感官知覺經驗，以回應當代視覺文化裡，數位藝術、新媒體與沈浸式影像創作等的興起。
syllabi.schedule:
本課程探究的對象是「影像」，目的是說明藝術家與導演是如何向影像本質提問，以啟動視覺之外感官知覺，進而擴展影像的語言。課程分成四大主題，每主題皆有指定閱讀文章與影片。

本課程歡迎曾修習課程「藝術的幾何元素」或「動態影像新研究法」同學，繼續參與。

主題一：感官知覺的開啟－運動影像實驗
第 01 週：課程介紹、線性敘事與非線性敘事
（影片）：光影魔法師（2015）Moholy-Nagy, 1936.

（閱讀）：麥克魯漢著，2008。《古騰堡星系：活版印刷人的造成》，賴盈滿譯。台北：貓頭鷹。頁5-7、68-75、143-146、204-208、257-259、300-302。
（影片）：Thom Andersen, 1975. Eadwaerd Muybridge Zoopraxographer.
第 03 週：影像上的運動感覺，以繪畫、攝影與電影為說明
（閱讀）：德勒茲著，2007。《弗蘭西斯・培根》，董強譯。頁30-46。
第 04 週：人與機械
（閱讀）：Turvey, Malcom. 2002. ‘The Avant-Garde and the "New Spirit": The Case of “Ballet mcaniqe”’ October, Autumn, Vol. 102. MA: The MIT Press. pp. 35-58.
（影片）：Fernand Lger and Dudley Murphy, 1924. Ballet mcaniqe.（機械新娘）

主題二：迎向新世界－城市影像實驗
第 05 週：維托夫與手持攝影機的人、主題一紙本報告繳交
（閱讀）：・Jacobs, Steven. Kinik, Anthony and Hielscher, Eva. 2019. ‘Introduction: The City Symphony Phenomenon 1920-40,’ Eva. The City Symphony Phenomenon: Cinema, Art, and Urban Modernity Between the Wars. Edited by Jacobs, Kinik and Hielscher. NY: Routledge. pp. 3-42.・Annette Michelson, 1985. “Intro to Kino-Eye,” Kino-Eye Writings of Dziga Vertov.
（影片）：Dziga Vertov, Man with a Movie Camera (1929)

（閱讀）：Richard Kostelanetz，1991. Moholy-Nagy: The Rick and Necessity of Artistic Adventurism. 
（影片）：・Moholy-Nagy, 1929. Impressions of the Old Marseille Harbor. Moholy-Nagy, 1936. The New Architecture and the London Zoo.

（閱讀）：Amad Paula. 2020. ‘”The World’s Heavy Gaze”: Cin-aereality in the Postwar Avant-Gardes,’ Modernism/modernity. Vol. 5. Johns Hopkins University Press. pp. 207-242.

第 08 週：期中分組上台報告、主題二紙本報告繳交
第 09 週：期中分組上台報告

主題三：縱橫山林－自然影像實驗
第 10 週：塞尚的聖維克多山、畫家呂正基的台灣高山；期末分組創作作業說明
（閱讀）：・顏娟英，2009。《油彩・山脈・呂基正》。台北：雄獅。・林麗雲，2004。《山谷跫音：台灣山岳美術圖像與呂基正》。台北：雄獅。

description.zh: 財務報表所反映的是企業的經營績效，不同的產業有不同的特質、不同的經營環境，即使在相同的產業中，企業若採行不同的競爭策略，在財務報表上也會有不同的表現。本課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何透過財務報表，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：1) 基本財務報導與特別科目的報導與分析 2) 基本分析理論 3) 償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 5) 探討我國最近發佈的7號、34號及35號會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of this course is to help students evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes 1) financial reports and analysis of special accounting subjects; 2) basic financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹企業倫理的意涵及其與一般倫理的差異，並深入探討與臺灣和國際社會相關的倫理議題和案例。透過討論問題和互動交流，學生將培養道德判斷能力和國際視野，以應對企業倫理所面臨的挑戰。

1. 導論
   - 瞭解倫理、道德、企業倫理和一般倫理的基本觀念
   - 探討企業倫理在現代社會中的重要性

2. 倫理教育與道德發展
   - 探究企業倫理教育的推行和道德發展的過程
   - 討論校園倫理教育、倫理意識、決策和判斷等相關議題

3. 倫理判斷與教學操作
   - 探討倫理判斷的教學方法和操作
   - 分析行政倫理、非政府倫理和職場倫理等相關議題

4. 企業社會責任與環境保護
   - 瞭解企業社會責任的概念和實踐
   - 探討環境保護的倫理議題和企業公民責任的重要性

5. 跨國企業的倫理挑戰
   - 分析跨國企業所面臨的倫理議題和挑戰
   - 探討永續發展和社會責任型投資的相關議題

課程結構以對應目次中的章節來進行，並在每個章節中安排相關的倫理案例和討論問題，以促進學生的學習和思考。此外，課程結尾包含選擇題和問題研討，供學生進行自我測驗和答問，以鞏固所學知識。

description.zh:
區塊鏈由比特幣為代表的1.0，經過以太坊的智能合約為代表的2.0，進入以設計超級帳本或結合物聯網、人工智慧的3.0階段。在各產業的應用也逐漸廣泛，已呈現多元研究及發展的面向，也代表產業型態將因為區塊鏈的發展而發生重大的變革。
本課程在帶領學生了解區塊鏈的核心技術、特性，以及目前在各產業的應用實例，並透過從發行數字貨幣到撰寫智能合約的商業應用，看見區塊鏈未來的發展。
description.en:
Blockchain is represented by Bitcoin 1.0, and after 2.0 represented by Ethereum's smart contracts, it enters the 3.0 stage of designing a super ledger or combining the IoT and AI. The application in various industries is gradually becoming more and more extensive, and it has presented a multi-faceted research and development orientation. It also represents that the industry type will undergo major changes due to the development of the blockchain.
This course leads students to understand the core technology and characteristics of blockchain, as well as current application examples in various industries, and sees the future development of blockchain through the commercial application from issuing digital currency to writing smart contracts.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將教導學生了解固定收益型商品的評價以及風險控管的方法。這些方法會需要一些基礎的數學工具，例如微積分與統計，而這些工具大一、二的學生在過往的必修課程中已經習得。為了有效處理複雜的評價問題並與所介紹的基礎觀念連結，本課程將會教導學生如何利用兩種程式語言，C 和 Matlab，來進行計算，處理的問題也將包含 (1)現金流現值的計算，(2)利用牛頓法求解公司債持有報酬率，(3) 利用二分法計算swap interest rate (4) 拔靴法求零息利率

(This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating fixed-income securities and hedging. The pricing algorithm will then be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the calculation of the present value of future cash flows, internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  and zero rate curves via the bootstrap method.)

十~十七	12/2、12/9(暫) 設計思考Workshop (雙週末)

By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. name.zh: 智慧空間互動程式設計
name.en: Interaction design and programming in a smart space

description.zh: 互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機(大疆/Parrot)、生成對抗網路、軟體開發應用(Open source SDK)、APP開發、介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試。相關程式與應用包括JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.
description.en: This course is integrated with AR、VR、MR, smart agent concepts, and user experiences study.  The purpose is to incorporate programmer and designer in designing a mixed-reality space which is actually a physical space considered as a real-time interface to trig many human-environment interactions. Based on Electronic Engineering, Computer Science and Information Engineering, and Interaction Design, we set study topics as Drones (Dji /Parrot), gan, Open source SDK, APP development, interface design, small business innovation. Students are encouraged to create their own concepts then develop programming. Course contents included of spatial perception and information visualization, spatial information and interface, machine learning, neural network, Scrum, software development and testing. The program and application included of JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

syllabi.outline:
互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機、生成式AI(AIGC)、軟體開發應用、網頁資訊視覺化介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試、Blender 3D 建模與AI生成、Unreal Engine 簡單遊戲設計及無人機群飛。相關程式與應用包括JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

The design of interactive smart spaces focuses on integrating reality and reality, coupled with the concept of smart agents and user experience, prompting programming professionals to collaborate with interaction designers to develop smart interfaces that allow users to interact with the environment at any time. This course combines electronics, engineering, and interaction, focusing on topics such as drones, generative AI (AIGC), software development and applications, web information visual interface design, and innovative research and development of small enterprises. Learners and in-depth Development procedures and development practices design it. The course includes spatial cognition and visualization, spatial information and interface design, machine learning, neural networks, SCRUM, software development, and testing, Blender 3D modeling and AI generation, Unreal Engine simple game design and drone swarm flight. Related programs and applications include JavaScript, JSON, Firebase, D3.JS, Apache ECharts, CNN, and Python.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.zh: 本課程旨在整合應用程式與設計，完成互動設計作品。為達成此目標，本課程培養學生熟悉與整合互動設計的理論、方法與應用，以具互動性的設計議題，訓練學生獨立創作或分組合作設計，藉此訓練學生創意思考、應用科技與新知的實作能力，同時也可結合產學合作專案於教學活動內，達到務實致用的目標。
description.en: This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interaction design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在通過專案整合的方式，引導學生學習生成式人工智慧在互動科技領域的應用。學生將學習使用者腳本設計的基礎知識，進行使用者經驗分析，並探討互動科技的相關技術分析。同時，學生將通過互動程式的撰寫，完成互動科技應用系統的開發和評估。

This course aims to guide students in the development of interactive technology applications using generative AI through a project-based approach. Students will learn the fundamentals of user script design, user experience analysis, and interactive technology analysis. They will also gain hands-on experience in writing interactive programs to develop and evaluate interactive technology applications.

description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theory of user interface design, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related application, so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and design work.

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 本課程設計予五專部工科學生，其目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: This course is designed for the five-year-degree-program students.In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
實驗簡介
P1	長度的量測	使用游標尺、螺旋測微器、球徑器，量測物體長度。
1	經驗方程式	利用圓環擺動的週期，求出週期與半徑之間的關係
2	簡諧運動	利用滑車及彈簧研究簡諧運動的特性
3	表面張力	應用圓環量測液體的表面張力。
4	等加速運動	量測自由落體，求出重力加速度。
5	楊氏彈性係數	應用光槓桿原理，量金屬絲的楊氏彈性係數。
6	碰撞實驗	利用台車研究物體的彈性及非彈性碰撞。
7	轉動慣量之測定	量測不同結構的圓柱體的轉動慣量。
8	熱平衡:利用混合法，求卡計之熱容量、金屬比熱、冰熔解熱以瞭解熱平衡
9	熱膨脹係數	測量金屬材料的熱膨脹係數
10	熱電偶電動勢	探討熱電偶電動勢與溫度的關係。
11	黏滯係數	測量流體的黏滯係數及溫度的效應。
12	波動	(1)探討駐波的性質並測量音叉的頻率；
        (2)探討空氣柱的共鳴及量測空氣中的聲音的速度。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為五專部工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週4小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en:
The course is aimed directly at the five-year-degree-program students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to
emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 4 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Series.

description.zh: 本課程適用於P-TECH學校。透過多元化的課程設計，透過教學培養學生職場中所需具備的技能及軟實力，為將來進入職場提前做好準備。其課程涵蓋七大主題：協同合作(collaboration)、溝通技巧(communication)、分析式思維(analytical thinking)、自我管理能力(self-management)、激勵(motivation)、領導力(leadership)、專責(responsibility)、好奇心(curiosity)等課程，並搭配企業參訪(worksite visits)、實習課程及企業導師等安排，培養具備職場技能及競爭力的學生。
description.en: The primary focus of Workplace Learning Curriculum is to provide students with introductory units on communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, leadership and responsibility, self-management, curiosity and motivation. The 7 skills are a framework for talking about professional skills within the P-TECH model. We are calling out these skills for the IBM P-TECH schools in hopes that our students will begin to develop fluency in discussing them, which will be highly valuable in distinguishing their readiness for internships and?? jobs from their competition.

description.zh: 本程式設計課程以C語言為基礎，先介紹程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言物件導向概念。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練以應付各類工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。
description.en: To familiarize the student with basic computer programming concepts. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, as well as an introduction into the syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming language. An important objective of the course is to present effective methods of program design using modular construction and structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括四大項：
一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換
二 向量幾何與分析
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
上學期課程包含第一大項，下學期課程包括第二、三、四項。

description.zh: 介紹各領域的太空科學和技術的應用，包括：火箭、太空醫學、太空法、太空人、太空(光)通訊、太空遙測、太空旅行、太空商業化、人類太空、(外)太空探索、太空垃圾、宇宙飛船、月球、土星、小行星、火星、彗星、行星科學、天體物理學、次軌道、類衛星、天文?等。
description.en: This course will introduce the application of space science and technology in various fields, including: rockets, space medicine, space law, astronauts, space (optical) communications, space remote sensing, space travel, space commercialization, human space, (outer/deep) space exploration, space debris, cosmic spacecraft/probe, moon, Saturn, asteroids, Mars, comets, planetary science, astrophysics, sub-orbits, satellite-like, astronomy...etc.

description.en:
1. Introduction to computer networks and the Internet. Protocolarchitectures (TCP/IP, OSI). Packet switching 
2. Application Layer Protocols: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DNS, P2P. Socket programming and Web server implementations. 
3. Transport Layer Protocols: TCP, UDP 
4. Network Layer Protocols: IP 
5. Data Link Layer Protocols: Ethernet. Local area networks 
6. Wireless and Mobile Network

syllabi.outline: The course aims to provide a comprehensive introduction to Internet and computer networking technologies. Unlike traditional course, it pursues a top-down approach to the topics, starting with the application layer and then describing the transport and network layers, finally covering the physical layer. The topics covered in course are: (1) Network Application, (2) TCP and UDP protocols, (3) Network Layer - Data Plane, (4) Network Layer - Control Plane, (5) Link Layer & Local Area Networks, (6) Wireless and Mobile Network, and (7) Multimedia Networking.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括五大項：
一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換，   特殊函數。
二 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
五 複變分析及映射轉換。

syllabi.outline:
電子學實習的課程在教授測試跟設計類比電路，在課程中將會介紹基本的儀器使用說明、電子零件之認識、二極體電路（特性）、電晶體電路（特性）、線性電壓調整器及濾波器等應用。課程在規劃搭配原理的介紹及電路的模擬與實務的驗證，以專案式的教學作為學習的導向。

The course of the electronics experiment laboratory teaches testing and designing of analog circuits. The course will introduce basic instrumentation instructions and understanding of electronic parts, including diode circuits (characteristics), transistor circuits (characteristics), linear voltage regulators and filters, and electronics applications. The course introduces the principle of electronics, the simulation of the circuit, and practical verification of circuits with project learning-based teaching methods.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括五大項：
一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換，   特殊函數。
二 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
五 複變分析及映射轉換。
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction, Terminology and Separable Equations
第1週  課程介紹；微分方程用語與可分離方程式
Week 2 The Linear First-Order Equation, Exact Equations
第2週  一階線性微分方程式、正合方程式
Week 3 Integrating Factors, Homogeneous Equations
第3週  積分因子法、齊性微分方程式
Week 4 Bernoulli and Riccati Equations, Additional Applications
第4週  伯努利方程式及雷卡迪方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 5 The Linear Second-Order Equation, Reduction of Order
第5週  二階線性微分方程式、降階法
Week 6 The Constant Coefficient Homogeneous Equation
第6週  常係數齊性微分方程式
Week 7 Particular Solutions of the Nonhomogeneous Equation
第7週  非齊性微分方程式的特解
Week 8 The Euler Differential Equation, Additional Applications
第8週  尤拉微分方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 9 High Order Differential Equations, Midterm Exam.
第9週  高階微分方程式、期中考
Week 10 Definition and Notation of Laplace Transform
第10週 拉氏轉換式的定義與標號
Week 11 Solution of Initial Value Problems, Shifting Theorem and the Heaviside Function
第11週 含有初值問題的解、移位定理與赫維賽德函數
Week 12 Convolution, Impulses and the Dirac Delta Function
第12週 摺積、單位脈衝及狄拉克德爾塔函數
Week 13 Solution of Systems of Laplace Transform
第13週 線性微分方程式系統的解
Week 14 Polynomial Coefficients Differential Equations
第14週 多項式係數的拉氏轉換式
Week 15 Power Series Solutions
第15週 冪級數的解
Week 16 Frobenius Solutions and the real roots
第16週 弗羅貝尼斯的解與實根
Week 17 Frobenius Solutions with k≠0
第17週 具有k≠0弗羅貝尼斯的解
Week 18 Final Exam.
第18週  期末考

description.en: Course Title:Probability and Statistics Description:This course is designed for students to get concepts and methods of Probability and Statistics. The main purpose of this course is establishment of the foundations of industrial management, quality control, and industrial economics.

syllabi.outline:
此課程主要探討現代機率基本知識，包含以下主題: 機率空間；隨機變數；期望值與慣矩；聯合分佈隨機變數；慣矩母函數；中央極限定理。
This course will be focused on the basic knowledge of probability, including the following topics: sample space; random variables; expected value and moment; joint distributed random variables; moment generating function; central limited theory.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline: In the first semester, this course first introduces the core areas of physical chemistry by defining systems, states, and processes. Later, traditional thermodynamics is described and applied to understand the reaction spontaneous direction of macroscopic systems, including the explanation of the three laws of thermodynamics, to the description of thermodynamic behavior applied to gaseous and liquid systems.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。

The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 訓練學生以實驗技巧，探討理論，認識儀器，並對實驗結果之數據與現象做評析與處理。
description.en: This course is to train students by experimental techniques and the principles of physical chemistry, and to become familiar with laboratory apparatus. Both the phenomena and data results of experiments are explained and treated.

syllabi.outline: 訓練學生以實驗技巧，探討理論，認識儀器，並對實驗結果之數據與現象做評析與處理。
syllabi.schedule:
一 固體密度的測定 藉比重瓶測定粒狀或粉狀等不規則形固體的密度
二 液體密度的測定 藉漢埃氏法測定液體或溶液的密度
三 表面張力的測定 藉毛細管上升法測定不同溫度下液體的表面張力
四 液體黏度的測定 以奧士瓦黏度計測定純液體或溶液於各種溫度時之相對黏度，並了解相對黏度及絕對黏度的定義及測定法
五 凝固點下降法測定分子量 依據Clausius-Clapeyron方程式及稀薄溶液理論，藉貝克曼凝固點下降分子量測定裝置，以圖解法求溶質之真正分子量
六 中和熱的測定 藉由量熱器測定各種酸與鹼溶液的中和熱，並熟悉量熱器水當量的測定法
七 液體蒸氣壓的測定 藉等壓管法測定液體蒸氣壓，並與Clausius-Clapeyron方程式相驗證，進而估算液體的汽化熱
八 固體溶質溶解度的測定 了解溶解度的定義及其測定方法，以測定固體溶質在不同溫度下的溶解度並求該物質的溶解熱
九 溶質於相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率 測定溶質在相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率，並依據熱力學原理，由分配律測求其會合度或解離度
十 二成份系之液液平衡 測定水-酚系溶液之溶解度曲線（成份與溫度的關係），並求其臨界溶解溫度（或稱會溶溫度）及其組成

description.zh: 介紹化工程序中物質於一系統中流進、流出間質量、能量均衡之原理與計算，使學生學習列出質能均衡之基本式子並查尋相關文獻，手冊上所登錄之物性資料以解決問題。
description.en: The course introduces the material and energy balances of the chemical process.  Students learn to define the system, practice the conservation law of mass and energy, and look up handbook for necessary information.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹化學工程程序中物質於一系統中流進、流出間質量、能量均衡之原理與計算，主要銜接化學專業與工廠內化工製程操作，因化工廠內工作人員被要求對「參與化學反應的質量關係，以及反應中能量的去除或加入」必需清楚明瞭，熟讀本科可擁有足夠的化學專業知識，故可「以最經濟的化學反應成本來量產高附加物品，獲取最大的益」。使學生學習列出質能均衡之基本式並查尋研讀相關文獻、與手冊上所登錄之物性資料以解決各種相關問題。
1.瞭解化學工廠中質量與能量變化之相關知識
2.瞭解化學專業應用在工廠操作之產程放大技術與考量
3.瞭解化學產業之市場動態及其發展情形

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline:
以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括氣體動力論、熱力學、物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、反應動力學、輸送性質等。

本課程為兩學期的課程，在第一學期的部分，將主要集中於熱力學的部分，內容將會包含物質的狀態方程、熱力學三大定律的概念建構、以及相變化的熱力學描述。

相關會處理的議題將會包括：理想氣體與真實氣體的差異性、能量的概念、「亂度」的定義、自由能作為判定程序自發性的標準等等。
syllabi.schedule:
1. The properties of gases 
氣體的性質。內容包含理想氣體、氣體動力論、真實氣體、van der Waals狀態方程的討論。

2. The First Law of Thermodynamics
熱力學第一定律。內容將包含功、熱、焓、狀態方程的概念討論。

3.The Second and Third Laws
熱力學二、三定律。內容將包含對於「亂度」(entropy)、吉布司自由能、Maxwell關聯式等概念的討論。

4. Physical transformations of pure substances
將應用所教授的熱力學三大定律的內容，對純物質的相變化系統進行討論。

5. Simple mixtures
混合物的熱力學討論、將涵蓋理想氣體混合過程、partial molar properties的定義。

*將會在第1、2部分教授完時進行期中考試以測驗學生的理解，期末考的部分將涵蓋第3~5點內容。

課堂小考(25%)

description.zh: 將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。
description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy and its equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solution thermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change, computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning a mathmatics model of metallurgy.

syllabi.outline:
This course applies the theories of thermodynamics to evaluate the chemical potentials equilibrium phases. Three fundamental laws of thermodynamics will first be introduced.  The effects of temperature and pressure upon Gibbs Free energy are then discussed. Applications for solutions, phase diagram, and chemical reaction evaluations with aids of computers will be the main practical topics for thermodynamics. The concepts of thermodynamics will be used extensively for metallurgical and materials-related fields.

本課程討論材料熱力學的基本理論、技巧及應用等，特別是平衡時化學熱力學有關氣相，氣体定理，熱量，功，熱力學第一、第二及第三定律，溫度與壓力對焓，熵，自由能之影響等概念；利用電腦輔助計算溶液、相圖與相平衡、及化學反應平衡等均為熱力學的應用範疇，這些概念對於諸多冶金、材料相關的場域皆十分重要。

description.zh:
材料之特性取決於材料內部組織，所以課程內容也注重內部組織與材料特性之間的關係，內部組織的變化對材料特性之影響，由理論為基礎之探討至實際之應用上。對本課程有關的基本概念，則詳加說明，初學材料者能得到材料上所必備之基本知識，若基本概念已有充分了解，則利用這些知識即可參考材料規格或手冊就可得到欲知之條件，進而以此概念作基礎，亦可研習更高深之學問，本課程內容著重於介紹材料之結構，基本原理有： 1. 金屬之基本理論，金屬及合金之構造，材料之組織，塑性加工變形之理論，材料之物理化學，機械性質及其實驗。 2. 鋼和鐵之製造，組織及其熱處理，變態理論。 3. 構造用鋼，合金鋼，工具鋼，特殊鋼之特性、用
途及其熱處理方法。4. 鋼之表面硬化理論及其熱處理方法。 5. 鑄鐵之冶煉，種類及其熱處理方法。6.非鐵金屬材料，銅，鋁，鈦，鎂，錫，鋅，鉛，鎳等合金種類之特性及其處理方法。
description.en:
The chacteristics of material depend on the inside tissue, therefore, the content also
put more emphasis on the relationship between the inside tissue and material chacter-
istics, how the change of inside tissue influences it in full details from the discussion 
of the theory basis to practical application. It has a detail description to the basic idea
of this course, the novice may get requisite fundamental knowledge. Once they fully
perceive these basic ideas, they may refer to material specification or manual to get
the conditions they request, or they may use these fundation to further explore
advanced knowledge.

description.zh: 專業技術不斷開創與努力，如果再配合管理經營的能力，即能相得益彰，成就非凡。工廠管理是用來探討經營或管理工廠的方法，即以工廠管理人員的立場，研究如何應用最有效的方法，來組合應用各項生產要素，以獲得工廠經營的目標。目前工業發展情況，政府的工業措施與方案，以及我國文化背景，都必須與工廠管理的方法結合，才能成為最佳的經營者。
description.en: It would be an extraordinary achievement if an endless creative professional skill can be matched with excellent management ability. This course is used to discuss the method of management or administration, that is to make a research in using the most effective approach to combine all the necessary production elements from the viewpoint of factory management class, so that the management objective can be reached. The current industry development, the initiative and policy of industry, and the culture background of this country all have to be matched with factory management strategy, thus, would become the best management once and for all.

本課程主要概括性介紹分為三部分：第一、奈米基本理論－介觀物理奈米微粒、奈米碳管與奈米線、奈米薄膜的結構特性、奈米粉體材料的性能等；第二、奈米加工與檢測；第三、奈米材料之應用。
This course is divided into three parts. Part 1: the fundamental of nanostructure materials. The topics include: nanoparticles, carbon nanotube, nanowire, nanostructure coating, bulk materials, etc. Part 2: fabrication of nanomaterials. The topics include: self-assembled, scanning probe microscope. The measurement of nanomaterials include scanning probe microscope, scanning tunneling microscope, Raman spectroscopy, etc. Part 3: the state-of-the art review the application of nanomateria.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 課程主要目標，是要使工程科系，發展出以簡單而合於邏輯的方式分析任何問題，並應用一些為大家熟悉的基本原理加以解答。本課程內容分成質點力學及剛體力學兩部分，剛體力學部分又分為靜力學及動力學。除介紹力學中的基本觀念及定理外更解釋及預測各種物理現象，進而打好工程應用的基礎。提供同學分析及設計各種機件和承載荷重結構的方法，課程內容將介紹某些依據基本定理而化簡的數學模式，進而分析及設計作用在結構上的各種條件，使同學在選擇或運用材料上有安全與正確的觀念，以便在理論與經驗的配合下，順利地處理材料在工程上所發生的問題。
description.en: The major target of this course is to let the engineering students develop and analyze any questions with an easy and logical way, and to try to solve them with some well-recognized fundamental principles. The course can be divided into particle dynamics and rigid body dynamics, the latter can be further divided into statics and dynamics. Apart from introducing the fundamental concept and law, it also explains and forecasts all kinds of nature physic phenomenon, in order to establish a good foundation for engineering application science. It provides methods for students to analyze and design all kinds of machine elements, bearing load structure as well, the course content will introduce some implified math models which are based on fundamental principles, and further analyze and design all conditions to the structure , let students have a safe and exact concept in choosing and utilizing materials, so that the theory and experience can be well matched, and the problems arisen from hand.

syllabi.outline: 本課程歷經幾屆學生的反應與討論, 老師最終將大二上學期的應用力學與下學期的材料力學, 從原本偏向機械系與土木系的靜力學/材料力學, 轉為以物理系的統計力學以及材料系的熱力學為主的(材料特色)應用力學, 我們會從機械系的引擎(熱機)出發, 進入熱力學第二定律, 最終將物理系的統計(熱)力學中的排列方法數(微觀態)與材料(熱)力學中的熵(巨視態)結合成一套連貫性知識

description.zh: 本課程討論，化學中相關物理量的基本理論，技巧及應用等，特別是化學熱力學及電化學等。有關氣相，氣体定理，熱量，功，熱力學第一、第二及第三定律，焓，熵，自由能，相平衡，溶液，化學平衡，酸鹼，電化學，電極，電池，半反應等基礎理論之探討。
description.en: This course discuss the fundamental theory, technique and application with regards to physical property in chemistry, especially at the chemical thermal dynamics and electrical chemistry. The research of the fundamental theory about gaseous phase, the gas laws, heat, work, the first, second and third law of the thermodynatmics, entropy, enthalpy, free energy, phase equilbrium, solution, chemicalequilbrium, acid and alkali, electrical chemistry, electrode,electric cell,half reaction ,etc.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將教導學生有關物理化學的基礎知識，並利用物理原理探討化學領域的各種現象。從氣體分子特性開始，介紹氣體動力論、熱力學理論、相平衡觀念，以及化學和電化學平衡等，並說明化學動力學計算和界面化學領域中的重要理論。
Physical chemistry deals with the principles of physics involved in chemical interactions. This course will start with gas laws, and introduce the kinetic theory of gases, the laws of thermodynamics, phase equilibrium, chemical equilibrium, electrochemical equilibrium, etc. In addition, we will also discuss the basic theories in the fields of chemical kinetics and quantum mechanics.

description.zh: 本課程主要目標在介紹與實際問題相關之數學領域，以模擬解題及詮釋等方式，將數學方法應用在工程問題上。課程內容有常微分方程，線性代數，向量微積分，Fourier 分析及偏微分方程式等章節，訓練同學在理論，計算及實驗間建立正確的認知及意義。內容將繼續介紹複數分析及數值方法等章節，尤其對計算機的概念及演算法乃給予較多的強調，對實際問題亦有簡化討論。另外，在應用解決問題構想，練習例題及理論間，更有相輔相成的效果。至於線性規化，圖形組合，機率理論及數學機率等內容亦有概略介紹，務使同學有正確的認知。

description.zh: 本課程討論結晶質固體之基本概念，含晶體之幾何學及數學理論，並進一步討論結晶化學及結晶構造之原理，同時輔以電子顯微鏡法及X-射線法作結晶構造分析。
description.en: This course is to introduce Elements of Crystallography.

syllabi.outline: 本課程討論晶體之幾何學，對稱關係，結晶化學及結晶構造之原理，以及晶體如何形成及生長，他們與材料性質之關係。由於場域之女王頭等奇岩的脖子部位，因內部礦物結晶物不足，導致強度較弱，如何有效利用結晶學方法，使礦物質結晶於脖子部分的岩石孔隙，以達到增加岩石抗風化強度，延長奇岩壽命，意識本課程重點之一。

第7週：野柳奇岩強化方案－晶體與岩石材料強度關係
第8週：野柳奇岩強化方案－如何應用礦物結晶增強岩石強度
第9週：Mid-term exam.

description.zh: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Visual Basic 語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C或 JAVA程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en: This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts. Syntax and semantics of the VB and C (or JAVA) programming languages will be introduced. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python語言為基礎，在Python包索引（PyPI中）的主機中，擁有成千上萬的Python模組。本課程內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
syllabi.schedule:
Ｗeek 1-2 運算思維與程式設計 - 跨入程式設計的大門
程式設計，是針對電腦要解決的問題提供處理方式的過程，也是軟體開發時的重要步驟。Python是一個執行功能強大，但語法簡潔優雅的程式語言，不僅容易學習，更容易應用實作在許多專題上！

Ｗeek 3-5 變數與運算式 - 不只先乘除後加減
變數建立時，應用程式就會配置一塊記憶體，並以變數名稱做為辨識此塊記憶體的標誌，設計者就可在程式中將各種資料存入使用。運算式包含了運算元與運算子，可以進行程式的運算動作。
‧本章範例包括：成績單、稅率報表及薪資表格式化輸出\梯形、長方形面積計算\複利本金計算...等。

Week 6-8 判斷式 - 邏輯思維的起點
程式設計也和日常生活雷同，常會遇到一些需要做決策的情況，再依決策結果執行不同的程式碼，這就是「判斷式」。
‧本章範例包括：密碼比對判斷\輸入成績評等\電影分級判斷\百貨公司折扣戰\數字比大小...等。

Week 9 期中上機檢核

Week 10-11 迴圈 - 翻滾吧！程式碼
電腦最擅長處理的工作就是重複執行的事情，而日常生活中到處充斥著這種不斷重複的現象，程式專門用來處理重複事件的命令稱為「迴圈」。
‧本章範例包括：建立數列\計算正整數總和\井字直角三角形\九九乘法表\找最小公倍數\階乘計算...等。

Week 12-14  串列與元組 - 大量數據收納術
串列又稱為清單或列表，與其他語言的陣列相同，其功能與變數相類似，是提供儲存資料的記憶體空間。元組的結構與串列完全相同，不同處在於元組的元素個數及元素值皆不能改變。
‧本章範例包括：串列初值設定\迴圈讀取串列\成績計算\刪除串列元素\成績排序...等。

Week 15  字典 - 為資料貼上標籤
字典資料型態，其元素是以「鍵-值」對方式儲存，運作方式為利用「鍵」來取得「值」。‧本章範例包括：血型個性查詢\四季天氣查詢\成績查詢\產品銷售查詢\世大運獎牌數查詢...等。

Week 16 函式與模組 - 簡化運算擴充功能的利器
在程式中通常會將具有特定功能或經常重複使用的程式，撰寫成獨立的小單元，稱為函式。Python擁有許多模組，可讓功能可以無限擴充。
‧本章範例包括：攝氏華氏溫度\公斤英磅轉換\均分蘋果\電費、家庭支出查詢\網址格式檢查\檔案格式檢查\成績單、業績報表列印\日期時間格式轉換\擲骰子遊戲\大樂透抽獎\四星彩開獎...等。

Week 17  演算法：排序與搜尋 - 用邏輯來解決問題
演算法就是為了解決一個問題而採取的方法和步驟，通常會以虛擬碼來表示，再以熟悉的語言來實現。‧本章範例包括：數字排排站\追蹤泡沫排序\搜尋中獎者\彩券對獎...等。

Week 18 期末上機檢核

description.zh:
為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解設計圖中內容，本課程採用實務的教學方式，以工程師實際面對的建築設計圖、結構設計圖、土木設計圖及機電設計圖等，加以解說圖面內容並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下:
1.熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容
2.熟悉設計圖上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義
3.結構標準圖、配筋圖與施工規範之解說
4.如何依設計圖進行工程品質之查驗
5.其他與勞工安全相關知識等
description.en:
To improve undergraduate civil engineering students to understand the design drawings reading ability.  This course provides a set of design drawings, such as building, structural, civil and MEP design drawings, for instructors to explain the meaning of the design drawing, and guide the students to read the related drawings. The course also includes practical exercise for students to read the drawings, and to understand the information in the drawings. The course will also involves the knowledge of engineering to enhance the integration ability of all the design drawings for the students. The contents of this  course are listed as below:
1.To familiar with the whole set design drawings.
2.To familiar with the meaning of symbols, lines and expression in the design drawings.
3.To understand general notes, general drawings, reinforcement and specification in structural design drawings.
4.How to inspect the construction quality by the design drawings.
5.Other topics about labor-safety

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程旨在教導學生具備獨立思考有機化學的能力;因此課程分為基本觀念(結構式與鍵結),有機化學反應與反應機構以及化合物的製備與分析等三大部分。
description.en: The aim of this course is to educate students to think independently about organic chemistry. The course is divided into three parts;introductory material(concepts of structure and bonding);organic reactions and mechanism(sigma-bond chemistry followed by  pi-bond chemistry);and topics of more specialized interest.
