description.zh: 先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車引擎實習，包含汽油及柴油引擎拆裝，引擎實驗，引擎量測與調整，點火、燃油、冷卻及潤滑系統之檢測及故障排除，定期調諧保養及引擎排氣檢測。
description.en: Automobile Engine Service Shop Practice ,Gasoline & Diesel Engine Assembly, Engine Test, Engine Tune-up and Repair, Trouble-shooting and Instrument Adjustment on: Ignition System, Fuel System, Cooling System, Lubrication System, and Starting System, Routine Engine Tune-Up and Engine Exhaust Emission Check .

description.zh: 汽油引擎-工具及量具介紹、燃料系統、冷卻系統、潤滑系統、引擎本體、汽油噴射引擎、汽車排放污染氣體控制系統，汽車底盤-傳動系統、剎車系統、懸吊系統、轉向系統，汽車電系-基礎電學與基本電子學、電瓶、點火系統、起動與充電系統、汽車儀錶與燈路系統、電子控制裝置、車身電系與其他附屬裝置。
description.en: Gasoline Engines include Fuel systems, Cooling systems, Lubrication systems, Engine construction, Fuel injection engines and Emission control systems; Automotive Chassis include Transmission systems, Braking systems, Suspension systems and Steering systems; Automobile Electrical and Electronic Equipment include Basic electricity and electronics, Battery, Ignition systems, Starting and charging systems, Instrument and lighting systems, Electrical control devices, Body electrical systems and Accessories.

name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Technology (I)

description.zh: 課程包含汽車概論，車身構造組件拆裝，汽車碰撞衝擊力之吸收，車身損傷判斷，車身鈑金損傷及修正法，銲接原理與設備，氣銲性質與應用，電銲原理與操作法，二氧化碳銲接法，電阻點銲銲接法介紹，底漆塗佈，補土刮塗與研磨，中塗塗佈與研磨，素色上塗噴塗方法，銀粉漆、透明漆二層塗裝法，以及素色、珍珠、透明漆三層塗裝法之介紹。
description.en: The course includes the following topics: Introduction to automotive vehicles, Construction of vehicle bodies, Impact energy absorption, Damage analysis, Body panel and structural alignment and replacement, Welding principles and equipment, Gas, electric, carbon dioxide, and resistance spot welding, Primer coating, Body filler application, Sanding, and Base coat, clear coat and tri-coat finishes.

name.en: Auto Body Repair and Refinishing Workshop (I)

description.zh: 實習氣銲設備使用及檢漏操作，基本銲道練習，平銲、橫銲、立銲對接，仰銲、填塞銲及銅銲，切割，CO2銲接以及電阻點銲。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Using welding equipment and learning leak detection, Basic welding, Performing welds in various positions on vehicles, Overhead welding, filling welding and brazing, Cutting, CO2 welding, and Resistance spot welding.

description.zh: 先修課程： 無。本實習內容為汽車底盤實習，包含底盤綜合保養檢修、轉向懸吊及煞車系統元件拆裝調整檢修、檢修調整汽車前輪定位、拆裝輪胎總成及校正平衡、操作使用底盤動力計、煞車及偏滑實驗儀器。
description.en: Automobile Chassis Service Shop Practice , the basic inspection, adjustment and repair of Automobile Chassis System, Include the Automobile Suspension systems, Steering systems and Braking systems, Tire Repair and Balance practice, Wheel-Alignment practice , Chassis dynamometer Experiment , Brake performance and Slide Test .

description.zh: 實習剪切操作，延展、彎曲、平整，車身板金零件拆裝、車體板金切換、以及車身小變形矯正。
description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Cutting, Pulling, stretching, bending, and straightening, Body sheet metal parts disassembly and installation, Body panel replacement and sectioning, and Small deformation mending.

先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車電系實習，包括：引擎電系，起動系統及充電系統檢測，點火系統檢測，電池之檢測與換裝，電腦控制系統檢測，電腦診斷系統，檢測車輛新式電子設備，檢修汽車空調系統。
95學年度前入學者適用下列實習內容: 結構力學分析與實習。學生將學習使用套裝電腦應用軟體，了解並學習如何做常用的結構力學前處理、分析及後處理。 課程著重學生實作練習。
description.en:
Automobile Electrical System Service Shop Practice , Include Service of the Engine Electrical System , Starting and Charging System, Ignition System, Battery inspection and replacement, Computer Control System, Computer Diagnostic System, New Electronic Equipment Inspection , Air Condition Test and Repair.
For those students who enter the school before 2006 Fall Semester , this class is to utilize computers to do the experiments on different vehicle/engineering problems. Student will learn the basic concept of Finite Element Method (FEM), learn how to utilize FEM in Vehicle Engineering to solve problems. Classes include Geometry modeling, creating FEA models, learning different analysis types (such as Statics, Normal mode, Buckling, and Optimization).

description.en: Students will practice the following subjects: Using painting gun and paint spraying, Applying filler and sanding, Base coat, clear coat and tri-coat finishes, Full vehicle painting, and Refinishing and painting.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 計算機系統之基礎觀念介紹及應用。主要內容包括：計算機系統簡介,，資料的表示法、數字系統、邏輯，周邊裝置及儲存體，程式語言與程式設計，作業系統，檔案與資料庫。本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入進階程式語言。著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en: This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of computers, including: introduction to computer systems, data representation, number systems, and logic, peripherals and storage,  programming languages and programming, operating systems, files and database systems. This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts. Syntax and semantics of the programming language.

description.zh: 由介紹基本熱傳有關現象，配合熱力守恆有關公式之應用，討論各種熱交換環境下應考慮之因素，分析熱傳導、熱對流、熱輻射及相變熱傳之計算方法。並將要更深入地探討在各不同熱傳導系統內所可能形成之熱力分佈現象，以期學習者能以淺入深地對相關熱傳導系統工程設計上培養出最佳能力。
description.en: Introduction of basic heat transfer phenomena, using thermodynamic conservation equations to discuss the parameters under different heat exchange circumstances, heat conduction, heat convection, heat radiation and phase change are analyzed, discussion in depth on the heat transfer problems in application to cultivate heat transfer design capability.

syllabi.outline: 由介紹基本熱傳有關現象，配合熱力守恆有關公式之應用，討論各種熱交換環境下應考慮之因素，分析熱傳導、熱對流、熱輻射及相變熱傳之計算方法。並將要更深入地探討在各不同熱傳導系統內所可能形成之熱力分佈現象，以期學習者能以淺入深地對相關熱傳導系統工程設計上培養出最佳能力。

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生實務能力，學生利用整學期至各相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh: 財務報表所反映的是企業的經營績效，不同的產業有不同的特質、不同的經營環境，即使在相同的產業中，企業若採行不同的競爭策略，在財務報表上也會有不同的表現。本課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何透過財務報表，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：1) 基本財務報導與特別科目的報導與分析 2) 基本分析理論 3) 償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 5) 探討我國最近發佈的7號、34號及35號會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of this course is to help students evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes 1) financial reports and analysis of special accounting subjects; 2) basic financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

Business ethics is the intrinsic value of enterprise. It contains two parts, inside and outside enterprise. This course will introduce 
1. Ethics between employer and employee

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹企業倫理的意涵及其與一般倫理的差異，並深入探討與臺灣和國際社會相關的倫理議題和案例。透過討論問題和互動交流，學生將培養道德判斷能力和國際視野，以應對企業倫理所面臨的挑戰。

1. 導論
   - 瞭解倫理、道德、企業倫理和一般倫理的基本觀念
   - 探討企業倫理在現代社會中的重要性

2. 倫理教育與道德發展
   - 探究企業倫理教育的推行和道德發展的過程
   - 討論校園倫理教育、倫理意識、決策和判斷等相關議題

3. 倫理判斷與教學操作
   - 探討倫理判斷的教學方法和操作
   - 分析行政倫理、非政府倫理和職場倫理等相關議題

4. 企業社會責任與環境保護
   - 瞭解企業社會責任的概念和實踐
   - 探討環境保護的倫理議題和企業公民責任的重要性

5. 跨國企業的倫理挑戰
   - 分析跨國企業所面臨的倫理議題和挑戰
   - 探討永續發展和社會責任型投資的相關議題

課程結構以對應目次中的章節來進行，並在每個章節中安排相關的倫理案例和討論問題，以促進學生的學習和思考。此外，課程結尾包含選擇題和問題研討，供學生進行自我測驗和答問，以鞏固所學知識。

description.zh:
區塊鏈由比特幣為代表的1.0，經過以太坊的智能合約為代表的2.0，進入以設計超級帳本或結合物聯網、人工智慧的3.0階段。在各產業的應用也逐漸廣泛，已呈現多元研究及發展的面向，也代表產業型態將因為區塊鏈的發展而發生重大的變革。
本課程在帶領學生了解區塊鏈的核心技術、特性，以及目前在各產業的應用實例，並透過從發行數字貨幣到撰寫智能合約的商業應用，看見區塊鏈未來的發展。
description.en:
Blockchain is represented by Bitcoin 1.0, and after 2.0 represented by Ethereum's smart contracts, it enters the 3.0 stage of designing a super ledger or combining the IoT and AI. The application in various industries is gradually becoming more and more extensive, and it has presented a multi-faceted research and development orientation. It also represents that the industry type will undergo major changes due to the development of the blockchain.
This course leads students to understand the core technology and characteristics of blockchain, as well as current application examples in various industries, and sees the future development of blockchain through the commercial application from issuing digital currency to writing smart contracts.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教導學生學習如何基於系統和邏輯概念進行定量分析方法以解決管理上的問題，並進行生產與實務上的分析與決策。透過將實務問題經假設，將其轉化為的數學模式，進而優化決策品質並對資源做有效運用。課程除最佳化理論外，亦教授如何運用相關軟體解決最佳化模型求解問題。
任何一個實務問題，原則上都可以透過不同的作業研究方法轉換成一個數學問題，然而轉換的過程是否符合真實，則取決於對於方法學與實務問題的認知!實務問題在做的就是「將有限的資源做最有效的利用」，而本課程的宗旨就是透過作業研究方法達成上述之目的。解決問題的方法很多，然作業研究方法是一個有系統的求解過程。
本學期的課程主要教授最佳化方法中的線性規劃(linear Programming)以及其相關衍生之問題，亦包含Transportation problem。目標是讓學生具有將實際所面對問題，轉化為最佳化問題，寫成一數學規劃的能力；並了解球解最佳解的原理以及對結果的進一步分析的能力。本課程以教授原理為主但鼓勵學生使用相關軟體。
In this course, students will learn how to perform quantitative analysis methods based on system and logical concepts to solve management and decision-making problems usually seen in real world, especially in production and logistics. Through assumptions, practical problems are transformed into mathematical models to optimize the quality of decision-making and make effective use of resources. In addition to optimization theory, the course also teaches how to use related software to solve optimization model.
In principle, any practical problem can be converted into a mathematical problem through different OR research methods. However, whether the result is true or not depends on the knowledge of methodological and practical problems! The practical problem is to "make the most effective use of limited resources", and the purpose of this course is to achieve the above-mentioned purpose through the OR method.
In this semester, we will learn the topic of optimization including linear program and its related derivative problems, as well as transportation problems. The objective is to train students to have the capabilities to model the corresponding optimization problem after observing the real case problem; to let them know the mathematics in solving the optimization problem and the ability to further analyze the results of the optimal solutions.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 課程簡介
Week 2 線性規劃建模與圖解法/線性規劃假設
Week 3 線性規劃建模/案例計算
Week 4 講授Excel規劃求解之操作/Simplex method理論/Simplex method(Algebra Form): 以代數的方式講解球求解線性規劃問題simplex方法。 強調在觀念上對simplex方法的了解。
Week 5 Simplex method(Tabular Form): 以表格的方式講解simplex方法。 強調simplex方法的解法觀念。
Week 6 後最佳化分析/Big-M Simplex Method
Week 7 Two-Phase Simplex Method/ The Revised Simplex Method
Week 8 Sensitivity Analysis(Graphical)/ 以圖形討論如果參數波動下最佳解的波動/ The Revised Simplex Method
Week 9 期中考
Week 10 Sensitivity Analysis(Applications): 藉由參數波動下，討論最佳解的經濟意義/ The Revised Simplex Method
Week 11 Duality Theory I: 從另一對偶(Duality)的角度表達線性規劃問題。
Week 12 Duality Theory II: 從Duality的角度說明線性規劃問題所呈現在經濟層面的解釋如shadow price。
Week 13 Duality Theory III: 討論Duality與線性規劃問題在simplex方法上的對應性。
Week 14 Sensitivity Analysis I: 以Duality的觀點深入討論討論如果參數波動下最佳解的波動。
Week 15 Sensitivity Analysis II: 用更廣義的方法(Fundamental Insight)討論在參數波動下，再以量化的方式討論最佳解的波動。
Week 16 Sensitivity Analysis III: 用更廣義的方法(Fundamental Insight)討論在參數波動下，再以量化的方式討論各參數的範圍。
Week 17 Dual simplex method/ Parametric programming
Week 18 期末考

description.zh: 探討家具製造之最新技術，側重量產設備及其與產品工程的關係。介紹木材加工原理及最新量產設備之性能，以便依據家具特徵如組件形狀，材料性質，及產量多寡等考量，提出有效率的加工計畫（製造流程）。講授家具製造作業程序（從原料接受、備料、細作、裝配以迄塗裝、包裝、發貨等其間之種種細節），特別是以計量的觀點來看家具製造問題，以避免發生瓶頸，製造系統整体概念之培養，尤為重點。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. This course provides students with an understanding of the principles of wood machining processes and the capabilities of modern production woodworking equipment. Students learn to develop efficient process plans (machining sequences) based on product characteristics such as part geometry, material composition, and production volume. Emphasis is on operations, and the integration of many types of equipment into a manufacturing system. This course specially requires the students to view the manufacturing process in quantitative terms.

syllabi.outline:
1.訓練學生如何開列各種材料清單與材積計算。
2.訓練學生了解行業的加工流程與加工方法。
3.建構學生了解行業製造的結構與生產模式，增加從事行業的基礎能力。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程大綱、評量標準、分組(約5人) 與選TA及相關規定之說明並調查第一、三節休息時間之提前的表決。
第二週：按分組自行安排時間，到IKEA門市市場調查，選擇『架類』作品、並研究其他不同之K/D五金結構、拍照、蒐集資料。
第一階段 （3-7週）
1.藉由參觀、拍照、實物與目錄等資訊之田園調查，引導學生認識市場商品。
2.產品主題，是以『仿〜掛或立式 之『架』類作品。
3. K/D五金結構的認識，是『仿』的重點；是量產商品的核心。
4.組員個人需蒐集資料、照相記錄、研究分析三種以上的K/D五金結構，把個人心得列入PPT內容。※K/D五金可一樣，但照片、資料、心得不可一樣；一樣則把分數乘以相同成數除以人數。
5.透過資料收集、整理與歸納，並決定製作產品之期初PPT。
6.第六週各組組員異動截止週；主題產品製作。
7.第七週材積計算教學與應用測驗、期初PPT報告；包括分組等級考核。
第二階段 （8-12週）
1.選定類量產實例，透過結構探討、開材料單…等加工細項，來讓學生了解量產的製造流程。
2.針對木工製作實務較弱同學，透過團隊合作及補強基礎的加工能力。
3.透過定案之三視圖，開出正確之淨料、加工、毛料，三種材料單及毛料才積。	
4. 第九週期中考核PPT報告，以加工貢獻度、配合度與學習精神三方面為主；包括組長進行之等級考核。 
5.補充教材〜木材的認識、量產實例、參觀…等。 
第三階段 （13-18週）
1. 透過加工操作任務，如何讓同學生了解工廠的運作內容包括：設計製圖、企劃、生管、品管、砂磨、組立、塗裝、包裝…等措施。
2. 針對製作產品，安排所需安全的加工方式，請紀錄組員實際的照片或影片…等。
用定案三視圖為製作PPT基點，按加工流程融入內容。
3. 第十六週進行產品工件生產流程再加強：審核開列產品零件加工的生產流程
期末考核階段 
一、期末PPT報告考核：
考核內容包括定案三視圖各項料單與毛料材積各組員分配零件加工流程特色內容…等。
二、期末作品考核：
考核內容包括：尺寸精密、結構密合、完整性等項目。

description.zh: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh:
本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以 C 語言為基礎，於熟習基本
程式語法後，再導入 C++程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，
同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概
念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en:
This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts.
Syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming languages will be introduced.
Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer
solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions
of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意
本課程在應用計算方法來解決工程問題，重點將放在理解各種數值方法背後的基本概念，使用MATLAB環境來實現基本數值方法，以及利用複雜的數值方法來建構MATLAB函數。
This course is to teach you how to apply computational methodologies to solve engineering problems when no analytical solution exists. Emphasis will be placed on understanding the basic concepts behind the various numerical methods, implementing basic numerical methods using the MATLAB structured programming environment, and utilizing more sophisticated numerical methods provided as built-in MATLAB functions.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 1. 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含： (1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件， (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等， (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應， (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域， (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。 2. 瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路， (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析， (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換， (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數， (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用， (6)Laplace轉換及應用。
description.en: The course covers the synthesis and analysis of bath linear and nonlinear circuits.Contents include: 1.Introduction to linear circuit analysis, 2. Resistive circuit, 3. SPICE tool, 9.AC circuit :AC steady-state analysis, phasor analysis, 10. Three phase circuits, 11. Transformer circuits, 12. Frequency response, 13. Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

name.en: College designated dimension curriculum：Nature and Science

description.zh:
各學院指定向度學分規定如下：
機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。
電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。
工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。
管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。
設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。
人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。
修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 修完「學院指定向度課程」12學分後，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: After completing 12 credits “designated by the college”, the remaining 6 credits are open for selection form these curriculums: humanities and art, social and legal, nature and science and innovation and entrepreneurship, until a total of 18 credits of the general curriculum are completed for graduation.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include: probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹和探討管理學的基本概念、原理和應用，培養學生在組織管理領域的專業知識和技能。課程包括概論、管理和應用三個部分。概論部分涵蓋管理的意義、功能、技能和環境。管理部分深入探討規劃、策略管理、組織結構、組織行為、領導理論、溝通與激勵，以及控制與績效管理。應用部分涵蓋人力資源管理、組織變革、創新與創業精神，以及企業倫理與社會責任。教學方法包括講授、案例分析和小組討論，評估方式包括報告和考試。本課程旨在培養學生成為具備全面管理能力的優秀管理者。
This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and applications of management, cultivating students' professional knowledge and skills in the field of organizational management.The course consists of three parts: Introduction, Management, and Applications.The Introduction part covers the meaning, functions, skills, and environment of management.The Management part delves into topics such as planning, strategic management, organizational structure, organizational behavior, leadership theories, communication and motivation, as well as control and performance management.The Applications part covers human resource management, organizational change, innovation and entrepreneurship, as well as business ethics and social responsibility.Teaching methods include lectures, case analysis, and group discussions, while assessment methods include reports and exams.This course aims to cultivate students to become excellent managers with comprehensive management abilities.

description.zh: 介紹資料庫系統之基本概念，熟悉基本指令及操作方法，使之能輕易建立資料檔案，並可對其資料進行擷取、添加、刪除、修改、編輯、排序、建立索引及產生標準報表列印等，且開發一套簡易應用軟體。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts of database system. The students can understand the operation process in order to develop the data file. In addition, the retrieval, add, delete, modify, edit and sorting of data files are also provided. Finally, the students can develop a DBMS for themselves.

syllabi.outline:
資料庫管理課程旨在介紹學生資料庫的基本概念和技能，包括關聯式資料庫和非關聯式資料庫。學生將學習關聯式資料庫的特徵、關聯性和擴充性，以及與程式和非關聯式資料庫的差異。同時，他們將瞭解關聯式資料庫的架構，並學習如何避重複群和重複記錄的問題。此外，課程還將介紹非關聯式資料庫的概念和使用情境，讓學生了解其特點和適用性。這門課程將培養學生在關聯式和非關聯式資料庫管理方面的知識和技能，為他們日後在資料庫領域的工作和研究提供基礎。

The Database Management course aims to introduce students to the fundamental concepts and skills of database management, including relational and non-relational databases. Students will learn about the features, relationships, and scalability of relational databases, as well as the differences between relational databases and non-relational databases. They will also explore the architecture of relational databases and learn how to avoid issues such as duplicate groups and duplicate records. Additionally, the course will introduce the concept and use cases of non-relational databases, allowing students to understand their characteristics and applicability. This course will cultivate students' knowledge and skills in both relational and non-relational database management, providing a foundation for their future work and research in the field of databases.

description.zh: 本課程介紹如何將電化學技術應用於生物燃料電池上。生物燃料電池的觸媒主要是由酵素或是微生物甚至是生物細胞所組成，反應過程區分為電子直接轉移(mediatorless)與間接轉移(mediator)，並介紹此各種生物燃料電池的原理及應用，個別討論電池之反應過程、電池電極材料、電化學修飾電極及各種不同電池電解質溶液等個別元件。
description.en: The aim and purpose of this course is to introduce and expand the electrochemistry to develop the biofuel cells. Generally the catalysts of biofuel cell are composed by enzymes, microbial, creature cells and the bio-reduction process. In the biofuel cells the reaction process can be distinguished into mediator less and mediator transfer process. In this course, we will introduce the principle, reaction process and the application of biofuel cells. Especially, a detailed study about the utilization of film modified electrodes and different electrolyte solutions for the development of biofuel cells.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在探討如何運用科學與系統化的方式解決管理上的問題。整個過程包括：資料蒐集與問題分析、數量模式的建構、問題求解、成本效益分析、系統規劃設計與執行等步驟。課程內容主要以應用案例說明為主，讓同學瞭解理論如何與實際問題結合，也會介紹最佳化計算軟體來求解數學模式並輔助說明所得數據之意涵。
description.en: The purpose of this course is talking about how to utilize scientific and systematical approaches to solve management problems. The solution process includes data collection and problem investigation, model formulation, optimal solution derivation, cost and efficiency analysis, system implementation and execution etc. This course mainly contains various application cases. Accordingly, participant can understand how to apply theoretical methods on solving real problems. Computational software is also utilized to solve the formulated models and analyze and interpret the obtained solutions.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Python. Python is widely used not only in the engineering but also in natural science, medicine, biology, physics, and business. This course will introduce you to a vibrant and growing community of open source data analysts that is pushing the state of the art in data analysis and presentation. (Another benefit to you as students is that open source software is free!) This course’s main objective is to: learn how to take raw data, explore it, and present the results in a useful way. Thus, in this course, you will learn all of the basic skills needed to do each of these steps with the statistical language Python.

description.en: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for the efficiency of decision making in various fields. The topics are about basic concepts of data manipulations, analytic, and communications which are including: introduction to big data; basic knowledge of data mining; special topics of big data in business Analytics, and data analytic project. The course will help students careful consideration of what is desired from big data, how big data analytic to add value to business, etc. Students can gain a strong data science knowledge set and techniques via in-depth case studies, most current readings and experiences, and most current and future technology exploration.

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces the methods and applications of big data analytics.
The topics include big data management, data mining techniques, big data platforms, and project implementation and presentation.
Students are expected to learn the concepts of big data analytics techniques, and their applications and future trends in different case studies.

name.en: Principles and Practices of  Cloud Computing

description.zh: 課程介紹雲端資訊計算與運用相關技術，使學生對雲端平台、架構、服務有全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1.雲端運算發展近況及基本概念2.資源虛擬化之基本概念與技術，3.雲端運算相關技術、效能與安全，4.虛擬化資料中心建置-虛擬計算、儲存、網路與應用，6.雲端服務規劃，7.雲端之基礎設施服務、平台服務、軟體服務介紹，8.專題討論。
description.en:
Cloud Computing, either private, public or hybrid, is dramatically transforming every aspect of IT. Now it has become ubiquitous these days, and is the key foundation for developing technologies of Big Data and Internet of Things (IoT). Its deployment starts delivering applications with more benefits than the existing legacy infrastructure.

Because the terms are broadly quoted and adopted, then by this course, the Cloud Computing core technologies and the associated below will be well introduced:
1.Cloud Computing Basic Concept 
2.Resources Virtualization & Software Defined Data Center (SDDC)
3.Cloud Computing Security 
4.Cloud Technologies
5.Cloud Service Planning and Deployment 
6.Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
7.Platform as a Service (PaaS)
8.Software as a Services (SaaS)
9.Cloud Service Operations 
10.Case Studies and presentation

description.zh: 可穿戴式應用已成了全球科技產業的新寵兒之一。因此，漸漸地，穿戴式裝置已成為人們生活用品的一部分。本課程討論可穿戴式系統導論、無線感測網路導論、生醫資訊模組設計、可穿戴式教學平台之設計、情境感知遠距監控與定位救援手仗之設計、非視覺型之不穩步態偵測分析設計、自行車玩家生醫資訊守護神設計、遠距醫療照護系統設計、與客製化谷歌智慧型眼鏡設計。本課程主要達成跨領域的高度整合應用訓練課程。
description.en: Wearable applications have been become one new darling of the global technology industries. Hence, gradually, the wearable devices have become part of people's daily necessities. This course will discuss the topics of “Introduction of wearable system, Introduction of wireless sensor network, Design of Bio-information module, Design of wearable teaching platform, Design of Context-Aware Tele-monitor and Position-rescue Staff, Detection Analysis and Design for Unstable Gait with Non-vision Base, Bicycler-Player Bio-information Guardian, Design of Tele-Medicine care system, and Design of customized Google Smart-glass”. This course is highly integrated applications to achieve interdisciplinary training.

name.zh: 人工智慧在資通訊技術應用實務
name.en: Artificial Intelligence in Information and Communication Technology Applications

description.zh:
課程主要為介紹人工智慧概念和基本原理，學習DNN/CNN/LSTM的神經網路架構和學習方法，並舉資通訊技術應用實例說明，進而在雲端或非雲端平台實作人工智慧。
課程內容包括：
1.人工智慧概念和基本原理
2.DNN與深度學習
3.DNN應用實例:5G無線資源分配
4.CNN
5.LSTM 
6.LSTM應用實例: 5G極化碼解碼和Federated Learning
7.Attention神經網路
8.CNN和Attention應用實例:影片場景分段
9.學習方法:監督式，非監督式，強化學習
10.Amazon雲端平台
11.Amazon DeepLens智慧鏡頭平台
12.Amazon Alexsa智慧音箱平台
13.分組實作
description.en:
The goal of this course is to introduce ideas and principles behind artificial intelligence. We will teach the structure of DNN/CNN/LSTM neural network structure and learning methods, and implement artificial intelligence in cloud or non-cloud platforms.
 The course content includes:
1.Ideas and principles of artificial intelligence
2.DNN and deep learning
3.DNN example: 5G wireless resource allocation
4.CNN
5.RNN/LSTM
6.LSTM example: 5G Polar code decoder and Federated Learning
7.Attention neural network
8.CNN and attention example: video scene boundary detection
9.Learning methods: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement
10.Amazon cloud platform
11.Amazon DeepLens
12.Amazon Alexsa
13.Project implementation

description.zh: 由於近年來電腦科技發展迅速，在透過地理資訊系統的幫助下，圖文整合的資料庫型態，已有相當完整成熟的作業方式。本課程將針對地理資訊系統的應用功能方向，分別剖析其主要架構與理論。同時配合相關地理資訊系統軟體，建立學員整體規劃能力。
description.en: In recent years, due to the rapid development of computer technology, Geographic Information System (GIS) that integrates text and graphics has become quite mature in terms of its operational procedures. This course will focus on the application of GIS functionality and analyze its main architecture and theory. It will also use relevant GIS software to help students develop their overall planning capabilities."

syllabi.outline: 地理資訊系統（Geographical Information System，簡稱GIS）之開發與應用，即是提供各使用單位，對於大量空間資訊存取、管理、查詢、與分析的最佳解決方案。隨著網際網路的普遍，空間資訊的無界限分享，更擴充了服務內涵與其廣度。本課程學習目標在於建立學員對於空間資訊的獨立處理能力。針對在職研究學員，課程進行中，著重於實務演練，以加強對於抽象學理概念的理解。

description.en:
At the completion of this course, students will be able to several factors:
1. Compare and contrast the various forms of energy conversion.
2. Examine the technologies used to convert chemical energy into mechanical energy.
3. Apply the concepts of electrical converters.
4. Evaluate the major types of energy storage.
5. Determine how human values affect the success of energy conservation.
6. Design of new energy system modules with ecology considerations.

name.zh: 學校人力資源發展與管理
name.en: Human Resource Development and Management in Schools

description.zh: （一）瞭解學校人力資源發展與管理之定義、內涵與功能；（二）培養進行學校人力資源發展與管理之基本能力。課程內容包括：學校人力資源發展與管理之定義與內涵、人力資源管理與學校效能、學校人力資源發展之需求評估與規劃、教職員工甄選、教職員工的工作動機、教職員工專業發展、教職員工的績效評量、薪資與獎勵及創造高生產力的工作環境等。
description.en: The course aims to (1) understand the definition, essence, and function of human resources development and management in schools, (2) cultivate the fundamental capability of developing human resource development and management in schools. It covers the definition and essence of human resources development and management in schools, human resource management and effective schools, assessing and planning of human resource development in schools, selecting staffs, motivation of personnel, professional development for educational personnel, evaluating employee performance, compensation and rewards, and creating productive work environments.

syllabi.outline:
探討人力資源管理理論，並能研究創新人力資源管理理論論文成果。
課程大綱：學校人力資源管理（Teaching Materials & Syllabus）；掌握時代脈動的人力資源管理；教育產業環境變遷與人力資源管理；學校人力資源管理策略－教育產業競爭優勢之新器；教育人員招募、甄選；教育人員訓練與開發－探討他山之石分析；績效評估與管理；學校組織生涯發展、規劃與管理；國際觀的學校人力資源管理

name.zh: 教育訓練實施與績效評鑑

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: 在這門課程中，我們會介紹教育訓練實施的方法、不同績效評鑑的模型、與績效評鑑的理由。學生將得以確定績效評鑑是否需要以及何處需要評鑑，並且指出評鑑是如何對組織的總體目標以及所需的學習做出貢獻。強調理論與實務的結合，在這門課中，學生將獲得關於教育訓練實施與以及績效評鑑的概念與實際經驗。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程概述

第二週：（實施）教育訓練的方法、在職培訓方法和課堂培訓方法

第三週：（實施）講授方法、討論法和視聽媒體

第四週：（實施）電腦輔助訓練、自主學習媒體和方法，以及環境安排

第五週：（評鑑）績效評鑑的基礎

第六週：（評鑑）基於績效的評鑑原則

第七週：（評鑑）知名的績效評鑑模型概述

第八週：（評鑑）柯克帕特里克的四個評估層級

第九週：期中考週

第十週：（評鑑）菲利普斯的投資回報方法

第十一週：（評鑑）布林克霍夫的成功案例方法

第十二週：（評鑑）影響評鑑過程模型

第十三週：（評鑑）CIPP模型

第十四週：（評鑑）後設績效評鑑

第十五週：（評鑑）數據收集

第十六週：（評鑑）績效評鑑數據分析：工具和技術

第十七週：（評鑑）傳達績效評鑑結果

第十八週：期末考週

?高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
description.en:
The course is to investigate the physical phenomena of macromolecules in the solution and solid state. It includes the solution thermodynamics and chemical microstructure of polymer chains.
The solution thermodynamics is to study lattice theory, statistical thermodynamics, Flory-Huggin theory, Flory-Krigbaum theory, phase separation, θ-temperature, Osmometry, GPC, and polymer gels.
Light scattering and Neutron scattering are used to characterize the polymer microstructure. Polymer radius of gyration, freely rotating chains, excluded volume, fractal, and scaling are also discussed. Finally, spectroscopy methods are used to study polymerization models and microstructure.

description.zh: 本課程包含材料的結構鑑定和材料的性質分析。材料的結構鑑定方法有：元素分析、吸收光譜法、振動光譜法、核磁共振光譜法、質譜法、x-射線光譜法和電子顯微鏡法。材料的性質分析包含：材料熱性質(DSC, TGA, TMA,DMA)和材料機械性質(伸張、壓縮、剪力強度等)。
description.en: The materials of the course include structure identification and property analysis of materials. Methods of structure identification  of materials are : elemental analysis, absorption spectroscopy, vibration spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, x-ray spectroscopy and electron microscopy. Metheds of property analysis of materials are : thermal properties of materials (DSC,TGA,TMA,DMA) and mechanical properties of materials (tensile, compression and shear strengths).

syllabi.outline: 本課程具體介紹各式有機材分析技術。內容有紫外線/可見光光譜、螢光/磷光光譜、紅外線光譜、拉曼光譜、核磁共振儀、質譜儀、層析、熱分析、光學顯微鏡影像分析、電子顯微鏡影像分析及原子力顯微鏡等。並透過多項實驗證與闡述分析技術於各種有機材之運用，包含能源、先進材等相關領域。修習本課程的學生可系統性地建立各式有機材分析的理論架構，有助於未來研究與就業方面之發展。

description.zh: 本課程主要探討各種高分子之聚合方法及動力學之研究，如逐步聚合、遊離基連鎖聚合、乳化聚合、離子連鎖聚合、連鎖共聚合反應、開環聚合、立體規則高分子之合成，未終止的游離基聚合方法。從分子量的分佈，結構物性之關係，作高分子聚合之最佳化設計，並且探討這些聚合方法如何應用在最新的科技上，如光電材料、複合材料。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the polymer synthesis and Kinetics studies. The synthesis includes step polymerization, free radical chain polymerization, emulsion polymerization, ionic chain polymerization, chain copolymerization, ring opening polymerization, sterospecific polymerization and living free radical polymerization. The synthesis scheme is optimized with the structure-properties relationship and molecular design. The potential application of these methods in high-tech materials, such as optoelectronics, and composites, will be elucidated.

    2. The origins: urban growth from 1800 to 1940
    3. The seers: pioneer thinkers in urban planning, from        1880 to 1945
    4. The creation of the postwar planning machine, from        1940 to 1952

    6. Planning for cities and city regions from 1945 to        1990

syllabi.outline:
都市計畫是一門新興的學術，它是就特定地區有關都市生活之經濟、交通、衛生、保安、國防、文教、康樂等重要設施作有計畫的發展，並對土地使用作合理的規劃、開發與管制。其內容涵蓋建築物配置、住宅建設、土地使用分區、公共設施與交通路線規劃、開放空間管理與景觀設計、財務籌措與產業發展等。因此，都市計畫是提供一個都市長遠發展的藍圖，在時空上無論從單棟建築的興建乃至新社區、新市鎮的開發、舊市區的更新及各項公共設施的興闢，均須以都市計畫為藍本，所以都市計畫影響環境品質與居民生活福祉甚鉅。
台灣的都市計畫在觀念、作法、行政體制以及實質發展方向上已經走到了一個轉捩點，不論是政府官員、專業人員、甚至於一般百姓，都深切體會到近年來都市各種問題的日趨嚴重而必須於予檢討變革。睽諸諸如英美先進國家的都市計畫，一般皆以公共利益為依歸，而涉及地理、經濟及公共行政等重要學術領域，也為從事建築、都市計畫、景觀設計、都市設計、土木、環境規劃與管理工作者必修的學科。因此在這關鍵時刻，如何檢討國內現有都市計畫課題，並參採國外已有的制度與經驗，將理論應用在實務工作上，皆必須作有系統的介紹與評論。修讀本課程可使瞭解都市成長、問題、規劃思想、都市政策之發展、規劃體制變革歷程、戰後歐美之規劃歷程經驗、與規劃及規劃過程之理論與應用、國內外都市計畫課題、對策與發展方向。

description.zh: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。
description.en: The subject will be presented in three partsPart One - (1) Literature retrospection; (2) Fundamental planning for disaster prevention; (3) An integrated disaster prevention organization.Part Two -The major contents to be addressed include (1) Formation of urban disaster cataclysm and risk; (2) Urban disaster prevention plan and regional disaster protection system planning; (3) Principles for planning disaster prevention system in urban plan; (4) Operational standards and organization for urban disaster prevention; (5) Operational guidelines for urban disaster prevention; (6) Realization and formation of trouble free urban plan.Party Three -. The major contents are (1) Introduction; (2) rehabilitation theory; (3) Current development in Tsaotun City; (4) Establishment of damage survey method and rehabilitation procedures; (5) Detail analysis of damage survey report and preparation of rehabilitation plan content.

name.en: Traditional architecture of Taiwan in Special Topics

description.zh: 本課程為台灣傳統建築文化系列課程之一，其主旨在介紹台灣傳統建築的理論與原則，藉由已有的研究案例與成果，使同學能擴展其對台灣傳統建築研究的視界，並就傳統建築中特定建築類型與空間文化議題進行研討，除了經由地方志等文獻的解讀，以了解建築所屬的特殊空間文化意涵外，並由同學進行特定建築的實地調查，以供印證。本課程期使修課同學除了對傳統建築的意義有所瞭解外，亦對特定建築類型的社會文化意義有所體認。
description.en: This course is one of the series of Taiwan traditional architectural culture courses. Its main purpose is to introduce the theories and principles of Taiwanese traditional architecture. With the help of existing research cases and achievements, students can expand their horizons in the study of Taiwanese traditional architecture and learn from traditional architecture. Discussions on specific architectural types and spatial culture issues in architecture, in addition to reading local chronicles and other documents to understand the special spatial cultural meaning of the building, and students conduct field investigations on specific buildings for verification. This course enables students to not only understand the significance of traditional architecture, but also understand the social and cultural significance of specific architectural types.

syllabi.outline: 台灣建築就其文化特質而論，可依族群區分成南島族群文化、閩客移民族群文化及外國殖民族群文化，其內容廣泛地包括前述建築所屬的自然地理環境、社會組織、宗教信仰及象徵體系等議題。本課程即在以傳統建築領域的南島文化及閩客文化為對象進行討論，課程首先就傳統社會、傳統建築議題進行基礎理論探討。其後再以原住民社會所屬的南島建築，及閩客移民所建立的漢人建築和聚落為題，藉由建築反映的自然地理環境、產業經濟、社會組織、匠師體系等建築文化，綜合論述其文化涵構與特色。本課程目的期使修課同學除了對台灣傳統建築、空間有所認識外，亦對其所屬的社會文化意義有所體認。

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要把城市的發展置於歷史的脈絡中去研究 探討各個歷史階段的城市發展特質 其範圍涉及人類社會的各個領域 從城市的外在形式一直探討到它的內部因素 另外 本課程也探討城市文化與市民生活的品質 並論述城市的建築與空間構成 讓學生瞭解時空轉移中城市發展與需求的差異 並讓學生從城市的歷史發展中找到對付當前城市問題的方法 最後 本課程也會觸及都市重建與現代城市發展的各類議題

syllabi.outline: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。

description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh:
「研究成果具有足以影響意見和行動的力量，因此有責任感的作者會以謹慎細心的態度撰寫之」。(MLA Handbook for the Writers of Research Papers, xiv).
本課程以人文學科領域通用的MLA系統為基礎，加強學生對論文撰寫規範的認識，並經由研究過程的實踐和論文的撰寫體認學術研究的目的及價值。課程開始時學生須選擇一較為廣泛的主題，學習如何抽絲剝繭，找出核心的問題，進一步釐清研究的重點所在，然後經過仔細研究搜尋，最後以論文報告呈現成果。透過此一過程，學生將體認到學術研究有嚴謹明確的規範，需經過一步一步的印證，方能寫出合乎專業水準的研究論文或報告。
description.en:
"Because research has the power to affect opinions and actions, responsible writers compose their work with great care." (MLA Handbook for the Writers of Research Papers, xiv).
This course will define for students the rules, practices, purposes, and value of scrupulous scholarship and careful documentation in accordance with the MLA system shared by a wide community of researchers world-wide.  Beginning with the selection of a general topic, moving toward a specific research question and then researching and documenting the answer to that question will be a step-by-step process with clear guidelines resulting in the student's knowledge of how to produce a paper acceptable to scholars world-wide.

description.zh: 不同文化之間的對話需要故事的講述。了解一種文化的故事有助於人們了解這種文化並與其人民交談。有時，一種文化會借用另一種文化的故事，或者寫一個關於彼此文化碰撞的故事。(例如，關於亞洲的美國故事，或關於美國的亞洲故事)。為了幫助學生與來自其他文化的人們談論重要的思想，本課程研究跨文化共享故事以及一種文化講述其他文化的故事。
description.en: Conversation between different cultures requires the description of stories.  Knowing a culture’s stories helps one to understand that culture and talk with its people. Sometimes a culture borrows a story from another culture or writes a story about its encounter with that other culture.  (For example, American stories about Asia or Asian stories about America).  To help students talk about important ideas with people from other cultures, this course examines stories shared across cultures and stories one culture tells about another.

Topics include (but not limited to) staffing, training and development, performance appraisal, compensation, organization design, leadership, work motivation, workgroup functioning. Implications for managerial practice will be discussed in this class.

description.en: The course mainly discusses concepts of business research methods. The contents will include following topics：（1）the nature of business research, （2）elements of research and research process, （3）research problem and hypothesis,（4）literature review, （5）research design, （6）research proposal, （7）case study, （8）analysis and the interpretation of data, （9）quantitative and qualitative research,(10) research report.

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces the methods essential to business research. The first focus is on research methods, particularly applied quantitative statistical analysis—interpreting results, as well as applying them to actual data. Students should become informed consumers of statistics—to be able to understand and assess the quality of statistical methods in the papers they read, and to use those methods in their research. The second focus is on research design and data collection methods, which will be essential to master’s dissertation, and practical business roles (such as consultant or market researcher). Students will participate in a project in which they have the chance to collect and analyze their data.

The course is on fundamentals, up to multiple regression, so we will not have time to discuss more advanced statistical techniques. However, you should leave this class with a solid foundation for further education on these topics.

description.zh: 永續發展是妥善規劃與管理自然資源之最高指導原則，因此本課程﹙一﹚依此宗旨討論水資源保育、固廢管理與空氣污染控制；更將以實際例將面向擴及科技與社經整合層次，以期落實理論於實際應用之中。

It must be technologic, economic and social environmental change or a new factural data are developed

syllabi.outline:
學生將會學習從較宏觀的視野來認識屬於人文與社會層面的環境管理。課程將會透過系統思考及永續創新的角度，來反思地球的現在與未來；闡述新經濟時代的來臨與綠色資本主義的重要性及其四種策略，來緩解氣候變遷及全球暖化的趨勢，創造企業競爭優勢，並開創人類永續發展的新契機。
Students will be guided from a broader and global perspective to learn the social and human aspects of protecting the Earth. Lectures will cover systems thinking and its importance to Sustainable Development, Innovation and emerging technologies for sustainability, Natural Capitalism, its strategies, and Circular Economy.

syllabi.outline: 教學大綱:簡介作業研究Systems Analysis中的各式優選工具，並學習混沌理論。以生態族群的Growth and Decay模式為例，初窺混沌世界的奇妙，以提供往後解決問題時有不同的思考方向。混沌理論應用在物理、經濟、生物、數學的領域上，處理數百年來許多無法看透的問題有不錯進展(包括紊流現象)，在環境領域上的應用則尚待開拓。只要處理的系統(問題)具有自我相似性，以混沌來處理是可行的。(課程中將視時間教進階數學軟體Mathematica.)  Explore Chaos Theory from the Models of Growth and Decay (Simple Logistic Model, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration).  Introduce important factors of Chaotic Behavior: Dynamics of species, Critical Reproduction Rate, Bifurcation, Butterfly effect.  Examples of Chaotic behavior: Single Species System, Two Species Competition System, Two Species Predator-Prey System.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋嵌入式工業視覺系統完整的開發內容，從機器視覺系統流程與演算法設計、嵌入式系統實作、函式庫封裝、人機介面設計、工業相機取像及實際案例分析。其中包含: 1. 嵌入式系統軟體實作：Linux 環境介紹與基本程式設計 2. Qt 人機介面開發 3. 工業用機器視覺演算法/系統開發，並提供相關設計概念 4. 實際應用案例與設計流程介紹。學生需要先有C/C++程式語言及影像處理之基礎。
description.en: The goal of this course is to learn the basic tools and techniques required to implement Machine Vision on small, embedded, portable platforms. The primary focus will be on the design of industrial vision system based on specialized embedded hardware, with a little less focus on machine vision algorithm. The course will involve: (1) Linux embedded software development; (2) Qt GUI development; (3) development of embedded industrial machine vision algorithm; (4) application practice on the embedded platform, with an industrial camera, to demonstrate real time vision processing. The only pre-requisite for the course is to know C/C++ and image processing.

description.zh: 本課程說明如何利用質量及動量守恆建立可以描述速度、應力及壓力等流體系統物理量間關係之統制方程式。其內容包括：線及角動量守衡、應力張量、平滑近似理論、非穩態流動、邊界層近似法、線性穩定度理論及紊流系統。
description.en:
We will learn how fundamental principles such as conservation of mass and momentum lead to equations that govern or describe the interrelationships of velocity, stress, pressure, and so on. Content includes macroscopic balance for linear and angular momentum, the stress tensor, 
lubrication approximation, unsteady flow、the boundary layer approximation, linear stability theory, and turbulent flows.

syllabi.outline: This course surveys the principal concepts of fluid dynamics. Topics include mass and momentum conservation, the Navier-Stokes equation for viscous flows, as well as dimensional analysis. Emphasis is placed on being able to utilize the concepts to solve the real problems encountered during conducting research

description.zh: 反應工程是在商業規模之考慮下對化學反應開發利用之相關工程活動。其目的在成功的設計和操作化學反應器，並使化學工程在工程專業中成為一個獨特的支系。此高等反應工程是延續大學部己學習在均相中有關之簡單觀念及理論，並推展到非均相較複雜系統之設計及操作上。學生在修習此課後，對於較複雜之反應器有清晰及整體之概念。
description.en: Under commercial scale consideration, chemical reaction engineering is that engineering concerning the exploitiaton of chemical reactions Its goal is the successful design and operation of chemical reactors and it sets chemical engineering apart as a distinct branch of the engineering profession. This aduanced chemical reaction engineering is a continuative study of simple idea and principle for homogeneous systems and extended to heterogeneous and more complex systems for design and operation. After study in this course, the student can obtain clear and unified coucept of complex reactor systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於使學生瞭解化學反應工程之原理以及訓練學生能夠應用此些原理於設計，分析或操作化學反應器。此課程首先複習大學部已學習在均相中動力學之基礎理論，再推廣至非均相較複雜之系統。

In this course, a structure is developed that allows the student to solve reaction engineering problems through reasoning rather than through memorization and recall of numerous equations, restrictions and conditions under which each equation applies. A special emphasis on bioreaction engineering and more industrial chemistry with real reactors and real reactions will be covered and wide range of applications to which chemical reaction engineering principles will be applied.

description.zh: 為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，國家特制定著作權法；本課程重心在於介紹我國著作權法之內涵，包含該法所保護之「著作」範圍、權利人及著作權範圍、著作權管理及權利侵害之救濟等，除講授理論外，同時搭配案例解析，以期讓同學對著作權法有最完整之了解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. This course introduces the main meanings, concepts and contents of the Copyright Law. Including the scope for copyright protection, the kinds of works that qualify for copyright protection, the rights granted to copyright owners, the management of copyright, and remedies for right infringement. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

syllabi.outline: 本專題研究除重點分析著作權法基礎之重要課題外，亦將以引導、啟發、共同討論及邀請專業講座的方式，深入探討從AI科技發展之生成、創作、可能濫用，以及其在NFT藝術品交易、Metaverse數位創作、ChatGPT侵權等爭議。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學需求進行調整。

第2-17週：將以學理分析及比較法制觀點，探討下列主題或案例：

1. 著作人格權（姓名表示權、禁止醜化權、公開發表權等）

2. 著作財產權（依侵權行為類型，暫定5個主題）
(1) 重製權、改作權
(2) 傳輸權、散布權
(3) 鄰接權、製版權
(4) 著作合理使用的判斷基準(含轉化性理論)
(5) (大數據分析) 資料庫

3. 探討以AI運作相關的著作權專題
(1) AI訓練之機器學習、深度學習等
(2) AI如何生成？是否應予保護？ 
(3) AI創作過程及銷售是否可能侵權？其之權利如何歸屬及保護？
(4) AI深度偽造的法律問題
(5) NFT藝術品交易之爭議
(6) Metaverse數位創作之爭議
(7) ChatGPT侵權爭議

※各單元主題分析或案例討論，將配合進度及時事或修法等，適時邀請實務專家協同教學。

name.zh: 數位匯流與智財法律專題
name.en: Intellectual Property Laws in the Age of Digital Convergence

description.zh: 在數位匯流的趨勢下，網際網路不但即將成為各種傳統媒體的聚集之處，同時也不斷衍生新型態的媒體傳播方式。有鑑於此，本課程目的即在探討數位匯流時代的智財法律議題。將由實際案例為主，輔以相關分析文章及法律規定的解析，帶領同學了解數位環境的特性、數位媒體形式與媒體內容的發展，同時針對著作權、隱私權等實用智慧財產權議題，讓同學了解、並具備分析數位時代的媒體趨勢、以及智財法律策略的能力。
description.en: In the face of digital convergence, the internet seems will not only become the ultimate channel for all kinds of traditional media, but the birthplace of new types. In light of the challenges posed by the digital age, this course is aimed at helping students explore the IP legal issues with reference to the media evolution on the internet. It will begin with the introduction of the characteristics of the internet, the developments of the digital media formation and content, and followed by the discussions and analysis on the cases in the real life.

description.zh: 本課程重點在於台灣專利法的主要法律議題，包括產業利用性、新穎性、進步性、可實施性、說明書支持性、請求項不明確性、請求項解釋、侵權行為、救濟手段、專利授權、強制授權、專利訴訟之展開和舉發。本課程教材包括專利法教科書、智慧局頒發的專利審查基準和智慧財產法院裁判。
description.en: This course focuses on the main legal issues of the Taiwan Patent Law including industrial utility, novelty, inventive step, enablement, written description, claim indefiniteness, claim interpretation, infringement, remedies, patent licensing, compulsory licensing, initiation of patent litigation, and opposition. The class materials include a patent law textbook, patent examination guidelines issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office and recent decisions from the Taiwan Intellectual Property Court.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程內容：本課程係碩士一年級的基礎課程，係對專利法制的一般性、綜觀(巨觀)性介紹；其主要內容：包括我國的專利法制、其他國家的重要專利理論與學說。
二、教學目標：期使同學於期末，能對現今專利法制的重要觀念與趨勢，能有普遍性的認識與瞭解。
三、授課對象，主要為本所一年級的同學，其他系所同學，亦歡迎選修本課程。
四、注意事項：修習本課程的同學，前半學期為專利基礎知識的介紹，而於期中後，則須於上課前閱讀指定教材，並參與課程中的討論與回答問題，期末則需完成一篇期末報告。

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或理論論文寫作之能力。研究方法一強調量化研究，課程內容包含研究的基本概念、文獻探討、研究問題、研究變項、研究假設、研究設計、資料蒐集與分析、研究工具、研究樣本、研究倫理與研究論文撰寫等。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and pr92tical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This research methods one focus on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis, research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The te92hing methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

The te92hing methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, inter92tive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and pr92tice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation.

description.zh:
本課程主要的概念於利用設計思考以使用者導向之設計方法，將使用者需求作為設計提案及解決方案的啟始點，並整合分析設計對象、使用者所遭遇的問題、如何提高性能及實現可擴展性等問題。透過資料科學與工具的整合應用，導引資料分析人員與設計專業人員進行跨領域的整合，以建構未來設計創新的機會與願景。
課程的主要目標是：1.建構以用戶為導向之人本設計重要設計流程。2.使用高品質的數據，可以創建設計工件，滿足真實使用者的需求。3.鼓勵學生在互動設計領域中，整合兩者的優勢，建構未來的設計優勢和機會。4.最重要的目標是確保使用者體驗人本設計的品質。
description.en:
"The IxD uses their sensibility and methods to match users' need in a way that is technologically feasible and viable enough to generate user value and tap market opportunity. The idea is, design thinking puts user and their needs as the starting point of developing new product and solution and ask questions like for whom are we designing, what is the problem user is experiencing, how to improve the performance and achieve scalability, among others.
The main objectives of this course provide:
1. Creating a vital user-centered design process.
2. Work with the high-quality data, design artifacts can be created, addressing the needs of the real user.
3. Encourage student to mix these two together in IxD to reap design benefits and opportunities.
4. The most important objective is to ensure the quality of user-centricity of user experience.

syllabi.outline:
使用者導向之設計已成為大多數互動設計的依循主軸。他翻轉了以產品為導向的傳統，強調以使用者的偏好引領設計的價值。而這就是設計思考的方法導入互動設計中，利用其敏感性和方法，透過可行及可用的技術滿足使用者的需求，從而產生使用者價值並發展市場機會。研究建議，由世界級的設計公司IDEO所主導，設計思考與決策科學相結合，觸發了同理心設計與工程技術的融合。這不僅可以確保提出兼容實際性和創造性地問題解決方案外，而且在設計的開始便融入使用者導向的設計概念，將有助於創新設計與解決方案的提出。同時，在設計的初始階段導入資料應用與分析的方法，更能在設計中正確的整合敏感性，技術可行性，商轉可行性和使用者的需求。
本課程主要的概念在於利用設計思考以使用者導向之設計方法，將使用者及其需求作為設計提案以及解決方案的啟始點，並整合分析設計對象，使用者所遭遇的問題，以及如何提高性能以及實現可擴展性等問題。並透過資料科學與工具的整合應用，導引資料分析人員與設計專業人員進行跨領域的整合，以建構未來設計創新的機會與願景。
本課程主要是希望能連結科技與設計人才，做跨領域的學習。本課程的核心主軸，將利用史丹佛大學d.School所提出設計思考的方法，針對資料科學的關鍵知識進行跨領域的盤點、整理與設計，以創造其具人本設計(Human-Centered Design)的創新價值。
本課程將採用專案/問題導向(Project/Problem-Based Learning)的學習與互動模式。因為是跨系選修的課程，將於課堂上組成跨領域的學習團隊，鼓勵跨領域的學生從不同的情境模式，連結「資料探勘」之核心課程。「類神經網路」與「深度學習」的進階課程，及「語音辨識與人機互動」的應用課程等相關內容。並同時應用於探討資料科學有關資料蒐集、建構、過濾、品質驗證、分類處理、模式應用、資料視覺化處理、及分析敘事的核心知識。並於課程操作過程中，透過「資料導向敘事(Data-Driven Storytelling)」的方法，呈現跨領域創新學習的成果。

description.zh: 互動設計可視為三大傳統設計領域：平面設計、工業設計，與建築設計的延伸。在許許多多延伸出來的新設計領域如 UI、UX、響應式網頁、互動產品、智慧空間等等，圖像依舊是所有設計在發想、討論，與實現設計上所仰賴的根本工具。本課程以圖像為設計語言的架構下，介紹由圖像所發展出來的數位生產線，以模組技術介紹互動設計在設計發想、原型製作，以至到設計討論與提案所需要之圖像技術，並鼓勵學生以一設計提案來總結課堂之所學。
description.en: Interaction design can be considered as an extension of the long-established fields of architectural, industrial, and graphical design. Regardless what types of the recent emerging field of interaction design such as UI, UX, responsive website, tangible interaction design, or smart environment, the image remains as the visual language for design ideation to realization. This course introduces the concept of digital pipeline which is mediated on wide range of image related digital technologies. Through those modularized technologies, we can form a working pipeline to create a prototype for an interaction design proposal.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹使用者經驗設計之理論與研究方法。藉由本課程的學習，學生能習得互動設計過程中所需要之關鍵概念 - 以使用者經驗為中心之設計。課程以人-機-境之架構為基礎進行相關知識之講授，並透過相關研究案例之研討、方法之操作以及設計研究之進行了解其原理。課程內容包含人物誌、使用者經驗與需求、互動環境、使用者研究以及認知心理基礎等。教學將以課堂講授、文獻閱讀以及研究方法操作等方式進行，並以報告繳交、分組討論與發表為評量方式。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theories and research methods of User Experience Design (UXD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UX, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory, and executed through research case studies, method simulation and design research. The contents include personas, user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, user research and cognitive psychology. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, literature review and research conducting. Students are evaluated by reports, group discussion and presentation.

This course is focused on introducing the theories, application and research of User-Centered Design (UCD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UCD, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory and case study. The contents include user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, usability design and evaluation, user-centered product design and development, design psychology and universal design. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, professional seminar and case study, and evaluated by students' reports, group discussion and presentation.

name.en: Interactive Installation and Performing Arts Technology

description.zh: 本課程介紹整合即時影像、即時音訊、實體裝置、及相關表演科技（如燈光控制、各類感應器應用等）之技術與應用實務，並藉由圖形化、物件導向程式設計系統，引導未有程式設計經驗的視覺設計者或輔助已有程式設計能力者，以更有效率的方式進行相關互動系統設計，藉以達成互動裝置、表演科技、與表演藝術之整合。
description.en: This course introduces the technology that help integrates real-time video, audio, installations, and associated performance arts technology (such as lighting control, the application of various types of sensors, etc.) into performing arts. Through a graphical, object-oriented programming system, the course is intended to help visual designers with no programming experiences or to assist experienced programmers to efficiently design the interactive systems that combine interactive installations, performance arts technology, and performing arts itself as a whole.

description.zh: 本課程討論了大資料的概念和原理以及如何在企業中使用大資料。本課程提供了一個大資料分析的基本原則的概述，以及大資料分析在機構作出更好的決策和預測的作用。該課程還涵蓋了技術、基礎設施和大資料應用，以及資料識別、資料清洗和資料集成的概念。還提出了大資料的軟體和應用需求，還對大資料應用的案例研究進行了討論。先修課程：INSY5337資料庫和商業智能、INSY5325高級統計方法。
description.en: This course addresses the concepts and principles of Big Data and how Big Data can be used in the Enterprise. The course provides an overview of the fundamental principles of Big Data Analytics and its role in making better decisions and predictions in the organization. The course also covers the Technology, Infrastructure and Applications of Big Data. Concepts of data identification, data cleansing and integration are also addressed. Software and Application requirements of Big Data are addressed and case studies of Big Data Applications are discussed. Prerequisite: INSY 5337 (DATA WAREHOUSING AND BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE) and BSTAT 5325 (ADVANCED STATISTICAL METHODS).

description.zh:
戰略管理使用綜合管理視角去解決相關的制定和實施企業和企業級戰略的問題。
該課程包括開發識別問題的能力，評估戰略選擇，並瞭解戰略的形成和執行的組織過程。它建立在功能區課程所獲得的知識，並使用案例研究和項目，以提高學生的分析和決策能力。前提：必須參與上學期的課程或與得到研究生導師的許可。
description.en: Strategic management uses a general management perspective in addressing issues related to the formulation and implementation of corporate and business level strategy. The course involves developing the ability to identify issues, evaluate strategic options and understand the organizational process by which strategies get formed and executed. It builds on the knowledge gained in functional area courses and uses case studies and projects to improve students' analytical and decision-making skills. Prerequisite: Must be taken in last semester or with permission of the Graduate Advisor.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於建構產業分析之思維架構及洞悉市場發展之研究能力，以因應市場之快速變遷,並介紹學生瞭解總體經濟與產業景氣分析,公司經營財務報表分析,投資標的評價與技術分析。透過研究方法之介紹及預測手法之教導並輔以個案實作以達其效。
description.en: The objective of the course is to construct the infrastructure of industry analysis and to build up the research capability for changing market development. The fundamental analysis of macro economy and business cycle, financial statement analysis and investment valuation methods are also studied. By introducing the methodologies and forecasting tools, the case study is implied in this class.

syllabi.outline: 本課程目的在於協助學員學習不同型態的產業分析工具與方法，以培養學員務實致用的產業分析技能，以具備帶領企業分析所處產業之短/中長期未來發展趨勢，並據此分析結果提出產業/企業發展的策略方案。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週次：課程內容簡介
第2~3週次：產業分析方法
  資料蒐集與解析、
  市場分析與預測、
  商業效益分析、
  策略管理與競合策略、
  目標市場策略運用
第4~6週次：產業分析途徑
  SCP模型、
  SWOT分析、
  BCG模式、
  五力分析、
  GE模式、
  鑽石模型理論、
  產業結構與競爭分析、
  產業群聚分析
第7~8週次：產業實務
  傳統產業、高科技產業、從5+2到六大核心產業
第9週次：產業分析報告

description.zh:
聯合國全球契約(UN Global Compact)於 2004 年首次提出ESG 的概念，由環境(environment)、社會(social)、公司治理(corporate governancer)評估一家企業的永續(sustainability)發展指標，提出如何實踐 CSR 的原則。2008 年全球金融海嘯爆發時，更獲得關注。ESG 為衡量一家企業經營的績效指標，亦即市場參照的投資標準。因此，注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。
本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。
description.en:
The UN Global Compact first proposed the concept of ESG in 2004. The environment, social, and corporate governance assess the sustainability development indicators of a corporation and propose how to practice CSR. When the global financial tsunami broke out in 2008, ESG gained more attention. ESG is a performance indicator that measures the operation of an enterprise, that is, the investment standard referenced by the market. Therefore, ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being.
This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability,

本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。
The UN Global Compact first proposed the concept of ESG in 2004. The environment, social, and corporate governance assess the sustainability development indicators of a corporation and propose how to practice CSR. When the global financial tsunami broke out in 2008, ESG gained more attention. ESG is a performance indicator that measures the operation of an enterprise, that is, the investment standard referenced by the market. Therefore, ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being.
This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability,

name.zh: 全球組織經營策略暨領導決策
name.en: Global Organization's Management Strategies and Leadership Decision

description.zh: 本課程專注在探討全球組織經營策略與領導決策之關鍵議題，聚焦在不同時空的國際經營環境中，企業經營者如何因應政府的政策與財經情勢改變，能夠快速回應與彈性應變的領導思維與決策。透過本課程將能夠理解高階主管面對政經環境的調整能有效因應變化，並且提升領導才能與創造市場優勢之創新能力。
description.en: The course focuses investigate the global organization's management strategies and leadership decision of the key issues. It is focusing in the different time frames and fierce international environment, how changes in policy of governments and situation of economic. Business executives will be able to quick to respond with the elastic strain of the global strategy perspective and leadership thinking. This course will be able to understand top managers can achieve the decision making of leadership, and improve the leadership knowledge and innovation capabilities in market competition.

syllabi.outline: 有句名言闡述企業經營的全貌，「唯一不變的，就是變」。 在快速競爭的時代，企業經營所面臨的課題無論在政治、經濟、企業經營以及環境議題各個層都面臨劇烈的挑戰。透過本課程能夠帶給學生時時更新的管理知識以及企業策略的思維，輔以全球以及臺灣本土的個案，讓學生能夠對照不同思維的管理模式。相信對企業管理能夠有更新的視野以及感受。

syllabi.outline:
本課程專注在探討全球組織經營策略與領導決策之關鍵議題，聚焦在不同時空的國際經營環境中，企業經營者如何因應政府的政策與財經情勢改變，能夠快速回應與彈性應變的領導思維與決策。透過本課程將能夠理解高階主管面對政經環境的調整能有效因應變化，並且提升領導才能與創造市場優勢之創新能力。
The course focuses investigate the global organization's management strategies and leadership decision of the key issues. It is focusing in the different time frames and fierce international environment, how changes in policy of governments and situation of economic. Business executives will be able to quick to respond with the elastic strain of the global strategy perspective and leadership thinking. This course will be able to understand top managers can achieve the decision making of leadership, and improve the leadership knowledge and innovation capabilities in market competition.

Topics include (but not limited to) staffing, training and development, performance appraisal, compensation, organization design, leadership, work motivation, workgroup functioning. Implications for managerial practice will be discussed in this class.

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
國文，是運用本國語言文字，蘊釀於欣賞文藝作品，充實文化內涵，增進思維能力與人文素養的一門課程。
本課程分為大一上學期2學分，大一下學期2學分。大一上學期的授課內容，以文學名篇為範圍；希望藉此擴建學生深入品味文學趣味的能力，鍛鍊靈活的語文敏感度，默契文學創意，甚而嘗試創作。大一下學期的授課內容，以思想名篇為範圍；希望藉此啟發學生透轍分析各家學說思想，漫步哲人的宇宙天地，跟隨哲人的心路歷程，進而念茲在茲，從容內化，共饗取之不盡用之不竭的先驗與風範。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法
２.布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯   及邏輯閘
３.布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法
４.組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路
５.可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法
６.正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性
７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法 
８.遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法
９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含：
１.數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法
２.布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯   及邏輯閘
３.布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法
４.組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路
５.可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法
６.正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性
７.同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與   設計之方法
８.遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法
９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

name.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages.

description.zh: 瞭解程式語言的基本結構，並以C語言為主要實習對象，其內容包含：1. 程式語言簡介：介紹各種程式語言及其特性，並對C語言之發展沿革架構及持點詳加討論，2. 資料型態：介紹C語言之資料型態及各種運算子，3. 基本輸入：介紹各種輸出入函數及輸出入實習，4. 流程控制：介紹指定指述，選擇敘述及迴圈敘述，並做實習，5. 前置處理：介紹前置處理觀念及程式實作，6. 函式：介紹主副程式及實作，7. 陣列與字串：介紹各種陣列之特性及字串與陣列之關係，並做實習，8. 結構型態：介紹結構，列舉及同位資料型態及應用實習，9. 指標：介紹指標之觀念及應用實習，10. 位元運算：介紹位元運算及應用實習，11. 檔案處理：各種檔案之介紹及檔案輸出入函數，12. 鍵盤與游標控制：介紹鍵盤、游標之控制及字元之特性，並作相關實習，13. 繪圖與音樂：介紹文字模式及繪圖模式函數，並作實習，14. C語言與物件導向：介紹C++與物件導向之關係，及物件與類別之基本定義，並作相關實習。
description.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages. C language is used for the practice. The course includes: 1. Introduction to programming languages: introduce various programming languages as well as their properties and discuss the history, the structure and advantages of C language. 2. Data types: introduce the data types and operators of C language. 3. Basic Input and Output: introduce various input and output functions and work on their practices. 4. Processes Control: introduce assignments, select statements and loop statements and work on their practices. 5. Preprocess: introduce the concept of the preprocess and work on the programming practice. 6. Functions: introduce the main program and subroutines. 7. Array and strings: introduce the properties of various arrays as well as the relations between strings and arrays and work on their practices. 8. Structure data types: introduce structure data types and work on the practices. 9. Pointers: introduce the concept of pointe

description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.
