description.zh: 隨著人類對於工程技術的省思，以及環境倫理的變遷，兼顧生態、安全、景觀等面向生態工法逐漸受到重視。我國自2002年起，全力推動生態工法的落實及應用上的困難。有鑑於此，特開立「生態工法概論」，建立全盤性的了解，使土木工程能迎合時代的需求，提升相關智識水準。因此，將分別就基本精神、案例、應用範疇等議題進行探討。
description.en: This is intended as brief introduction to the subject of Ecological Engineering Methods(EEM), which is a whole new concept in the field of civil engineering. The Advantages of EEM is not only to satisfy the demand of safety(i.e. natural hazards control)but also that of protecting ecosystem and landscape aesthetic. In 2002, related government agencies try to pormote the application of EEM , and attempt to adopt this specific measure. However, the lack of basic understanding and knowledge has been the main reason why engineers are struggling in introducing EEM into reality. Therefore, including fundamental theories, cases study, and practical apects of application will be taught in this course. The optimal goal is to inspire students to learn more about new philosopgy and techniques in the world of civil engineering.

syllabi.outline:
隨著人類對於工程技術的省思，以及環境倫理的變遷，兼顧生態、安全、景觀等面向生態工法逐漸受到重視。我國自2002年起，全力推動生態工法的落實及應用上的困難。有鑑於此，特開立「生態工法概論」，建立全盤性的了解，使土木工程能迎合時代的需求，提升相關智識水準。因此，將分別就基本精神、案例、應用範疇等議題進行探討。
This is intended as brief introduction to the subject of Ecological Engineering Methods (EEM), which is a whole new concept in the field of civil engineering. The Advantages of EEM is not only to satisfy the demand of safety (i.e. natural hazards control) but also that of protecting ecosystem and landscape aesthetic. In 2002, related government agencies try to promote the application of EEM , and attempt to adopt this specific measure. However, the lack of basic understanding and knowledge has been the main reason why engineers are struggling in introducing EEM into reality. Therefore, including fundamental theories, cases study, and practical aspects of application will be taught in this course. The optimal goal is to inspire students to learn more about new philosophy and techniques in the world of civil engineering.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在於提供方法，用來分析任何型式的結構物受任意動荷重所產生的應力與變化。
description.en: The primary purpose of this course is to present methods for analyzing the stresses and deflections developed in any given type of structure whenit is subjected to an arbitary dynamic loading.

syllabi.outline: This course will cover the theory of structural response to dynamic loads. Students will learn to mathematically describe the response of SDOF systems with and without damping to free vibration, harmonic, and arbitrary excitations. Students will learn to compute the dynamic response of structural components (like beams, walls, and columns) and structural systems under dynamic loads such as blast and earthquake excitations. Lumped and distributed mass systems including modal analysis of MDOF systems will be covered. Moreover, the fundamentals of spectrum analysis and its application in earthquake engineering are also covered to provide the student an insight into the benefit from dynamic analysis.
syllabi.schedule:
(1) 結構動力學簡介 (Introduction)
(2) 自由振動分析 (Free vibration analysis)
(3) 受到諧和載重之反應分析 (Response to harmonic loading)
(4) 受到週期載重之反應分析 (Response to periodic loading)
(5) 受到衝擊載重之反應分析 (Response to impulsive loading)
(6) 受到一般載重之反應分析(疊加法) Response to arbitrary loading - Duhamel integral
(7) 受到一般載重之反應分析(逐步積分法) Response to arbitrary loading - step-by-step integration method
(8) 反應譜 (Response spectra)
(9) 反應譜在耐震設計之應用 (Application of response spectra)
(10) 廣義單自由度系統 (Generalized single degree of freedom system)
(11) 多自由度系統之運動方程式 (Equations of motion for MDOF system)
(12) 多自由度系統之結構特性矩陣 (Formulations of structural matrices for MDOF system)
(13) 多自由度系統自由振動分析 (Free vibration analysis for MDOF system)
(14) 多自由度系統之振態疊加法 (Modal superposition method)

description.zh: 為增進本校工程相關科系學生之基礎數學能力，本課程希望在18小時中，能使學生對基礎數學有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分之數學基礎。課程內容包括：1. 數與式、2. 不等式、3. 直角坐標系、4. 直線、5. 圓錐曲線、6. 指數與對數、7. 三角函數、8. 向量。
description.en: With the purpose for improving the comprehension in fundamental mathematics for students who major in Engineering, and for building up solid background of Calculus for students' future training, it is planned to have this course. This 18 hours course aims at developing comprehension of basic mathematics、activating capabilities of Logic、strengthening the abilities of computing with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1. Numbers、Functions and Equations, 2. Inequalities, 3. Rectangular Coordinates, 4. Lines, 5. Quadratic Equations, 6. Exponents and Logarithms, 7. Trigonometric Functions , 8. Vectors.

10.	Those who earn 60 points and higher, but lower than 70 points, on the semester final grade and who are present in class for 10 or more class sessions are eligible for the make-up exam held on week 18 during class time (or at a time otherwise announced by the instructor). The make-up exam session will only be held once.

11.	The make-up exam score will be counted as 70% of the original score if it exceeds 70, but it will remain as it was when it is below 70. And the semester final grade for those who take the make-up exam will be 70 at most even if it exceeds 70 after make-up exam score is taken into account.

12.	Those who missed their exam(s) due to official absences will receive their original score instead of 70% on make-up exams after presenting the school absence note to the class teacher.

13.	Those who qualify for a make-up exam, but do not show up on time, will be considered as having been given the opportunity to take the make-up exam and their final grade will be their original grade.

description.zh: 科學視算指的是將大量的運算資料、監測結果或實驗數據，結合電腦繪圖以視覺化的方式呈現出來，幫助研究者進一步瞭解大量數據背後所代表的工程意義，在本課程中將介紹科學視算的原理，教導所使用的軟體工具和繪圖函式庫，讓學生有機會瞭解科學視算在土木工程上的應用，並以案例介紹科學視算的用途，如結構物的地震振動反應、震波在地層中的傳遞狀況、地形特徵和GPS資料的視覺化模擬、以及板塊運動的模擬情形等。本課程先修課程為程式設計，並且最好具備有限元素法的概念，建議研究所同學選修。
description.en: Scientific visualization is the use of computer graphics to visually represent the composite meaning of the large amount of data obtained by scientific computation, extensive monitoring, or engineering experiments. It could help researchers quickly grasp the engineering implications in their field of interest. This course will introduce the basic theory of scientific visualization, teach the relevant programming skills, and demonstrate how to apply the principles of scientific visualization to civil engineering problems. Examples include the seismic response of engineering structures, the propagation of seismic waves in the ground, and the movement of tectonic plates. The prerequisite of this course is computer programming. It is suitable for graduate students to choose as an elective.

syllabi.outline:
This course covers the theory and practice of scientific visualization, which is the graphical process of creating effective visual representations of 2D and 3D scientific data sets. The course will teach students the techniques and tools for generating, manipulating, analyzing and displaying various types of data, such as scalar fields, vector fields, and images. The course will also introduce some topics related to machine learning and graphical processing unit (GPU). 

By the end of this course, students should be able to:

1. Apply appropriate visualization techniques for different types of data 
2. Use existing visualization software packages and libraries, including Python Matplotlib and Matlab.
3. Describe the current technical relationship between GPU, image processing, and machine learning.

name.en: Introduction to Theory and Applications in Wind Engineering

description.zh: 風工程是一個跨領域的學科，屬於研究所課程，適合已有良好工程力學以及流體力學基礎的學生選修。然而為了推廣我國工程師及土木系大學生了解此門學問，本課程設計為大四及研究所學生選修的先導型課程。本課程內容涵蓋大氣邊界層、鈍體空氣動力學以及空氣彈力學的基礎知識，進而闡述建築物耐風設計以及橋梁耐風設計的概念，配合我國以及國際上常用之耐風設計規範作為解說及練習，輔助學生對於風工程有一定的認識。其他如空氣污染擴散、通風節能減熱、計算流體力學應用等與風相關的主題，亦在本課程提出概略性的介紹以及發展現況。
description.en: Wind Engineering is a cross-disciplinary subject that belongs to the institute course and is suitable for students who have a good background in engineering mechanics and fluid mechanics. However, in order to promote the knowledge of Wind Engineering to engineers and civil engineering students, this course is designed as the precursor courses selected by seniors and graduate students. This course covers the basic knowledge of atmospheric boundary layer, bluff body aerodynamics and air-elasticity, and then expounds the wind-resistant design of buildings and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. It is used as an explanation and practice with the wind-resistant design codes commonly used internationally. Students have a certain understanding of wind engineering. Other wind-related topics such as air pollution diffusion, ventilation energy conservation and heat reduction, computational fluid dynamics applications, etc., also provide a brief introduction and development status in

syllabi.outline: This course is designed as the precursor course selected by seniors and graduate students. It covers the basic knowledge of the atmospheric boundary layer, bluff-body aerodynamics, aero-elasticity, the wind-resistant design of buildings, and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. National and international wind codes for buildings and bridges are introduced with practices based on wind tunnel test data. Other related wind issues are also conceptually introduced in this course.

description.en: This course will provide important knowledge and information regarding to the latest development or application on the field of civil engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.

syllabi.outline:

name.en: Biotechnical and Soil Bioengineering Slope Stabilization

description.zh: 生態工法的概念和原則近年來廣泛地引介和應用在各種的土木工程領域中，包括河溪、坡地、都市和交通建設等，而由於土石流和坡地災害的頻繁發生，因此在山坡地應用生態工法遂成為重要的課題，也逐漸成為應該提供給土木系學生，使其瞭解相關基礎知識的重要課程，因此在本導論課程中，我們將介紹如何將生物地工技術和土壤生物工程（Biotechnical and Soil Bioengineering）應用在邊坡穩定和侵蝕控制上，使學生認識並瞭解目前在邊坡保護上結合工程力學分析、植物學知識和實際案例應用的發展，並藉此介紹國內外常用的邊坡穩定工法，以及結合不同傳統擋土設施的可行方式。本課程無先修課程限制，建議研究所和大學部高年級同學選修。
description.en:
The concept and principles of ecological engineering has been widely adopted by various disciplines of traditional civil engineering,including hydraulic engineering, slope stabilization, urban infrastructures, and transportation engineering.  Among them, slope stabilization is a particularly important topic because of the
frequent occurrence of debris flows and landslides in Taiwan, and thus it becomes necessary to provide such a course to familiarize students with this important field.  In this introductory course, we will explain the fundamental concepts of biotechnical and soil bioengineering and how to apply them to the slope stabilization and
erosion control.  An interdisciplinary approach that combines the knowledge and understanding of both mechanical design and vegetation properties will be emphasized.  The results can be integrated with traditional retaining structures to create more economical and eco-friendly slope stabilization systems.  No prerequisite.

syllabi.outline: 由於台灣經常發生土壤沖蝕、水土流失、土石流和地滑等災害，所以邊坡相關問題是一個特別重要的研究領域。在本課程中我們將探討造成邊坡問題的兩個主要原因，即(1)土壤沖蝕和(2)邊坡滑動，並解釋如何使用土壤生物工程(生態工法)的技術來防治或減緩邊坡相關問題，兼顧理論與實務。學生除了學習專業知識之外，並將參與賽德克部落的現地訪查服務，實際應用所學知識，作為本校實現大學社會責任(University Social Responsibility, USR)核心價值的一環。本課程將以中文授課，不需要先修課程，且現地訪查的交通費與保險費由USR計畫負擔。請注意選修本課程即自動同意所繳交的資料和報告得為USR計畫所用，無須另外授權。

description.zh: 資料庫是任何完整的資訊管理系統之不可或缺的一部份，並且已經在各行各業中顯示其與日俱增的重要性，當然土木工程也不例外。尤其近年來地理資訊系統、營建管理系統及地質鑽孔資料庫的發展，更促使土木工程師正視資料庫的重要性，並學習如何有效地管理龐大的相關資訊。因此，本課程的設計即針對此需要來教導學生熟悉現代資料庫系統的設計與技術，以使他們在畢業後更具有競爭力，更容易找到理想的工作。課程的內容將包括資料處理、概念設計、關連式資料模型、及正規化等領域，而學生必須在學期中設計並完成一個完整的資料庫作為專題計畫。關於本課程的其他細節請見下述課程大綱。
description.en: Database（DB） is an integral part of any information management system, and has been playing a significant role in many academic programs and professions, including the civil engineering, construction engineering, and environmental engineering. In recent years, the development of Geographical Information System, Construction Decision Support System, and Geotechnical Data Bank all require practicing civil engineers to understand the principles of underlying data storage and to develop an effective style of data management to achieve competitiveness in the market place. Therefore, it is the focus of this course to guide the students to become familiar with various technical aspects of modern DB systems so that they can perform the above-mentioned tasks and become more employable. This course will cover areas such as data processing, conceptual DB design, relational data model, and normalization. The students are required to complete a semester project and implement a functional DB.

description.en: Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure.  The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied).  For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.

description.zh: 寶石業為台灣新興的工業之一，集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於此門學問，寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。人造寶石之製造與辨認，均讓學習者有能力鑑定其真偽，價值與市場行為。
description.en: Introduction the physics and chemistry properties of gemstones.

syllabi.outline: 寶石業為台灣新興的工業之一，集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於此門學問，寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。本課程主要涉及四個方面的內容：一、總論，主要介紹寶玉石的概念、分類與特性、評價標準、物性、來源等; 二、講述寶石的特點與品鑒，其中包括鑽石、紅/藍寶石、祖母綠、金綠寶、海藍寶石、石榴子石、尖晶石、碧璽、水晶、橄欖石以及其它寶石等特點與評價; 三、介紹翡翠、軟玉、歐泊、石英質玉、獨山玉、蛇紋石玉、綠松石（土耳其玉）以及印章石等特點與評價; 四、有機寶石，如珍珠、象牙、珊瑚、琥珀等的鑒定與評價。 通過本課程學習，全面瞭解寶玉石的分類與特性、評價標準與來源，掌握寶石、玉石和有機寶石的化學組成、結晶學特徵、物理性質、典型的鑒定特徵，懂得利用常見寶玉石的鑒別方法品鑒寶石、玉石和有機寶石，瞭解各種寶玉石的佩戴習俗和保養方法。 讓學生理解自然界與思想、文化、科學之間的相互關係，擴大學生想像思維，培養學生的理論與現實結合能力。

description.en: Organizational behavior (OB) is a field of research that investigates the impact that individuals, groups, and structure have on behavior within an organization, and then it applies that knowledge to make organizations work more effectively.  Specifically, OB focuses on how to improve productivity, reduce absenteeism and turnover, and increase employee citizenship and job satisfaction.

description.zh: 生物電化學可以獲得更多先進的訊息，其中包括生化反應、形態學，以及物理、化學和電學等相關性質。運用相關的技術方法，例如電化學工具，可用以研究異相與均相反應，亦可獲得諸多界面間的化學活性和圖譜以利用於微裝置的發展。對生物分析而言，生物電化學感測器具有最大的再現性，並能夠成功的引用於電活性生化物種、母體材料，以及其規格上。生物電分析方法包括最先進和有用的方法，其中大部分皆建立在此領域的的基礎上。
description.en: Bioelectrochemistry can be investigated to get more and more advanced information about biochemical reaction, morphology, and physical, chemical, and electric properties. The techniques have been used in a variety of ways, for example, as an electrochemical tool to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, for high-resolution imaging of the chemical reactivity and topography of various interfaces, and for microfabrication. For bioanalysis, bioelectrochemistry sensors have maximum reliability and can be successfully employed in electroactive biomaterials, matrix materials, and their size. Bioelectroanalysis include descriptions of the most advanced and successful methods, which in large part build on the fundamentals will be described.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline: The course content mainly introduces various physical methods used in the research process of inorganic chemistry. First, the basic principles of spectroscopy are introduced. The various spectroscopic techniques applied to inorganic chemistry and solid materials will then be discussed in more depth. Including: various absorption spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy, X-ray absorption spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction and other commonly used analytical techniques in chemistry are also included in the course discussion. The content includes chemical bonds, molecular vibrations, electronic spectra of transition metal compounds, atomic cluster compounds and crystal structures.

description.zh: 生質能源(bioenergy)指的是儲存在現有(活著或剛失去生命)的動植物體的能量。生質能源的來源，主要是植物將太陽能經由光合作用轉換成葡萄糖，在進一步合生物高分子衍生物(如多醣體(polysaccharides)) 。新一代生質能源技術強調環保技術，整合跨領域之技術，包含應用分子生物技術所發展出之基因轉殖、醱酵控制及生物觸媒技術-利用生物酵素進行催化化學反應達成環保及高效率與節能之目的。本課程將介紹動植物的多醣體種類及如何運用新興生物系統學的技術開發生質能源。
description.en: Bioenergy is referred to the energy stored in living or recently living biological organisms, such as animals, plants and microbes. The source of bioenergy can be traced back from plants harvesting the sunlight and converting it to glucose, then to other biopolymers such as polysaccharides. The technologies for developing bioenergy, with an emphasis on environmentally compatible, consist of gene cloning technology from molecular biology and enzymatic control and catalytic chemistry (i.e. green chemistry).  The course is an introduction course on the types of polysaccharides in animals and plants, how scientist use system biology to develop bioengergy.

description.zh: 本課程主要是要讓學生對醫學設計之基本理論及實務內容有所認識。了解一個健康醫療產品/系統/服務從醫學及使用者需求的思維、如何發展到設計理念之形成、設計內容之導入實現、工程技術之開發、原型機製作、臨床前測試、臨床試驗、醫療認證、及工業管理等層次。讓學生能掌握跨領域之醫學設計原理，並教導如何藉由創新產品設計與開發方法引導醫學背景與設計背景之專業人士合作以瞭解開發市場上成功之健康醫療產品之關鍵課題、針對臨床服務需求，提出健康醫療創新解決方案。進而產生創新健康醫療產品。
description.en: This course aims to teach postgraduate students to understand the basic theory and practice of medical design. Learn about the health and medical products/ systems/ services from the discovery of medical and user needs to the design of innovative healthcare products, which include the topics of how to generate the design concepts, understand the user and market needs, develop the engineering technologies and prototype, design pre-clinical testing and clinical trials, obtain medical certification and plan industrial management. To enable students to master the principles of interdisciplinary medical design, and teach them how to use innovative product design and development approach to guide professionals in medical backgrounds and design backgrounds to understand the key issues in developing successful health medical products in the market and address the needs of clinical services, propose innovative solutions for health care, and develop innovative health and medical products.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to provide students with a better understanding of both the theoretical and practical aspects of medical design. Through the course, students will learn how to approach the design of healthcare products, systems, and services, taking into account medical requirements and user needs. The curriculum covers topics such as developing design concepts, introducing and implementing engineering design, prototyping, preclinical testing, clinical trials, medical certification, and project management. Students will also gain a deep understanding of the principles of cross-disciplinary medical design and innovative product design and development methods. The course will teach students how to collaborate with medical and design professionals to develop successful healthcare products that meet the needs of clinical services. Ultimately, the goal is to produce innovative healthcare products that provide innovative solutions to healthcare.
syllabi.schedule:
Upon completion of this course, students will have achieved the following primary learning objectives:
•	Gain a comprehensive understanding of the product, system, and service development process geared towards elderly health and medical care to promote healthy ageing.
•	Familiarize themselves with the regulatory approval process and the key regulators involved in the development of new products, systems, and service portfolios.
•	Acquire knowledge of the technical and commercial factors essential for the successful development of ageing-related products.
•	Develop an awareness of the ethical, social, and cultural considerations involved in the introduction of new ageing health medical products.
•	Explore emerging medical product categories for senior health.
•	Analyse and critique real-life cases of the development of medical products designed for the elderly.
At the end of the course, students will have created a visionary concept and a commercialisation strategy for a new geriatric health product.

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: In this course, students will gain a conceptual understanding of ways to implement a training program, different models of evaluation, and the rationale for evaluating a program or the objectives and intent of the organization. Students will identify whether and where evaluation is needed, and how the evaluation contributes to the overall goals of the organization as well as the learning identified as necessary. Students will gain practical experience with the notion of evaluation as well as what is  to be done with the evaluation’s findings.
syllabi.schedule:
week 1: Overview of the course

week 2: (implementation) Training delivery methods, on-the-job training methods, & classroom training approaches

week 3: (implementation) The lecture approach, the discussion method, & audiovisual media

week 4: (implementation) Computer-based training, self-paced media and methods, & arranging the physical environment

week 5: (evaluation) Foundations of evaluation

week 6: (evaluation) Principles of performance-based evaluation

week 7: (evaluation) Overview of existing evaluation models 

week 8: (evaluation) Kirkpatrick's four levels of evaluation

week 9: Mid-term

week 10: (evaluation) Phillip's return-on-investment methodology 

week 11: (evaluation) Brinkerhoff's success case method 

week 12: (evaluation) The impact evaluation process model

week 13: (evaluation) The CIPP model

week 14: (evaluation) Evaluating evaluations

week 15: (evaluation) Data collection

week 16: (evaluation) Analysis of evaluation data: Tools and techniques

week 17: (evaluation) Communicating the findings

week 18: Final

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

name.en: Biotechnical and Soil Bioengineering Slope Stabilization

description.zh: 生態工法的概念和原則近年來廣泛地引介和應用在各種的土木工程領域中，包括河溪、坡地、都市和交通建設等，而由於土石流和坡地災害的頻繁發生，因此在山坡地應用生態工法遂成為重要的課題，也逐漸成為應該提供給土木系學生，使其瞭解相關基礎知識的重要課程，因此在本導論課程中，我們將介紹如何將生物地工技術和土壤生物工程（Biotechnical and Soil Bioengineering）應用在邊坡穩定和侵蝕控制上，使學生認識並瞭解目前在邊坡保護上結合工程力學分析、植物學知識和實際案例應用的發展，並藉此介紹國內外常用的邊坡穩定工法，以及結合不同傳統擋土設施的可行方式。本課程無先修課程限制，建議研究所和大學部高年級同學選修。
description.en: The concept and principles of ecological engineering has been widely adopted by various disciplines of traditional civil engineering, including hydraulic engineering, slope stabilization, urban infrastructures, and transportation engineering. Among them, slope stabilization is a particularly important topic because of the frequent occurrence of debris flows and landslides in Taiwan, and thus it becomes necessary to provide such a course to familiarize students with this important field. In this introductory course, we will explain the fundamental concepts of biotechnical and soil bioengineering and how to apply them to the slope stabilization and erosion control. An interdisciplinary approach that combines the knowledge and understanding of both mechanical design and vegetation properties will be emphasized. The results can be integrated with traditional retaining structures to create more economical and eco-friendly slope stabilization systems. No prerequisite.

syllabi.outline: 由於台灣經常發生土壤沖蝕、水土流失、土石流和地滑等災害，所以邊坡相關問題是一個特別重要的研究領域。在本課程中我們將探討造成邊坡問題的兩個主要原因，即(1)土壤沖蝕和(2)邊坡滑動，並解釋如何使用土壤生物工程(生態工法)的技術來防治或減緩邊坡相關問題，兼顧理論與實務。學生除了學習專業知識之外，並將參與賽德克部落的現地訪查服務，實際應用所學知識，作為本校實現大學社會責任(University Social Responsibility, USR)核心價值的一環。本課程將以中文授課，不需要先修課程，且現地訪查的交通費與保險費由USR計畫負擔。請注意選修本課程即自動同意所繳交的資料和報告得為USR計畫所用，無須另外授權。

syllabi.outline:
The class will be taught in-person. In-person sessions will include active gameplay with another student or coach. This is an introductory course teaching the fundamental skills of table tennis. It is assumed that students enrolled in the class have little or no experience in table tennis. Class will be focusing on developing the following skills: racket grip, possible racket holding angles, basic strokes, rules, scoring, strategy, etiquette, practice drills, spin, singles play.
Not limited to a students with advance level would like to join. For those of who should notice, some advance techniques would not be included in the course.

Present the student fundamental skills and knowledge of table tennis.
Improve each student's skills in hitting all of the basic strokes: forehand counterhit; backhand
counterhit(drive); backhand flick(flip); backhand block; service return, and footwork.
Introduce each student to the basic rules, scoring, and footwork.
Offer each student an opportunity to apply their skill and knowledge in match play.
Make each student aware of the primary differences in strategies for singles and doubles and provide an
opportunity to implement this information in actual match play.
Provide each student with information about current table tennis trends, specifically regarding local
table tennis programs, professional tournaments and equipment selection.
Encourage each student to pursue table tennis as a lifetime leisure activity.

**Consistent attendance and participation are extremely important in order to develop the necessary skills for improvement. All students will be held accountable for any work missed when absent. Please be prepared each day with proper equipment and attire.

  EX., racket holding,  techniques of forehand, backhand, server.

Gameplay phase: game rules introduction and practicing.
During this phase, all students are required to play with other classmates in both single and double game match to familiar processes of the play.

#11~18weeks
Matching phase: single an double game competitions.
In this period, all students are randomly assign to a groups for competitions. For the final grade, to 40 points in total is requires for student to pass the class.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
生命科學是一門綜合知識探討什麼是科學，以科學方法瞭解地球上生命的來源，演化與特徵,與生命活動的環境。地球上存在各式各樣的生命，多樣性的物種，包括類生命的病毒，單細胞(生命的基本單元) 或多細胞生物。人類(異營生物)生活於其中與週遭的物種密切關聯，從環境取得能量(營養攝取)，代謝生長，繁殖，最終死亡。從宏觀看，人類位居生物鏈最頂端，但在微觀環境仍不斷與微生物做競爭。從基礎研究讓我們了解生命的過程(中心準則: DNA-> RNA-> Protein)，疫系統與細菌病毒間的運作，細胞生長發育與疾病的發生，利用動物模式幫助醫學與藥物科技的研發，讓人類更健康更長壽。同時，人類的過度活動也製造龐大的廢棄物造成環境汙染與生態傷害，這些最後將反撲於自己，如現在所面對的物種大量減少，環境賀爾蒙入侵食物鏈，新興病毒崛起。這些課題都是生命科學研究中的一環。現代生命科學不僅研究單獨生物體生命活動的過程，還研究眾多生物個體之間的相互關係（生物演化與多樣性問題），生物個體與環境的關係（生態問題）。這些基本知識都是現代大學生應該具備的。也為未來跨領域合作準備。課程將對每一課題從生命科學歷史到現在發展作敘述來引發同學興趣。
Life science is discussing all aspects of knowledge about biology to which we human could not get away. In this course, you will learn how life is started and study evolution, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, immunology and disease, microbiology, environmental toxicology and physiology. I will also introduce you the newly developed biotechnology and how importance of environmental protection to human life. All of the information included in these classes is so important that modern college students should not missed.

description.zh: 這e世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題:1.溝通管理定義與本質元素。2.溝通管理內涵分析。3.學習個人溝通能力。4.學習溝通程序。5.e化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6.學習全球化溝通科技工具。7.團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8.塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Effective communication degrees usually are seen as the index of learning communication. It depends on thoroughly melting and sharing with fact, opinion, feeling, interesting and experience. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

description.zh: 古蹟、歷史建築和聚落為台灣地區文化資產的一部份，亦是台灣社會發展和多元文化交融的歷史見證。這些建築物表出各項的歷史價值與意義，其類型包括了史前遺址、荷西城堡、清代祠廟、墳墓、民居，以及日治時代以後的官署、學校、官舍住宅、土木設施等。本課程的目的，一方面希望讓修課同學對台灣各期建築歷史與形式風格特徵，能有清晰的架構與認識，以作為欣賞台灣古蹟的基礎；另一方面則是養成同學對身處文化環境的關心與歷史人文精神的培養。
description.en: Cultural property, historic building and settlement are the evidence of history development and multiple cultural interaction of Taiwanese society. The types of architecture include excavation, castle, temple, tomb, folk settlement before the Ching dynasty, and official building, school, house and civil engineering facility after the Japanese occupied period. This course hope to help students to understand the architectural history briefly, and get some basic skill about the formative characters of each period. Furthermore, it will train them to give more concern on the cultural environment of Taiwan.

syllabi.outline:
「古蹟」是人類社會發展過程中的遺留物；是歷史的見證，代表不同時期文化的象徵；是國家重要的資產；是實體的歷史教材；是「歷史」這首歌裡的一個個音符，也可以說是歷史洪流的見證者。
「古蹟」也是無所不在的人類遺跡，有無可取代的文明寶藏；是豐富的文化史課本；是人類思考與想像的泉源。
本課程的目的，一方面希望讓修課同學透過古蹟，可使我們驗證過去、瞭解過去，並建立一個連續不斷的臺灣歷史文化命脈。
另一方面，則是養成同學對身處文化環境的關心與歷史人文精神的培養。所以以史前、荷西、明鄭、清代、日治、民國等六個時期為經、古蹟為緯，脈絡分明，欣賞古蹟。

description.zh: 西藥及中草藥是中華民族的傳統藥，也是中國藥學寶庫的重組成成分，中草藥包括中藥、草藥（即民間藥）以及少數民族地區使用的民族藥，在中國，使用中草藥防病治病已有數千年之歷史，寶鑑證明，中草藥療效確切，副作用較合成中藥少，力來深受群眾喜愛。當前，人類健康需要傳統醫藥之觀點正為越來越多之國家和人民接受，開發傳統要已成為當今藥物發展的潮流。同時，近年來科學研究成果表明，從中草藥發展出療效好，毒性低的新藥是一條成功的捷徑。因此，學習中草藥之人員日漸增加。本課程共分：西藥概論、中草藥概論、內科中草藥、兒科中草藥、男科中草藥、婦科中草藥、美容養生中草藥等。
description.en: The Drugs on Life is a two credit hours course and design especially for technology students. This curriculum emphasizes on the clinical applications and action mechanisms of various western and Chinese drugs. The curriculum trends will start from more details and bring a completely concepts. The subjects include neuropharmacology, autacoids, cardiovascular drugs, analgesics, anaethesia and drugs actiong on the central nervous system, chemotherapy of microbial disease and neoplastic disease, hormones and hormone antagonists, drugs acting on the blood and some Chinese drugs.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh: 教學目標：針對當前社會中之政治、經濟、社會、文化等各層面所形成之重大問題與現象加以探討，予以概略整合性之介紹，以使學生對社會現況更加瞭解並進而關懷所生活之環境。開課基礎：以原開設之社會科學概論為基礎，而向實務面擴充之課程。教學內容：採單元教學、口授、作業、探討意見交換並行方式進行。1.真正的民意－政治生態與國會。2.尖銳的對立－政黨競爭。3.台灣經驗－經濟奇蹟。4.高齡化的社會－銀髮族與人生。5.應關懷的族群－社福。6.立國的基礎－教育改革。7.慾望街車－犯罪與司法。8.和平發展之關鍵－兩岸關係。9.其他。

description.zh: 生態與環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解生態環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境污染問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Ecology and Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize its importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand the connection between our ecological environment and our living condition, the environmental pollution problems and their classification, the environmental problems in Taiwan, and the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems after the situation introduction.

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
林懷民說：「不管看的懂，看不懂，只要是看了可以讓你感動、喜愛的，對你而言，就是好的藝術」。這句話聽起來雖然很簡單，但提到「藝術」兩個字，對非藝術科系的同學而言，似乎還是很高深，很難懂 ! 所以這門課在課程設計上，主要就是針對非藝術科系同學們的學習需要，以深入淺出的方式來介紹藝術，讓同學們能夠在沒有壓力和負擔的狀態下，輕輕鬆鬆的接觸藝術、欣賞藝術、甚至喜歡上藝術。
在十八週的課程中，我們會從藝術史上的第一幅畫開始介紹，接著，再依序介紹世界上最有名的畫家如 : 達文西、米開蘭基羅、米勒、莫內、梵谷、馬諦斯、畢卡索…等等畫家生活中和藝術作品背後的有趣故事，並欣賞相關的藝術電影。
衷心希望這樣的課程安排，能夠讓同學們輕鬆學藝術，體會欣賞藝術的樂趣，敬請期待。

description.zh:
本課程，擬引領修課同學們徜徉古今愛情文學作品；內容含括詩、詞、散文、小說、戲曲、視聽影像等，並以主題單元方式進行之。從中，仔細咀嚼或清澀曖昧、或清新動人、或可歌可泣、或刻骨銘心、或纏綿悱惻、或黯然銷魂的愛情文學作品；從中，與作品中所傳達的心情、心事、心聲產生共鳴，由此來發現：在塵世的繁華裡，情感的傳遞是沒有時空隔閡，是可以心心相映。
鑑於修課同學正值青春年華、正將展翅翱翔，因此本課程除了鑑賞、品味古今愛情文學作品，並欲與吾人現實人生作一連結，由此思考愛情、婚姻、兩性、家國、社會、政治等議題，由此尋求愛情的本質與真諦。

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、課程簡介：民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，但卻也是不好學的一門法律課程。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：民法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是民法現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展民法在整個法律體系中的位置民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：公法與私法普通法及特別法實體法與程序法強行法與任意法固有法與繼受法國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係(1)：民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）民法與刑法民法與行政法/勞基法民法與經濟法民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係(2)-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：民法總則債篇總論債篇各論物權篇親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：土地法勞基法公寓大廈管理條例家庭暴力防治法智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。
第十七週：物權篇（1）
第十八週：物權篇（2）。
第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.en:
This course introduces the hardware/software technologies, architecture, access characteristics, and management strategies of next-generation memory/storage media. In addition, we shall also cover the architecture and design issues of various memory–storage systems, such as file systems, databases, NoSQL databases, key–value store, content-aware storage, and approximate storage. The key technologies such as processing-in-memory (PIM) are also discussed. 

Please note that this course is given in full English, and adopts full-English materials.

description.zh: C語言為開發作業系統、嵌入式系統、通訊協定等程式最常使用的程式語言，本課程主要教導C程式語言於實務上之應用，課程內容主要包括：進階指標使用、指標與陣列、指標與資料結構、Pointer-to-pointer、指標函式、Callback function、Bitwise operation應用等，除了於PC上撰寫程式練習之外，亦會有case study來輔助教學以及了解C語言的使用技巧，期末亦會要求學生利用所學習到之技巧來模擬CPU排程與記憶體管理等相關作業系統底層程式。
description.en: The C programming language is commonly used to implement operation systems, embedded systems, and communication protocols. The object of this course is to teach how to apply the C programming language to develop real application systems. The contents of this course include advanced pointer usage, pointer and array, pointer and data structure, pointer-to-pointer, function pointer, callback functions, bitwise operations, and so on. In addition to practice on PC, this course also offers case studies for better understanding. Students will also be required to implement emulators to simulate OS lower level operations, e.g., CPU scheduling and memory management.

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。

syllabi.outline: This course is the deepening and broadening of linear algebra. In terms of deepening the theory, this course starts with the Gaussian elimination method, explaining the four vector spaces. Next, it explains the orthogonality and projection of matrices. In addition, this course explains the determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, powers and exponents of matrices, and spectral decomposition, finally concluding with singular value decomposition, which is the theorem that unifies all the contents in this semester. In terms of broadening applications, this course introduces scientific and engineering applications, such as regression analysis, linear programming, graph theory and networks, and principal component analysis.

name.zh: 現代性與建築名作研討
name.en: Seminar on Modernity and Architecture Masterpiece

description.zh:
現代性源自於歐洲獨有的歷史文化與社會，在工業化、理性化和民主化的推波助瀾下綻放開來，促使人們從神話、威權和中心性解放出來，擺脫傳統社會的制約。透過現代性的反證精神和批判性概念，歐洲幾乎於整個二十世紀初開展出驚人的物質和人類意識的進程。而建築的生產與整個社會、經濟、政治和審美價值緊密相關的專業，又是如何以自身作為對於現代性的批判?
本課程將以辨明現代性概念為主軸，透過阿道夫·魯斯(Adolf Loos)、西格弗里德·吉迪恩(Sigfried Giedion)、華特·班雅明(Walter Benjamin)、恩斯特·布洛赫(Ernst Bloch)、和威尼斯學派(Venice School)的論說作為理解現代性含混而艱澀的觀念，並藉由藝術和建築作品的探索，作為對於現代性的批判與理念的參照，包括前衛派藝術對於建築的衝擊、新巴比倫的城市景觀社會反論、建築的擬仿和批判等等。
description.en:
The term “Modernity” originated from the unique European history, culture, and societal condition, bloomed with the development of industrialization, rationalization and democratization. That have inspired human to liberate from mythology, authority and centrality, and get rid of the constraints of traditional society. With the antithesis and critical concepts of modernity, Europe has carried out an amazing progress of material and human consciousness almost throughout the twentieth century. How does architecture as a profession closely related to the entire society, economy, politics, and aesthetic approach, in the process of production implemented itself as a critique of modernity?
    In the beginning of the class, it would be most important to identify the concepts of Modernity. The discourses of Adolf Loos, Sigfried Giedion, Walter Benjamin, Ernst Bloch, and the Venetian School help to clarify the vague and difficult concepts of modernity. description.en:
This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of designing and construction for local social issues in Taiwan. In this year, Focuses on the Settlements of aboriginal people, through cases studies and design practice, the courses seeks to expand the students understanding to the major components of site planning. The topics also focus on six premises:1.theories in relation to site planning;2.design sequences of site planning;
3.investigations and analyses of the sites;4.planning and designing methods and their evaluations;5.environmental impact assessment and countermeasures.

description.zh: 施工歷史可以被視為了解建築理論的關鍵基礎。按照慣例，建築學院提供建築歷史方面的研究方面，包括建築風格和哲學的發展，或者建築材料和建築技術的最新進展。此外，關於建築的理論辯論也更加關注哲學的討論，而不是物理建築的表現。 但是，建築理論主要討論材料和建築系統的表示。因此，材料的構造方法實際上會極大地影響建築理論的解釋。因此，該課程可以分為兩個部分：首先，將回顧東西方世界的建設歷史以及現代時期。其次，將討論結構論和相對論的爭論。本課程的目的是發展與會學生的能力，使他們能夠回顧自己論點的要點，並運用適當的理論來支持或爭論他們對建築理論的理解。
description.en: Construction history could be considered as the key foundation to understand architectonic theories. Conventionally, architectural academies provide study aspects either in architectural histories in terms of development of architectural style and philosophy or in the latest progress of architectural materials and construction techniques. Moreover, theoretical debates of architecture also pay more attentions to philosophical discussions instead of physical construction presentation. Nevertheless, architectonic theories mainly discuss the presentation of materials and construction systems. Therefore, construction methods of materials in fact affect the interpretation of architectonic theories significantly. As a result, this course can be divided into two sections: firstly the construction history of Eastern and Western worlds as well as modern period of time will be reviewed. Secondly the architectonic and relative theoretic debates will be discussed.

Week 01	Introduction to the course: definition of construction history and architectonics
Week 02	Theme 1-1 construction history of the East: timber and bamboo
Week 03	Theme 1-2 construction history of the East: masonry construction
Week 04
(10/15)	Theme 4-1 Foundation of architectonic theories: conventional understanding
Reading A: Frampton ch.1
Week 05	Theme 2-1 construction history of the West: masonry construction
Week 06
(10/29)	Theme 4-2 German Enlightenment: Bötticher, Semper, Wanger and Loos
Reading B: Semper’s four elements
Week 07	Theme 2-2 Construction history of the West: framework system
Week 08
(11/12)	Theme 4-3 Modernism and tectonics: Mies van der Rohe and Louis Kahn
Reading C: Frampton ch.7
Week 09	Mid-term week: proposal of final thesis 
Week 10
(11/26)	Visit of restoration site
Week 11
(12/3)	Theme 5-1 Adam’s house and the primitive hut
Reading D: Adam’s house
Week 12	Theme 3-1 construction history of the modern: iron and steel
Week 13
(12/17)	Theme 5-2 Principle of dressing, cladding and ripolin vs. surface and ornament
Reading E: Loos’s texts: principle of dressing
Week 14	Theme 3-2 Construction history of the modern: reinforced concrete
Week 15	holiday
Week 16
(1/7)	Theme 5-3 Tectonics in Postmodern discussion: Venturi and Koolhaas
Reading F: Venturi’s texts
Week 17
(1/14)	Theme 5-4 Atectonics and skeuomorph
Reading G: skeuomorph
Week 18	Final week: thesis representation
syllabi.assessment:
＊＊Attendance 20%
＊＊Participation 30%
Each participant needs to study a required article in advance and brief the article for all participants in the class of the required day for 20 minutes.
  (Week 4) Frampton’s chapter 1 (____)
  (Week 6) Semper’s four elements  (____)
  (Week 8) Frampton’s chapter 7 (____)
  (Week 11) Adam’s house (____)
  (Week 13) Loos’s principle of dressing (____)
  (Week 16) Venturi’s texts (____)
  (Week 17) skeuomorph (____)	
＊＊Mid-term presentation: proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, each participant has to find a project with vivid material expressions, which can be discussed in terms of tectonic theories and interpretations. The project can be international or domestic. It should be easier if the participant might find its design drawings. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.
＊＊Research thesis 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by the noon of 1/21 (12:00pm) to Dr. Wu in person. The words of the thesis should not be less than 5000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
Employed materials of one’s chosen architectural project for the thesis should be clarified. Please note that the referred theories should be reviewed firstly. Aftermath, the discussion of material deployment should be referred to at least one of the architectonic or atectonic theories.

It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

syllabi.schedule:
Week One: Unit 6: Does Advertising Help or Harm us? 
1.	Explication of related vocabulary (131)
2.	Reading I: p113-118
3.	Questions and Answers from the text 
Week Two: 
1.	Reading Part II: p119-127
2.	Grammar and Rhetoric (127: Compound sentence)
3.	Group assignment(s): Research information connected to this topic in verbal form 
Week Three:
1.	Group Presentations (Shared paper)
2.	Questions and Answers
3.	Summation(s) 
Week Four: 
		   Unit Seven: Why Do People Take Risks?
1.	Related Vocabulary and Thesis of statement (135-6)
2.	Reading I: P127-8
3.	Test Students’ comprehension (Can students detect the main idea of this article and point out the supporting ideas here?) 
Week Five:
		  Unit Seven: To be continued
1.	Reading II: P140-144
2.	Grammar Analysis (Shifts between past and present) 
3.	Group Assignment: Research related topics and share 
Week Six: 
1.	Group presentations 
2.	Interactions and responses 
3.	Summations 
Week Seven:
		Unit Eight: How Can We Make Cities Better Places to Live 
1.	Questions discussed in advance
2.	Possible vocabulary that flashes through students’ mind (collective brainstorming)
3.	Reading I: p157-160 (analysis of texts and thesis statement/supporting ideas)
Week Eight: 
1.	Reading II: 164-166
2.	Grammar and Rhetoric (Particles as Adjectives) 
3.	Group Research
Week Nine: 
1.	Group presentations
2.	Questions and answers 
3.	Summations 
Week Ten: 
1.	Outside Readings (adapted from monthly magazine, Ivory)
2.	Analysis—What is the thesis statement here? How many ideas does the writer bring up to support? 
Week Eleven: 
	 Unit Nine: How Can A Small Amount of Money Make a big Difference?
1.	Motivation of this article
2.	Thesis statement and supporting ideas 
3.	Reading I: 181-184
4.	Related Vocabulary and Idioms/Phrases 
Week Twelve 
1.	Reading II: p186-190; 194-5
2.	What are the Main Ideas?
Week Thirteen
1.	Students’ Research: Share 
2.	Collective Discussions 
3.	Summations 
Week Fourteen 
	Unit Ten: Do People Communicate Better Now Than in the Past?
1.	Reading I: 203-7
2.	What is the thesis statement? What are the supporting ideas?
3.	What are the related words that pop up in your mind? 
Week Sixteen 
1.	Reading II: 211-214
2.	Main Ideas
3.	Grammar and Rhetoric (Sentence Fragments)

name.en: Development of global perspective: Korean I

description.zh: 本課程將教導學生韓文字母結構、發音方法及基礎詞彙、文法與句型、韓國現況及文化等，透過文化與語言的習得，培養學生與韓籍人士溝通或在韓國生活所需要的最基本的溝通能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce beginners to basic spoken and written skills in Korean. Students will develop basic skills with a focus on effective communication and enjoyment through listening, speaking, reading and writing. By the end of the course, students will be able to hold a simple conversation in Korean, comprehend basic Korean texts and write about their everyday lives.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:馬來文化與語言
name.en: Emerging Market Series: Getting to know Malaysia

description.zh: 課程藉由傳授馬來西亞語言以協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖，旨在培養學生的馬來西亞語基本溝通能力，運用馬來語與當地母語者打招呼、了解馬來文化、建立人際關係、購物、敘述事物等，以此來協助學生前往馬來西亞就業，作為兩國的經濟橋樑。
description.en: In order to embrace economic development of globalization, especially in Asian and Southeast Asian countries, there is a need to introduce and equip our students not only with the basic local language but also to understand the local culture so as to strengthen the economic tie between Taiwan and the Asian countries and to enhance the employment opportunities of our students in these Asian countries. This course aims to help students to understand and develop basic communication skills by utilizing Bahasa Malaysia (Malaysian language) to communicate with Malaysian in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, etc. Historical and geographical backgrounds of Malaysia and their local cultures will also be introduced.

This course aims to help students to understand and develop basic communication skills by utilizing Bahasa Malaysia (Malaysian language) to communicate with Malaysian in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, etc. Historical and geographical backgrounds of Malaysia and their local cultures will also be introduced.

description.zh: 為了迎接全球化的亞洲國家與東南亞國家之間的經濟發展,藉由傳授印尼語言,讓學生掌握印尼語同時也了解印尼文化作為兩國的經濟橋樑，以此來協助學生前往印尼就業。本課程是培養學生的溝通能力，以運用印尼語來跟印尼母語者打招呼、建立人際關係、購物、敘述事物…等。

And, it is hoped that assisting students in employment in Indonesia. This course will aim to help students to develop communication skills by utilizing Indonesian language to speak to native speakers in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, and descriptive usage…etc.

name.en: Development of global perspective: Thai culture and language I

description.zh: 1. 在臺灣與東南亞交流日益增加的情況下，東南亞語言的學習需求也會隨之提高。而「泰國」所擁有的社會經濟條件優勢，以及泰國政府有意推動的文化創意產業，相信也將為臺灣帶來一陣「泰語學習風潮」。 2. 課程以培養基礎泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通基本實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。 3. 泰語教學方面，秉持聽、說、讀、寫同時並進的教學理念，由字母的發音、寫法、唸法、聲調、順序及拼字系統的學習開始，奠定良好的泰語基礎，搭配最常用的單字、句型、文法與日常實用會話，使學生可以拼寫、閱讀泰文短文，並能以泰語進行日常對話。 4. 泰國文化方面，以專題的方式，講述政治、經濟、社會、地理、歷史與文化等各個層面的泰國，呈現出不同於一般刻板印象中的泰國，培養學生對泰國的正確認識及態度。本學期先針對泰國目前的經濟與文化面進行概說；下學期則探討泰國歷史、地理、政治與社會。
description.en: 1. With the interaction between Taiwan and Southeast Asia getting more and more frequent, the need for learning Southeast Asian languages has been highly increasing. Thailand owns the advantages of social economy; moreover, Thailand government intends to promote cultural creativity industries. Hence, learning Thai definitely becomes a new trend in Taiwan. 2. This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking basic Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc. 3. In terms of learning Thai, listening, speaking, reading and writing, these four skills are equally important. Student will be trained to learn all these four skills together.

syllabi.schedule:
課程簡介
  以培養基礎泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構以泰國語言教學為主，搭配文化相關知識，使學生具備泰語溝通基本實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。不同於拉丁語系的拼音系統，泰語的字母、發音與拼字系統極為複雜，一般泰國母語人士亦需約二年時間才能完全熟記；本班透過獨創的泰語「四大結構及18種發音組合」教學，使同學於一個學年（上下兩個學期）內學會泰語字母、發音與拼字。此外，秉持聽、說、讀、寫同時並進的教學理念，由字母的發音、寫法、唸法、聲調、順序及拼字系統的學習開始，奠定良好的泰語基礎。每堂課除「字母、發音與拼字」的部份外，並將搭配「會話與聽力」部份，教授最常用的單字、句型、文法與日常實用會話，使學生快速學會簡單入門的日常生活泰語，增進學習泰語的成就感。本課程的設計，可使學生可於一年內學會拼寫、閱讀泰文句子，並能以泰語進行簡易日常對話。


課程目標
1.以培養和訓練學生具備泰語能力可以從事泰國往來工作或必須使用泰文為溝通語言為目標。
2.正確的指導字母發音與書寫方式，訓練學生書寫泰文字，針對單字同時進行聽、說、讀、寫的練習、在課堂中自然而然掌握泰語發音規則並累積字彙。
3.引導學生認識泰國文化歷史與風俗民情，了解泰國文化、思想、基本禮貌、泰國飲食習慣和泰國的重要節日。
4.奠定學生良好拼音基礎，持續學習泰語。

name.en: Development of global perspective: Vietnam culture and language II

description.zh: 在全球金融海嘯後，已開發國家經濟成長趨緩，新興亞洲國家-東協國家經濟成長迅速，本課程將以越南語教學為主，越南經貿、觀光文化及越語字母拼音教學，讓學生在學習越語的同時，深入了解越南文化，協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖。
description.en: This series of courses aim to provide students with opportunities to understand emerging markets in a global context. Global economy in the post-recession world relies heavily on emerging economies, in particular countries in Southeast Asia known as ASEAN. Seeing the greater potential for economic gains and development, we build up the courses from introducing the fundamentals, including but not limited to, their economy, culture, tourism and people with special emphasis on the use of the language for communication along with its relevance to Taiwan as a trading partner.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:日語與文化(一)

description.zh: 本課程提供學生養成基本日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life.In addition , using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

syllabi.outline:
我國與日本在經濟、學術、文化上之交流早已是不爭的事實。因此，
專業領域之外，如能再習得第二外國語文必定能擁有更大的競爭力。
從入門開始來了解日本的產業、經濟和文化，並探討日本在國際商場
上致勝的關鍵。並且藉由課程學習來加強日語的聽、說、讀、
寫之能力也是本課程追尋的目標。

共有2項作業
作業一:
每課之日語語法、發音發聲、句型應用講解後請學生利用相同句形做1對1或1對2、3之會話練習。

作業二:為加深印象與訓練日文書寫能力，每課內容必須做筆記。

name.zh: 國際觀培養:日語與文化(二)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Japanese Ⅱ

description.zh: 本課程為日語與文化(一)之進階課程，提供學生養成進階日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course is designed for students who has basic Japanese knowledge or who passed the language course: Japanese (I) in the previous term. This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life. In addition, using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:泰國文化與語言(二)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Thai culture and language II

description.zh: 課程以培養泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。
description.en: This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc.

syllabi.outline:
課程以培養泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。
This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc.
syllabi.schedule:
課程簡介
  以培養基礎泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構以泰國語言教學為主，搭配文化相關知識，使學生具備泰語溝通基本實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。不同於拉丁語系的拼音系統，泰語的字母、發音與拼字系統極為複雜，一般泰國母語人士亦需約二年時間才能完全熟記；本班透過獨創的泰語「四大結構及18種發音組合」教學，使同學於一個學年（上下兩個學期）內學會泰語字母、發音與拼字。此外，秉持聽、說、讀、寫同時並進的教學理念，由字母的發音、寫法、唸法、聲調、順序及拼字系統的學習開始，奠定良好的泰語基礎。每堂課除「字母、發音與拼字」的部份外，並將搭配「會話與聽力」部份，教授最常用的單字、句型、文法與日常實用會話，使學生快速學會簡單入門的日常生活泰語，增進學習泰語的成就感。本課程的設計，可使學生可於一年內學會拼寫、閱讀泰文句子，並能以泰語進行簡易日常對話。


課程目標
1.以培養和訓練學生具備泰語能力可以從事泰國往來工作或必須使用泰文為溝通語言為目標。
2.正確的指導字母發音與書寫方式，訓練學生書寫泰文字，針對單字同時進行聽、說、讀、寫的練習、在課堂中自然而然掌握泰語發音規則並累積字彙。
3.引導學生認識泰國文化歷史與風俗民情，了解泰國文化、思想、基本禮貌、泰國飲食習慣和泰國的重要節日。
4.奠定學生良好拼音基礎，持續學習泰語。

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline: This course intends to enhance students' reading and listening abilities by using English news reports selected from newspapers (e.g. New York Times and The Guardian), news magazines (e.g. Times and Newsweek) and online news websites (e.g. CNN Student News). It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Additionally, diverse forms of activities will be arranged to enable students to develop effective reading skills. This course is also designed to strengthen students' listening abilities through the use of video-audio materials from on-line news channels.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

Additionally, diverse forms of activities will be arranged to enable students to develop effective reading skills. This course is also designed to strengthen students' listening abilities through the use of video-audio materials from on-line news channels.

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

Attendance policy
You will automatically receive a grade of zero with 7 or more unexcused absences from Week 2 onwards. You may get an excused absence only upon presentation of a note of approval for leave from the university system to the Class Rep.

Group presentation:
You will form groups of 2 or 3 and present a current news event as reported by at least 3 news outlets and analyze the differences in reportage and reasons for and implications of these different perspectives. description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline:
本課程目標在引導學生了解可能改變世界的全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞。
This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

description.zh: 電控技術在現代工業應用中扮演著不可或缺的角色。因此，本課程的目的在使學生了解電控技術，其內容包括Matlab/Simulink軟體平台介紹、電控系統建模、分析與設計。
description.en: Electrical control technology plays an important role in modern industrial applications. Therefore, the purpose of this course is to introduce the technology to the students. The content includes Matlab/Simulink software platform, and electrical control system modeling, analysis and design.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為數值分析技術應用課程, 主要針對在職碩士專班以上之學生而設計。電控技術在現代工業應用中扮演著不可或缺的角色，但以往較專注於PLC程式或介面程式撰寫。因此，本課程的目的在使學生了解電控技術背後所需的數學方法與理論背景，其內容包括Matlab/Simulink軟體平台介紹、數值方法、類神經網路分析與設計。

name.zh: 專利資訊分析專題研究

description.zh:
近年來，經濟學家，社會科學研究人員，政策制定者，商人和專業人士已開始在中觀和宏觀層面上使用專利信息。這樣做是為了分析一個國家的國際化技術模式的專利活動;在某個部門，技術或公司中申請專利活動，以確定或預測技術變革的方向，或確定公司在市場中的相對技術地位;因此，專利信息的使用已經擴展到國家，機構或企業層面的許多不同的戰術和戰略業務，研究和政策制定活動。因此，本課程的主要目標
 通過發表論文審查，重點關注幾個領域的專利信息分析。
description.en: In recent years, economists, social science researchers, policymakers, businessmen and professionals have begun to make increasing meso-level and macro-level use of patent information. This is being done to analyze, for example, patenting activities of a country' technical patterns of internationalization; patenting activities in a sector, technology or company to ascertain or forecast the direction of technical change, or ascertain the relative technological position of a company in a marketplace; etc. As such, the use of patent information has expanded to many different tactical and strategic business, research, and policy making activities at national, institutional or enterprise levels. Therefore, the primary objective of present course focus on patent information analysis in several areas through papers review.

syllabi.outline:
In recent years, economists, social science researchers, policymakers, businessmen and professionals have begun to make increasing meso-level and macro-level use of patent information. This is being done to analyze, for example, patenting activities of a country' technical patterns of internationalization; patenting activities in a sector, technology or company to ascertain or forecast the direction of technical change, or ascertain the relative technological position of a company in a marketplace; etc. As such, the use of patent information has expanded to many different tactical and strategic business, research, and policy making activities at national, institutional or enterprise levels. Therefore, the primary objective of present course focus on patent information analysis in several areas through related cases study.
Furthermore, the student who would like participate the course should obey at least one of following two requirements: (1) He/She is a student of Graduate Institute of Intellectural property, or (2) He/She has taken at least one of the following courses, i.e. patent examniation guidelines I, II, design & intellectural property rights, patent portfolio and patent strategy, in the previous semesters.

description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
description.en: The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 本課程教授人工智慧技術的基礎理論與實務技巧，並對於人工智慧在製造業、服務業、金融業的應用，提供啟發性的基本認知與創意，以激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、工業 4.0、人工智慧的製造業應用個案、人工智慧的服務業應用個案、人工智慧的金融應用個案。
description.en: This course aims to teach students the basic concepts and practical techniques of artificial intelligence and to introduce its applications on manufacturing, service, and finance industries. The course focuses on inspring students for innovative artificial intelligence applications. The course includes: artificial intelligence basics, machine learn-ing, big data, deep learning, generative adversarial network, entrepreneurial thoughts, design thinking, business models, artificial intelligence and modern technologies, industry 4.0, real case applications on manufacturing, service, finance industries.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠：
1.	訓練研究生學術期刊論文研讀及講評能力
2.	論文研究計畫大綱撰寫
3.	論文發表口頭練習

description.zh: 本課程是教導學生金融科技的基本概念，使學生能夠建立金融科技的創新應用。內容包括:金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、P2P 匯兌、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財與期末專題製做。
description.en: This course is to instruct students the basic concepts of financial technology and to enable students to develop innovative applications of financial technology. The contents include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, P2P lending, virtual money, third-party payment, crowd funding, P2P remittance, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory.

syllabi.schedule:
1. 課程主題：人工智慧
課程內容包括：人工智慧簡介、人工智慧於金融之應用發展、人工智慧的風險與挑戰、人工智慧發展對金融產業發展衝擊、反思與影響

2. 課程主題：生物辨識技術
課程內容包括：生物辨識的緣起、生物辨識技術種類現況、導入何種最適生物辨識技術之評估、生物辨識在金融創新之運用現況與趨勢

3. 課程主題：保險科技創新模式及發展趨勢
課程內容包括：保險科技定義、保險科技簡介、保險科技之應用與發展、保險科技的影響與挑戰

4.課程主題：聊天機器人介面設計與AI 簡介
課程內容包括：什麼是人工智慧?人工智慧發展的歷史、聊天機器人介面設計、人工智慧應用與實作

5.業師專題演講：互聯網金融創新模式發展與應用
課程內容包括：互聯網金融定義、互聯網金融的應用、互聯網金融的發展趨勢及應用案例

6.課程主題：Blockchain(區塊鏈)的發展與應用
課程內容包括：區塊鏈定義、區塊鏈的形成、特性、制度類型、優點以及在金融上與商業上的應用

name.zh: 專利佈局與專利策略專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Patent Portfolio and Patent Strategy

description.zh: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利範圍解讀開始，熟悉專利的權利範圍，然後介紹專利策略以及佈局的方向，提供專利佈局與專利策略理論及實務經驗。本課程的綱要如下： 1.專利權利項解讀 2.專利侵權分析流程 3.專利迴避設計要件 4.專利策略分析 5.專利佈局實務 6.案例研究
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent claim interpretation, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用；值得強調的是，本課程內容完全與國考無關，係針對『專利技術分析』、『專利佈局』、『專利策略』與『科技管理』等主題作討論，故課程的設計會大量的閱讀相關外文文獻，所以份量頗重，預期每星期均會花很多時間閱讀paper與課堂討論，所以較適合未來擬以相關主題作為論文研究方向之同學修習。
syllabi.schedule:
主題一 (第1~4週):
PCT 專利系統、多國專利與檢索報告閱讀、國際專利家族與布局、國際專利申請策略。
主題二(第5~15週):
老師會在開學第一周提供約10幾篇papers供同學們閱讀，主題與下列有關
Patent strategy、Patent portfolio、Patent mapping、Patent quality、patent life cycle、Knowledge flows、patent classification
主題三 (第16~18週):
請同學在期初提出期末報告之proposal，並與老師討論，並在最後期末時進行期末報告。
syllabi.assessment: Term paper reports (45%)、Final reports (45%)、attendance(10%)

name.zh: 科技壟斷與公平交易法
name.en: Technology Monopoly and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 公平交易法是經濟憲法，也是維持市場交易秩序的根本大法。當現代企業與市場的結構愈趨複雜，公平交易法的角色也愈顯重要。本課程將以案例分析，帶領學生了解公平交易法的基本原則。最後，本課程將規劃呈現科技發展下的新興壟斷議題，帶領學生一起探討。
description.en: The Fair Trade Act is often considered as the economic constitution also a set of fundamental rules to maintain the order of market. This Act is getting more and more important in the modern economy while the market is getting more and more chaotic and complicated. This course is designed for students who intend to understand the principles of the Fair Trade Act by case studies, and who is interested to learn about emerging technology monopoly issues.
