description.zh: 研究生在教授的指導下，針對工業設計相關特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。其內容包括研究方法、理論分析及研究結果﹙含結論與建議﹚。本課程主要目的在提供學生開啟個人對於工業設計領域相關議題的獨立研究能力。因此，本課程將包含如何建構研究設計、寫作與參考文獻的能力。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

description.zh: 本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解環境工程與管理之最新理論,技術及最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the environmental engineering and management. Invited Speakers are well-known scholars in areas related to environmental engineering and management. Graduate students or thesis advisors are also invited to report research results of their graduate studies.

syllabi.outline:
課程中主要的訓練可分為三個方向：一、人為環境管理；二、自然環境管理；三、環境系統分析。在此規劃方向的考慮下，將會邀請專家學者進行相關主題的演講。參與者透過密集討論、書面報告、或舉行口頭發表等方式，可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的認識。
Three categories are stressed in these basic training courses: the management of human environment, the management of natural environment, and the system analysis towards environment.  Under the above goals, inviting addresses for special topics will be arranged though the courses.  The Participants are encouraged to have intensive discussion, written reports, or further oral presentation.  Efficient opinion exchange would be also expected to derive more extensive interest.

- 編譯器製作
- LLVM架構
- CLang
- 自訂自己程式語言的方法

程式規畫、實作，在這課程中比重相當大

description.zh: 設計是造就其所處時代和文化下的產物。它是社會共有的價值觀體現，但設計的思考過程也用於代表特定的概念，鼓勵某些活動，從而影響社會和文化。本課程介紹現代和後現代設計的時代精神，涉及的重要發展包括建築、平面設計、產品設計、家具設計、室內設計、數字設計，甚至商業設計。本課程提供理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理。
description.en: Design is a product of the period and culture in which it is created. It is a representation of values shared by society but also used to represent specific ideals, encourage certain activities, and thus influence society and culture. This course provides an introduction to the zeitgeist of Modern and Postmodern Design. It deals with the most important developments including architecture, graphic design, product design, furniture design, interior design, digital design, and even business design. This course provides the background needed for understanding the rich heritage of historical design in the arts, as influenced by political, religious, technological, cultural, climatic and geographic factors.

description.en:
This course introduces AI-related and data-processing applications in Python and VBA languages. The course content introduces the application and basic principles of neural
networks, deep learning, ChatGPT, Python/ VBA programming environments, flowcharts,code editing and debugging, and program structures such as fundamental input/output,sequence, condition, and loop to train students' essential ability of coding functions and subroutines.

description.en: Dynamical system representation and Modeling of Mechanical systems, Variational Principles Lagrange equation, Hamiltion Principles, System Analysis, System Identification and Application.

syllabi.outline: 機械動態系統及表示法、變分原理(Variational Principles)、Lagrange方程式、Hamilton原理、系統分析、迴歸性判別法、判別法則及選定、控制應用。
syllabi.schedule:
一、先修課程：大學部之基礎力學

二、簡介：本課程將介紹各種動態系統模型處理，及其模擬與分析方法。模型處理之方法中，包括：牛頓之向量法、Lagrange及Hamilton法等，而模擬之方式則是以電腦輔助模擬為主，特別是商用之工程CAE套裝軟體、MATLAB 與Mathematica等，都將在本課程中介紹。

三、教學目的與目標：本課程主要目的是以模型建構之為目標，以提供解決工程問題的模擬，同時也藉以該有效系統模型來預測系統之可能行為。因此，本課程除了提供學生一「自行建構有效的動態模型」之方法外，也提供系統之分析與判讀，以及能夠進一步應用到研究及實際工程上。

四、課程內容：
1.	前言與緒論：發展與演進
2.	座標系統及其轉換
	電腦輔助：應用Mathematica於座標轉換
3.	系統的負載效應及估計
	加速度、速度、位移及外力負載
	負載之估計與估算、實驗(optional) 
	常用之模型及CAE估算
4.	系統模型化處理
	模型處理的技法：離散化、抽象化、分離化、…
	數學表示法：運動方程式
	向量法、能量法
	系統延伸：MDOF
	非傳統模型(optional)
5.	電腦輔助動態分析、模擬及判別
	電腦輔助推導：Mathematica
	狀態方程式及建構
	等效線性化
	模擬方塊：Matlab SimuLink  
	Matlab programming 
6.	模擬結果表之示法
	State space, Time and Frequency domains etc. 
	模擬小程式之建構
7.	整合例題剖析與模擬
	Mechatronic problems

description.en:
To introduce the basic principle of the finite element analysis and its application in solving various types of engineering problems.
1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the finite element analysis
2. Formulation of the finite models through the use of variational principles
3. Shape functions and isoparametric elements
4. One dimensional problems: rod, truss, beam, frame, etc.
5. Two dimensional problems: plane stress, plane strain and plate, etc.
6. Three dimensional problems: typical solids
7. Implementation of the FEM computation by computer
8. Finite element applications in dynamic problems
9. Survey of some finite-element software systems

description.zh: 本課程預計搭配中國工業工程學會的「永續工程師」證照檢定考試做授課，由工程面與管理面探討淨零排放趨勢下，企業永續下工業工程所需具備的能力與知識。其中管理篇包括：企業永續發展、永續發展與氣候變遷風險管理、碳中和浪潮與因應之道、綠色供應鏈管理、永續金融、氣候相關財務揭露建議、資源永續與產業共生、與永續經濟決策分析。工程篇則包括：永續供應鏈設計、永續與能源政策、排放權交易與碳定價、綠色產品設計與評估、綠色物流與綠色冷鏈、產品服務系統、綠色聰明生產與循環經濟、清潔生產等理論與案例實務。
description.en: This course is designed to cover the knowledge and skills required for sustainable industrial in the context of net-zero emissions. It will be taught in conjunction with the "Sustainable Engineer" certification exam of the Chinese Institute of Industrial Engineers. The course will explore the topics from both engineering and management perspectives, focusing on sustainable enterprise development. The management chapters will cover a range of areas such as climate change, sustainable finance, green supply chain, carbon-neutral strategies, climate-related financial disclosure, resource sustainability, and industrial symbiosis, as well as sustainable economic decision analysis. Meanwhile, the engineering chapters will delve into topics such as sustainable supply chain design, energy policies, carbon pricing, green product design and evaluation, green logistics, product-service systems, green smart production, circular economy, and clean production theories and case studies.

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供創業和經營新創企業所需的基本知識和技能。 課程內容涵蓋當前各種形態的創業模式和創業家精神所具備的一些關鍵特質與必要的技能，學生將學習到如何識別市場機會並評估將想法商業化的可行性。本課程也將深入介紹行銷的核心概念與市場運作，包括市場細分，目標顧客定位和行銷組合，學生將學習到如何根據市場需求制定行銷策略並有效地實施。該課程還將涵蓋品牌策略、定價策略、推廣和銷售等主題。完成本課程後，學生將獲得關於創業以及經營企業的關鍵知識和技能，以及對行銷在創業過程中的作用有更深入的理解。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary to start and operate a new business venture. Students will learn about the various forms of entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship essentials, such as the characteristics, traits, and skills of successful entrepreneurs. Students will learn how to identify opportunities and assess the feasibility of a business idea. The course will then delve into the core concepts of marketing, including market segmentation, targeting, positioning, and the marketing mix. Students will learn how to develop a marketing plan and implement it effectively. The course will also cover topics such as branding, pricing strategies, promotion, and distribution. Upon completion of this course, students will have gained the knowledge and skills necessary to launch and operate a new business, as well as a deeper understanding of the role of marketing in entrepreneurship.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
國文，是運用本國語言文字，蘊釀於欣賞文藝作品，充實文化內涵，增進思維能力與人文素養的一門課程。
本課程分為大一上學期2學分，大一下學期2學分。大一上學期的授課內容，以文學名篇為範圍；希望藉此擴建學生深入品味文學趣味的能力，鍛鍊靈活的語文敏感度，默契文學創意，甚而嘗試創作。大一下學期的授課內容，以思想名篇為範圍；希望藉此啟發學生透轍分析各家學說思想，漫步哲人的宇宙天地，跟隨哲人的心路歷程，進而念茲在茲，從容內化，共饗取之不盡用之不竭的先驗與風範。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程介紹固體，尤其是半導體的光學性質，目的在了解光學檢測及光電元件的基礎原理。 藉由學習電磁波與半導體的交互作用，一方面可了解光在半導體中的產生、傳播、吸收、散射、及在界面的透射與反射等現象的規律，另一方面亦可認識光學特性與能帶結構、聲子結構、束縛與自由電子、及各種激發態之間的關係。課程內容包含固態物理複習、光學特性簡介、古典模型、帶間躍遷、激子、螢光現象、半導體低維系統的光學性質、自由載子及缺陷的光學性質、聲子相關特性、非線性光學性質等。
description.en: This course introduces the optical properties of solids, mainly semiconductors. The fundamental principles of absorption, reflection, luminescence and light scattering will be illustrated in terms of classical and quantum theories as appropriate. It mainly includes (1) Introduction (2) Classical propagation (3) Interband absorption (4) Excitons (5) Luminescence (6) Low-dimensional systems of semiconductors (7) Free electrons (8) Luminescence centers (9) Phonons (10)Nonlinear properties.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
材料機械性質是強調材料巨觀性質與材料微觀結構, 鍵結及晶體結構之間的關係, 是一門實務性,基本且重要的課程。它包括彈性, 塑性行為, 差排理論, 單晶與聚晶材料之塑性變形, 複合材料, 高溫聚晶材料之變形, 非晶質材料之永久變形, 材料強化機構, 材料破壞, 潛變與氫脆性等問題之討論。
description.en: This course deals with the mechanical behavior of materials. It emphasizes the relationship among macroscopic properties, material microstructure, and fundamental concepts of bonding and crystal structure. Contents of this course include the elastic and elastic behavior , dislocation , plastic deformation in single and polycrystalline materials ,strengthening mechanism of crystalline materials, composite materials, high temperature of crystalline materials ,fracture , fatigue and embrittlement.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en: Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 最近數年應用電腦軟體來計算分子的幾何形狀與力學數據已變得相當熱門，這些軟體不但計算小分子相當快速，即使是很複雜的分子也可行。本課程探討目前所常用軟體的原理、應用範圍、準確性與限制條件並舉數個例子來顯現其特點。
description.en: Within the last few years, computer programs have been developed which are based on force-field methods, allowing for fast calculations of the molecular geometry and dynamics of single molecules as well as more complex systems. This course is designed to provide a survey of the commonly used theoretical methods in dye chemistry,to discuss their scope and limitations, and to present some examples as illustrations of their advantages.

syllabi.outline: The progress of electronic industry accelerates the computer development so that computer simulation becomes one of the important tool in many fields. In this course, we will discuss how to apply the computer to assist the molecular structure design. In order to gain insight into the basic idea of structural design, the fundamental background in molecular mechanics, molecular dynamics, and quantum chemistry will be introduced. Some practical softwares will also be included in the course.  Each student has to prepare his personal notebook for practice each lecture.

description.zh: 本課程針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變）。
description.en: This course targets at the brief introduction to the fundamental principles, characteristics and application of the metal, ceramics, polymer and composite material. This course includes the crystal structure and defect, atomic diffusion of the solid materials, phase diagrams and phase transformation, material manufacturing process and application, the physic property (optical, electrical, magnetic and thermal property), mechanical property (strength, ductility, hardness, toughness, fatigue, and creep).

syllabi.outline: This course will introduce foundmental principle, property and application of materials including metal, ceramic, polymer and composite. Several topics will be discussed, including crystal structure, solidification, crystalline imperfections, atomic diffusion in solids, and basic mechanical properties.

description.zh: 本課程主要著重於讓學生瞭解在日常生活中，食衣住行育樂等活動與化學之相互關係。尤其對在生活中所接觸之食品、衣著、環境與用品應有所認識，並以化學觀點了解其與人體之關係。此課程主要內容包括(1)食品化學(Food Chemistry)，(2)衣著化學 (Cloth Chemistry)，(3)環境化學(Environmental Chemistry)，(4)核化學(Nuclear Chemistry)，(5)水化學 (Hydrochemistry)，(6)界面化學 (Interface Chemistry)，(7)家庭用化學品 (Household Chemicals)，(8)化粧品學(Cosmetic Chemistry)，(9)電化學 (Electrochemistry)
description.en: This course focuses on chemistry related to People`s Livelihood, including: Food Chemistry, Cloth Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Nuclear Chemistry, Hydrochemistry, Interface Chemistry, Household Chemicals, Cosmetic Chemistry, and Electrochemistry. Topics concerning about the manufacturing processes, application principles and recent developments of People`s Livelihood chemicals are also discussed in this course.

description.zh: 由介紹基本熱傳有關現象，配合熱力守恆有關公式之應用，討論各種熱交換環境下應考慮之因素，分析熱傳導、熱對流、熱輻射及相變熱傳之計算方法。並將要更深入地探討在各不同熱傳導系統內所可能形成之熱力分佈現象，以期學習者能以淺入深地對相關熱傳導系統工程設計上培養出最佳能力。
description.en: Introduction of basic heat transfer phenomena, using thermodynamic conservation equations to discuss the parameters under different heat exchange circumstances, heat conduction, heat convection, heat radiation and phase change are analyzed, discussion in depth on the heat transfer problems in application to cultivate heat transfer design capability.

name.zh: 現代性與建築名作研討
name.en: Seminar on Modernity and Architecture Masterpiece

description.zh:
現代性源自於歐洲獨有的歷史文化與社會，在工業化、理性化和民主化的推波助瀾下綻放開來，促使人們從神話、威權和中心性解放出來，擺脫傳統社會的制約。透過現代性的反證精神和批判性概念，歐洲幾乎於整個二十世紀初開展出驚人的物質和人類意識的進程。而建築的生產與整個社會、經濟、政治和審美價值緊密相關的專業，又是如何以自身作為對於現代性的批判?
本課程將以辨明現代性概念為主軸，透過阿道夫·魯斯(Adolf Loos)、西格弗里德·吉迪恩(Sigfried Giedion)、華特·班雅明(Walter Benjamin)、恩斯特·布洛赫(Ernst Bloch)、和威尼斯學派(Venice School)的論說作為理解現代性含混而艱澀的觀念，並藉由藝術和建築作品的探索，作為對於現代性的批判與理念的參照，包括前衛派藝術對於建築的衝擊、新巴比倫的城市景觀社會反論、建築的擬仿和批判等等。
description.en:
The term “Modernity” originated from the unique European history, culture, and societal condition, bloomed with the development of industrialization, rationalization and democratization. That have inspired human to liberate from mythology, authority and centrality, and get rid of the constraints of traditional society. With the antithesis and critical concepts of modernity, Europe has carried out an amazing progress of material and human consciousness almost throughout the twentieth century. How does architecture as a profession closely related to the entire society, economy, politics, and aesthetic approach, in the process of production implemented itself as a critique of modernity?
    In the beginning of the class, it would be most important to identify the concepts of Modernity. The discourses of Adolf Loos, Sigfried Giedion, Walter Benjamin, Ernst Bloch, and the Venetian School help to clarify the vague and difficult concepts of modernity. description.zh: 染顏料(色料)雖已發展百餘年，唯部分現象與實驗結果仍須進一步的研究以獲得完整正確的解釋。本課程主要探討染料的吸收光譜與其分子結構式的關係，是為具有色料化學與有機化學基礎的同學所設計的。
description.en:
Although studies on synthetic colourants have been performed for more than 100 years, their detailed elucidation requires further extensive research.
This course reviews the absorption features of organic dyes and recent progress in their explanation in terms of molecular structure. This course is mainly intended for organic chemists and colour chemists which are interested in the spectral characteristics of dyes and their conceptual understanding.

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh: 本課程欲讓應用英文系學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Global Issues and Trends
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Fall 2023
Course Description: 	This course aims to prepare students for collaborative participation in global activities by exploring global topics, issues and critical agenda of actions. In the process of cultivating engaged global citizens, the utmost task is to advance students’ understanding and critical evaluation of compelling evidence to apprehend the nature as well as complexity of issues and trend. With panoramic views of global agendas, comprehensive reviews of research studies, and social, cultural, political and economic assessments, global learning underscores collective awareness and brings in an analytical approach with emphasis on individuals’ global accountability, interconnectedness, and rigorous actions. More importantly, this current course provides the opportunity for students to be familiarized with the narrative / discourse style, language use and data description that will support their future pursuit for a global career. Reports adopted are available at major news outlets, research institutions and organizations.

Course Requirements: 	Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
(1)	Attending class regularly and to arrive on time (See Grading Policy)
(2)	Presentations and discussions 
i.	Students (w/ or w/o partners) can volunteer and/or will be conveniently selected to present on issues and topics through the infographics provided in reports with fully-elaborated explanations and analyses on data / concept exhibits. 
ii.	Students who prepare to give a presentation need to post handouts / study notes on Google Classroom a day before the scheduled presentation. 
iii.	Students are obligated to participate in class discussion by Q&A.
(3)	Quizzes will be administered at the instructor’s discretion, and will not necessarily be announced in advance. 
(4)	All student panelists videotape their sessions for further revisions. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings will be considered for extra credit bonus at the end of the semester.
Grading Policy: 	(1) Academic honesty is prioritized in this class. Plagiarism will not be tolerated. Students will fail the course without contention once an incident of plagiarism is identified in their work. 
(2) Final grades will be determined by a point system (X out of 100 total points). Students will be evaluated by their panel discussions, submitted materials and debates. (Adjustments will be made if necessary.)

(study notes and interactive feedbacks)	10% X 2 /3 = 20% / 30%
Quizzes 	20%

A university approved leave of document is accepted as one absence penalty waiver in the entire semester. AWOLs will be marked and entered into the penalty calculation if not corrected in two weeks of time, and lateness upon class dismissal.

1.	Research & analysis: understanding information introduced in the report and seeking additional support or discovering alternative or opposing studies; selection of important information from the report, with coherent and accurate presentation of such information in relation to other information /ideas in the reading and/or concerning issues in question; highly intelligible with exhibition of a sustained discourse 
2.	Content and structure: presenting a clear progression of ideas and conveying the relevant information required by task by providing and explaining substantive ideas and arguments in the reading; making necessary clarifications on facts and data introduced and critical analyses 
3.	Language use: demonstrating good control of basic and complex grammatical structures to allow coherent, efficient expression of ideas; using advanced and domain-specific and topic appropriate registers // Delivery and session management: speech being clear, concise, fluid and sustaining; maintaining the flow of discussions, stating and explaining ideas, arguments, facts and data as planned, asking and answering questions
4.	Study notes: clear and concise outline of content in the reading (report); language support, definitions of terms, and other useful information to enhance comprehension for ensuing discussion

description.zh: 本課程通過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性。 本課程將閱讀及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件和趨勢，培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en:
This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories.  Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.
The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

本課程通過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性。 本課程將閱讀及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件和趨勢，培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories.  Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.
The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

description.zh: 本課程以文化人類學的角度引導學生認識田野調查的發展背景，與當代社會科學研究中的應用現況。本課程分為田野調查相關理論介紹、田野調查的方法與倫理、大眾民族誌作品研讀與分析與田野調查實習三部份。透過基礎概念建立，搭配研讀相關作品，進一步思考田野調查之相關議題，最後依照擬定之田野調查場域或主題，進行實務操作練習，包含觀察、口訪與反思，並於期末進行分享與討論。
description.en: This course introduces the theories of anthropology and development of fieldwork as a research method. The ways to conduct a fieldwork are taught in the class, include participant observation and interview, and further, a practical workshop of fieldwork is offered, as an opportunity to practice fieldwork design, field observation and interview by students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程結合「漁村真本事－萬里野柳海岸地景保育與漁村文化永續」USR計畫，聚焦於漁村振興之議題。課程中教師教授田野調查之概念與技巧，以野柳漁村作為實習之場域，帶領學生進行野柳漁村的地方元素的調查和收集，包含產業面向及歷史文化面向，並進一步向地方耆老及達人進行深度訪談，以重新定位野柳的觀光發展方向。同時也引入ArcGIS業師團隊，協助學生自田野調查之所得，形塑新的地方觀光文化特色，進一步設計數位互動 StoryMaps，做為發展深度旅行的行動夥伴。
This course introduces the theories of anthropology and development of fieldwork as a research method. The ways to conduct a fieldwork are taught in the class, include participant observation and interview, and further, a practical workshop of fieldwork is offered, as an opportunity to practice fieldwork design, field observation and interview by students.

name.zh: 結合行動網路之無人戴具通訊技術
name.en: Integrating Unmanned Aerial Vehicle in Mobile Networks

description.zh: 本課程將講解無人戴具產業發展趨勢，介紹無人戴具通訊系統與網路以及滯空無人戴具裝載無線基地台之空中基地台應用的挑戰，並藉由空對地通道特性與通訊技術應用於無人機的實驗，了解無人載具通訊網路的最佳部署，課程內容包含：(1) 無人戴具系統簡介; (2) 無人飛行載具之點對點傳輸技術-軟體無線電實作; (3) 無人戴具空中基站; (4) 無人戴具通訊系統的性能分析-空對地通道特性與模型; (5) 無人載具與地面站之OFDM傳輸; (6) 無人戴具通訊網路的最佳部署
description.en: This course introduces the development trend of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) industry and explains the challenges of UAV communications and networks. With the experiment using air-to-ground channel characteristics, the software-defined radio-based experiment is designed for the transmission of UAVs and ground stations. The course includes: (1) introduction of UAV; (2) point-to-point transmission of UAV based on software-defined radio; (3) performance analysis of UAV systems - air-to-ground channel characteristics and models; (5) OFDM transmission of UAVs and ground stations; (6) optimal network deployment for UAV

description.zh: 本課程將引導學生了解語音辨識在人機互動應用上所牽涉的各種技術，包括語音訊號分析、音素/音節辨識、字詞辨識、連續語音辨識、語意辨識、語者辨識、語言辨識、語音合成等，其中也介紹動態時間伸縮與音高比對方法、隱藏式馬可夫模型、類神經網路與深度學習、語者與環境調適、語言模型等方法理論，配合「問題導向學習」之教學模式，進行分組討論、實作練習、企業參訪、與成果觀摩及報告，激發學生之創造與創新能力。
description.en: This course guides students to learn the techniques involved in the human-machine interaction based on speech recognition, including speech signal analysis, phoneme/syllable recognition, word recognition, continuous speech recognition, semantic recognition, speaker recognition, language recognition, speech synthesis. The theoretical fundamentals on dynamic time warping, hidden Markov model, neural network/deep learning, speaker and environment adaptation, language modeling, etc. are also introduced. In addition, the course is designed with the Problem-Based Learning (PBL) method, which includes  group discussion and collaboration on working projects, corporate visit, and project presentation, etc., so that students' capabilities of creativity and innovation can be developed or enhanced.

syllabi.outline: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) and multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) are popular transmission techniques for wireless and mobile communications, because they offer several advantages such as increasing transmission data rate and enhancing error performance. In the class, we will learn about the basic principles and some advanced topics of OFDM and MIMO. We will also learn how to write a MATLAB program to evaluate the performance of a communication system. All students taking this class have to study a special topic on OFDM or MIMO as a final project.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生認識中國及台灣本土的文學題材，熟悉各家的文學特色，進而懂得欣賞，並且能夠將之轉譯成文化符碼，靈活應用。然礙於文學作品繁多，課程時間有限，是以無法按照時間序，以史的方式一一介紹文學作品。是以為了避內容過於概論性或過於淺薄，本課程將以主題來進行教學。亦即依文類、時代、作家或風格來帶領同學由深而廣，逐漸培養同學賞析文學的能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to literary topics in China and Taiwan, familiarize them with the literary characteristics of various authors, and enable them to appreciate and translate them into cultural codes for flexible application. However, due to the vast number of literary works and limited course time, it is not possible to introduce literary works in a chronological or historical manner. Therefore, in order to avoid overly general or shallow content, this course will be taught thematically. That is, students will be guided from depth to breadth by literary genres, time periods, authors, or styles, gradually cultivating their ability to appreciate literature.

Course Outline:
Design methods, forced convection correlations for single phase heat exchange, pressure calculation, condensers and evaporators analysis, shell and tube heat exchanger analysis, compact heat exchanger analysis, wet coil analysis.
課程大綱：
本課程介紹熱能交換原理與熱交換相關之工程技術。使學生熟悉低溫熱交換中之分析熱效率、選擇材料之方法，及選用高效率熱交換器表面形狀之技術。內容包括：流力、熱交換基礎原理；氣冷式散熱鰭片分析、再生式熱交換器、管內與管集之單相熱傳、壓降計算；冷凝器、蒸發器等兩相熱交換器之設計；以及各種幾何變數、殼管式熱交換器之答拉瓦計算法、強化熱傳表面、鰭片管、熱傳表面積垢之問題與對策。

description.zh: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
description.en:
Introduction of Experiment and Measurement Method
Experiment is the essential tool for the research of science and engineering. The design of experiment and the analysis of data are the keys of the high quality of experiment. The course will introduce the materials of experiment and measurement. The procedures of measurement and the analysis method of data will be detailed investigated. And then the sensors to measure the interested physical parameters of pressure, temperature, flow rate and acoustic will be introduced. The technology of measurement and analysis of experiment will be built up in the course. The contents of the course are basic measurement, standards of measurement, dimension of measurement, access data, data presentation, accuracy and uncertainty of data, analog signal measurement, digital signal measurement, system response, and sensors.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的是介紹計算流體力學方法在工程上的應用，使學生能利用計算流力方法配合電腦的快速運算能力以解決工程上與能源、冷凍空調及熱流相關的問題。課程內容主要包括：計算流力簡介、基礎熱流方程式、紊流模式、有限差分法簡介、有限體積法簡介、套裝軟體應用以及案例分析。
description.en: The objective of this course is to introduce the engineering application of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Based upon the method of CFD and fast calculation ability of computers, students can solve related problems in the fields of energy, refrigeration and air-conditioning, and thermofluid sciences. The main content of this course includes "Introduction to CFD", "Foundation of thermofluid governing equations", "Turbulent models", "Introduction to finite difference method", "Introduction to finite volume method", "Application of package software", and "Case study".

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略：案例研析
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

syllabi.outline:
在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

description.zh: 本課程的設計，以培訓學生動手實作能力為核心，進而建構智能製造範疇的3D建模能力，培養學生未來在職場中的競爭力。綜合加法加工的3D成型列印技術與減法加工的CNC 3軸加工技術，結合國際市場上的通用專業軟體，進行系統化的單元講解，連結幾何物件，導入產業中常見的3D建模設計，再經由同學間的團隊合作，建構起完整的組合件產品。
description.en: The design of this course focuses on training students' hands-on ability, and then constructs 3D modeling ability in the field of intelligent manufacturing. The course teaches from the foundation of professional software to strengthening the integrated 3D and CNC 3-axis machining technology. The teaching objectives are fully introduced into the common 3D modeling design in the industry, and a complete product is constructed by encouraging teamwork among students.

syllabi.outline:
課程簡介
3 D建模與智能製造課程，讓學生透過親自動手實作學習知識與技能。課程引導學生認識自造者運動，以3 D列印應用與未來可能性為主體，透過一邊做一邊學習的方式，運用網路搜尋資源，認識現在的數位自造概念，然後能將自己的想法具體畫出，完成本課程後，有能力運用3D列印機輸出自己的作品。課堂以講授、小組討論、實際操作進行，同學也要“經常”上台簡單分享想法。

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授日語基礎語法，以期建立自學興趣與啟發閱讀日文資料之能力。前階段教授五十音、助詞、形容詞及動詞變化等基礎；後半階段將學習句型結構及產業界實務日文。本教學著重日語基礎之語法架構練習,學成後亦能自行取得日本新科技知識，廣泛應用於未來工作及日常生活中.語言是不斷的自我學習.與時俱進。

This course teaches Japanese basic grammar, in order to establish students' ability to read and understand Japanese technical articles. The first half of the course teaches Japanese syllabary, auxiliary words, adjectives and verb conjugations, and then introduces Japanese grammar structure, common sentence patterns, etc… Focusing on the concepts and methods necessary for Japanese reading so that students can still enhance themselves and apply in work and daily life to read instructions and manuals of equipment or products.

name.zh: 稀土在化工暨生物科技中的應用
name.en: Application of Rare Earths in Chemical Industry and Biotechnology

description.zh: 稀土是高科技產品必備元素且應用廣泛。本課程主要介紹稀土元素在化工、生物科技、生醫工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米科技、環境工程等諸多領域中的應用。除此，並探討台灣發展稀土產業因應對策。
description.en: Rare earths are essential elements in high-tech products and are widely used. This course mainly introduces the application of rare earth elements in chemical industry, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductor, nanotechnology, environmental engineering and many other fields. In addition, countermeasures for the development of Taiwan's rare earth industry will also be discussed.

syllabi.outline:

This course mainly introduces the application of rare earth elements in chemical industry, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductor, nanotechnology, environmental engineering and many other fields. In addition, countermeasures for the development of Taiwan's rare earth industry will also be discussed.

10-15 weeks：Insight into the application and importance of rare earth materials from patent documents 從專利看稀土材料的應用與重要性

name.zh: 科技新創事業與行銷策略
name.en: Technology Innovation Business and Marketing Strategy

description.zh: 本課程的設計，以科技新創事業的發展為目標，品牌的價值最大化為核心，進而設計與執行品牌之行銷方案，分析如何經營新創品牌的價值，與創造出在新創產業中的優勢品牌與品牌資產。結合行銷學的STP模型與SMART Strategy(睿智策略)，對本地與國際市場上的目標顧客，進行系統化的策略性行銷，連結顧客，經營通路上的成員與學習通路之設計，經由團隊合作，建構起良善通路的競爭優勢。本課程的教學模式，採用國立臺北科大經典的黑手工程師訓練模式，強調動手式的 OJT (On Job Training)。課堂上會有大量的實務型動手演練實作，下課後會有一定數量的作業與練習，透過此系統性訓練課程，將使學員(學生)具備微(小)型企業(工作室)的基本商業維運知識與能力。
description.en: The course is designed to target the development of Innovation Vocation, maximize the value of the brand as the core, and then design and implementation of brand marketing programs, analysis of how to operate a new brand value, and create a cultural industry in the advantages of brand and brand equity. To combine with the STP model of marketing and SMART Strategy, the target customers in the international market, the systematic strategic marketing, linking customers, managing the members in the channel and learning the channel design method. Use teamwork spirit to build the competitive advantage in the commercial channel. The teaching mode of the course: using the Taipei Tech classic Practice-Engineer training model, emphasizing the hands-on OJT (On Job Training) method. There will be a large number of hands-on exercises in the classroom, and a number of homework and exercises. After this course, students will have the basic business model knowledge and ability of micro-enterprises.

description.zh: 本課程將引導學生了解語音辨識在人機互動應用上所牽涉的各種技術，包括語音訊號分析、音素/音節辨識、字詞辨識、連續語音辨識、語意辨識、語者辨識、語言辨識、語音合成等，其中也介紹動態時間伸縮與音高比對方法、隱藏式馬可夫模型、類神經網路與深度學習、語者與環境調適、語言模型等方法理論，配合「問題導向學習」之教學模式，進行分組討論、實作練習、企業參訪、與成果觀摩及報告，激發學生之創造與創新能力。
description.en: This course guides students to learn the techniques involved in the human-machine interaction based on speech recognition, including speech signal analysis, phoneme/syllable recognition, word recognition, continuous speech recognition, semantic recognition, speaker recognition, language recognition, speech synthesis. The theoretical fundamentals on dynamic time warping, hidden Markov model, neural network/deep learning, speaker and environment adaptation, language modeling, etc. are also introduced. In addition, the course is designed with the Problem-Based Learning (PBL) method, which includes  group discussion and collaboration on working projects, corporate visit, and project presentation, etc., so that students' capabilities of creativity and innovation can be developed or enhanced.

name.zh: 結合行動網路之無人戴具通訊技術
name.en: Integrating Unmanned Aerial Vehicle in Mobile Networks

description.zh: 本課程將講解無人戴具產業發展趨勢，介紹無人戴具通訊系統與網路以及滯空無人戴具裝載無線基地台之空中基地台應用的挑戰，並藉由空對地通道特性與通訊技術應用於無人機的實驗，了解無人載具通訊網路的最佳部署，課程內容包含：(1) 無人戴具系統簡介; (2) 無人飛行載具之點對點傳輸技術-軟體無線電實作; (3) 無人戴具空中基站; (4) 無人戴具通訊系統的性能分析-空對地通道特性與模型; (5) 無人載具與地面站之OFDM傳輸; (6) 無人戴具通訊網路的最佳部署
description.en: This course introduces the development trend of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) industry and explains the challenges of UAV communications and networks. With the experiment using air-to-ground channel characteristics, the software-defined radio-based experiment is designed for the transmission of UAVs and ground stations. The course includes: (1) introduction of UAV; (2) point-to-point transmission of UAV based on software-defined radio; (3) performance analysis of UAV systems - air-to-ground channel characteristics and models; (5) OFDM transmission of UAVs and ground stations; (6) optimal network deployment for UAV

description.zh: 本課程內容包括邏輯閘的特性與功能測試，能利用積體電路完成各種基礎邏輯電路的組裝及設計，並能利用電子儀器進行量測、檢修。探討最佳化組合邏輯之演算法，可規劃邏輯元件，組合邏輯之VLSI設計，使用MSI與標準電路元件設計多層邏輯，使用閘陣列設計，循序邏輯之元件，循序邏輯之分析與合成，VLSI之設計與測試技巧，各種CAD軟體工具介紹。基礎邏輯閘實驗、組合邏輯實驗、加法器及減法器實驗、組合邏輯應用實驗、正反器邏輯實驗、循序邏輯電路應用實驗。

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

syllabi.outline:
系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

description.en: This course aims to provide students with electronics knowledge, to help the clinical application in the biomedical field, including capture the body's physiological parameters or for the treatment of human diseases. This course will introduce the medical electronic systems and electronic circuit theory, and then introduce the application of physiological measurement circuit. The circuit implementation so that students can experience the practical application of biomedical electronics category. Mainly on medical equipment and application of technical principles, which include measurement theory, biomedical sensors, electrodes and transducers, biomedical electronic amplifier, blood pressure and cardiovascular diagnostic equipment, respiratory therapy and pulmonary function measurement, brain and nerve system function measurement and treatment, electromagnetic interference with medical electronic equipment, and medical equipment electrical safety instructions and discussion. syllabi.outline:
本課程主要目的為使學生以電子學、訊號處理等相關的知識，應用在生物醫學的臨床領域，包含擷取人體的生理參數或用以治療人類疾病。本課程以模組化的課程設計，系統化地介紹以醫電系統為基礎的醫學量測設備與生醫訊號關聯及應用。介紹主題包含(1) 生醫感測設備原理和測量理論 (2) 血流與血壓量測原理和與應用 (3) 生理訊號量測與健康照護 (3) 生物聲學量測與應用 (4)電生理量測設備與量測(ECG、EMG、EEG) (5) 醫電安全性。

The main objective of this course is to enable students to apply knowledge in electronics, signal processing, and related fields to the clinical domain of biomedical science. This includes the extraction of physiological parameters from the human body or their application for the treatment of human diseases. The course employs a modular curriculum design and systematically introduces medical measurement devices and the correlation and application of biomedical signals based on biomedical electronic systems. The topics covered include: (1) Principles and measurement theories of biomedical sensing devices, (2) Principles and applications of blood flow and blood pressure measurement, (3) Physiological signal measurement and healthcare, (4) Bio-acoustic measurement and applications, (5) Electrophysiological measurement devices and measurements (ECG, EMG, EEG), and (6) Biomedical electrical safety.

description.zh: 本課程旨在經由對文化經濟學的認知，解讀文化經濟的發展邏輯與運行機制，建構文化經濟知識體系，期能為文化市場與文化產業發展提供理論基礎與思維座標。課程主要內容，一為在經濟邏輯運行下的文化活動，諸如文化產品、文化事業、文化資本、文化產業、文化市場等；另一為經濟活動所反映與體現的文化因素，以及對經濟運行產生作用的思維價值等。
description.en:
The course aims through awareness of cultural economics to interpret the development logic and operating mechanism of cultural economy and to construct a cultural economic knowledge system, and is expected to provide the theoretical basis and thinking coordinates for the development of cultural markets and cultural industries.
The main content of the course is economic logics underpinned cultural activities, such as cultural products, cultural business, cultural capital, cultural industries and cultural markets; on the other hand, cultural factors reflected and experienced by economic activities, as well as the value of thinking which plays an important role in economic activities.

syllabi.outline:
本課程涵蓋文化經濟理論與場域實作兩大面向，在構建文化經濟思維之同時，藉由具體的場域實作，導入真實的場域經濟議題，培養學生解決產業與社會複雜問題的實務能力，以因應未來職場所需跨界跨域整合能力之需求。

有別於一般多以傳統教室為教學場域的教育模式，本課程係以萬里野柳為實作場域，透過現地踏察與深度訪談，引導學生盤點場域在地的文化資源，著眼於漁村社區永續發展之利基，試圖開發場域文化品牌與經營模式，以建立萬里野柳漁村社區永續發展之基礎與共識，強化學生在文化傳承與文化永續之實踐力。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹有效研發/創新管理的概念、原則、與標準，這些概念、原則與標準將成為知識密集型的組織與企業的關鍵競爭優勢。本課程將介紹一些相關企業個案和練習活動，用以連結國家、產業和企業的研發或創新活動，並選定方法和工具進行有效的整合功能、企業業務、研發和創新活動。
description.en: This course is intended to introduce the concepts, principles, and standards for effective R&D/innovation management that is becoming the critical competitive advantages for the knowledge-intensive organizations and firms. The course will introduce a number of related cases and exercises with a view to bridge the national, industrial and corporate R&D/innovation activities, along with the presentation of selected approaches, methods and tools to effectively integrate functional, business and corporate R&D and innovation activities as a whole.

syllabi.outline:
本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
一、講授健康管理與終身運動觀念，讓學生從中學習參與，學習更多元化。
二、為提升健康體適能之實務課程，以自身的參與體驗來達到健康促進與疾病預防，了解健康適能觀念及方法。

本堂課程有申請教育部教學實踐計畫，並核可執行。因此本課程同時是教學實踐研究之課程。

The goal of the class is to develop the daily behavior to living environment attention and eventually promoting aesthetic standards in every profession. 
Class will include individual presentation and group discussion.

syllabi.outline:
介紹人體之形態特徵、心理期望、動作行為等人因知識，研究人因資訊應用於工業設計實務上之設計方法或準則以獲得具安全、效率與舒適之產品或環境設計。

This course is for students, researchers, and practitioners who design or evaluate products for their target user. It covers evaluation methodology for supporting human factor design for products, human-machine systems, software applications, games, and specialized appliances intended to be used by people. This field contains a substantial body of knowledge with regard to human factor design and the more narrowly scoped field of usability engineering (UE). Within these areas of practice, and the related research field of HCI, a host of methods are available for evaluating interactive products for user. This course provides an overview of a new and vibrant research field and exposes gaps in current methodologies that future research must address. We also hope it conveys our enthusiasm for this research area, where so much interesting work is taking place and so much still needs to be done.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

syllabi.outline:
壹、教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:提倡[健康存摺]的概念。從心、運動、基礎飲食、睡眠全方位自我照護。
藉由瑜伽之身心修持術，以探索、解放、覺醒、轉化以平衡身心與人生；再透過流動式運動展演體現身心美感；並經歷心靈圖卡遊戲，提升再造現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。配合對食物與保健食品正確飲用，充分幫助身心得到恢復及休息。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)瑜伽(Yoga)與抗力球(Stability Ball ):
*藉由基礎瑜伽體位法配合抗力球運行，加上呼吸法將身心靈連結在一起，產
生之專注力以提升覺察與覺知能力，並體悟身心變化。
*增進肢體柔軟度，達到身心放鬆與休息，產生身體上新的自由，並能體現於
生活中。
*增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二)抗力球( Stability Ball )
其特性因充氣球體使支撐表面不穩定，需要徵招更多肌群來幫助維持平衡，
除了運用於重量訓練、核心肌群訓練，同時還可建立良好的神經肌肉控制，
增進本體感覺能力與動作協調性，是一項多元又有趣的身心鍛鍊器材。
(三)流動抗力球之舞 (Dance of Mobile Stability Balls)
*體驗流動抗力球運動並能展演:從學習抗力球肌肉控制與柔軟度中，發展肢
體美感。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能
力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
(四)心靈圖卡/OH CARDS (One of Meditation)/人生探索與自我覺察
*藉由 OH 卡來瞭解生命課題、內我的訊息與物質實相。知識從外在轉向內在，從內心得到答案。使意識向內關照，可以有清明的立足點看懂實際事件。
(五)基礎食品營養與健康
了解如何均衡營養與膳食、如何補充保健食品，讓身體得到充分的能量。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
*提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

syllabi.assessment:
參、評量方式
一、術科技能 40%
(一)期中測驗 15% :肢體協調性、反應性、記憶力及專注力測試。或心靈圖卡創作表達。
(二)期末舞作成果展:個人表現 15%與團體合作 10%。
二、出勤考核 50%
(一)學習態度 30%
1.服裝儀容，著適宜之運動服裝。
2.安全考量，長髮者勿披頭散髮及不要穿戴飾品，亦影響自己與他人活動。
3.未經老師許可切勿使用手機，並關靜音。
4.遠距教學自主學習作業繳交情況。
(二)出缺席狀況 20%
1.一次曠課扣總成績 5 分。
2.遲到 30 分以上，無特殊原因者曠課論。
3.事病假以學校正式請假為主，超過三次以上依情況扣總成績 1-5 分。
三、學科 10%:表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀之學習心得報告。
 *上傳至【TEAMS】數位教學平台

肆、課程注意事項 
一、課程第一要點：身心安全第一！
上課當日有任何身心不適的狀況，請務必馬上告知教師。
二、請穿著適合運動的服裝，如 T-Shirt、運動長褲；切勿穿著帽 T、牛仔褲或時裝，戴金屬尖銳飾品；長髮者請勿披頭散髮將頭髮束起，以運動時危險。
三、請自備水與毛巾。
四、未經老師許可切勿使用行動電話。進教室，請關靜音。
五、請將鞋、襪、書包至於教室鐵櫃擺放整齊。
六、請準時上課，若無法前來上課，請事先告知，除緊急情況或突發事件例外，並依規定完成請假手續。
七、每堂課皆會點名，每位學生出席狀況將會詳實紀錄。網路請假，請於下一堂上課時提出證明。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

syllabi.outline:
壹、教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:提倡[健康存摺]的概念。從心、運動、基礎飲食、睡眠全方位自我照護。
藉由瑜伽之身心修持術，以探索、解放、覺醒、轉化以平衡身心與人生；再透過流動式運動展演體現身心美感；並經歷心靈圖卡遊戲，提升再造現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。配合對食物與保健食品正確飲用，充分幫助身心得到恢復及休息。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)瑜伽(Yoga)與抗力球(Stability Ball ):
*藉由基礎瑜伽體位法配合抗力球運行，加上呼吸法將身心靈連結在一起，產
生之專注力以提升覺察與覺知能力，並體悟身心變化。
*增進肢體柔軟度，達到身心放鬆與休息，產生身體上新的自由，並能體現於
生活中。
*增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二)抗力球( Stability Ball )
其特性因充氣球體使支撐表面不穩定，需要徵招更多肌群來幫助維持平衡，
除了運用於重量訓練、核心肌群訓練，同時還可建立良好的神經肌肉控制，
增進本體感覺能力與動作協調性，是一項多元又有趣的身心鍛鍊器材。
(三)流動抗力球之舞 (Dance of Mobile Stability Balls)
*體驗流動抗力球運動並能展演:從學習抗力球肌肉控制與柔軟度中，發展肢
體美感。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能
力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
(四)心靈圖卡/OH CARDS (One of Meditation)/人生探索與自我覺察
*藉由 OH 卡來瞭解生命課題、內我的訊息與物質實相。知識從外在轉向內在，從內心得到答案。使意識向內關照，可以有清明的立足點看懂實際事件。
(五)基礎食品營養與健康
了解如何均衡營養與膳食、如何補充保健食品，讓身體得到充分的能量。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
*提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

syllabi.assessment:
參、評量方式
一、術科技能 40%
(一)期中測驗 15% :肢體協調性、反應性、記憶力及專注力測試。或心靈圖卡創作表達。
(二)期末舞作成果展:個人表現 15%與團體合作 10%。
二、出勤考核 50%
(一)學習態度 30%
1.服裝儀容，著適宜之運動服裝。
2.安全考量，長髮者勿披頭散髮及不要穿戴飾品，亦影響自己與他人活動。
3.未經老師許可切勿使用手機，並關靜音。
4.遠距教學自主學習作業繳交情況。
(二)出缺席狀況 20%
1.一次曠課扣總成績 5 分。
2.遲到 30 分以上，無特殊原因者曠課論。
3.事病假以學校正式請假為主，超過三次以上依情況扣總成績 1-5 分。
三、學科 10%:表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀之學習心得報告。
 *上傳至【TEAMS】數位教學平台

肆、課程注意事項 
一、課程第一要點：身心安全第一！
上課當日有任何身心不適的狀況，請務必馬上告知教師。
二、請穿著適合運動的服裝，如 T-Shirt、運動長褲；切勿穿著帽 T、牛仔褲或時裝，戴金屬尖銳飾品；長髮者請勿披頭散髮將頭髮束起，以運動時危險。
三、請自備水與毛巾。
四、未經老師許可切勿使用行動電話。進教室，請關靜音。
五、請將鞋、襪、書包至於教室鐵櫃擺放整齊。
六、請準時上課，若無法前來上課，請事先告知，除緊急情況或突發事件例外，並依規定完成請假手續。
七、每堂課皆會點名，每位學生出席狀況將會詳實紀錄。網路請假，請於下一堂上課時提出證明。

name.zh: 生成式人工智慧於企業實務之應用
name.en: Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Enterprise Practice

description.zh: 隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
description.en: This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.schedule:
AI在製造業中應用：

1. 生產線監控：如產品質量、生產速度、裝配情況等。通過即時警報和提示，幫助管理人員快速識別並解決問題，從而提高生產效率和產品質量。

2. 故障診斷：通過學習和分析過往的故障記錄和維修日誌，來預測和診斷可能出現的問題。

3. 智能物流管理：根據訂單數量、貨物種類和目的地等信息，自動安排最佳的運輸路線和物流方案。

4. 設備維護：通過收集和分析設備的運行數據和故障記錄，預測設備可能出現的故障，並提供相應的維護建議。

5. 品質控制：在生產過程中收集和分析產品的質量數據，以檢測和預防可能出現的缺陷和問題。

syllabi.outline:
壹、教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:提倡[健康存摺]的概念。從心、運動、基礎飲食、睡眠全方位自我照護。
藉由瑜伽之身心修持術，以探索、解放、覺醒、轉化以平衡身心與人生；再透過流動式運動展演體現身心美感；並經歷心靈圖卡遊戲，提升再造現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。配合對食物與保健食品正確飲用，充分幫助身心得到恢復及休息。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)瑜伽(Yoga)與抗力球(Stability Ball ):
*藉由基礎瑜伽體位法配合抗力球運行，加上呼吸法將身心靈連結在一起，產
生之專注力以提升覺察與覺知能力，並體悟身心變化。
*增進肢體柔軟度，達到身心放鬆與休息，產生身體上新的自由，並能體現於
生活中。
*增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二)抗力球( Stability Ball )
其特性因充氣球體使支撐表面不穩定，需要徵招更多肌群來幫助維持平衡，
除了運用於重量訓練、核心肌群訓練，同時還可建立良好的神經肌肉控制，
增進本體感覺能力與動作協調性，是一項多元又有趣的身心鍛鍊器材。
(三)流動抗力球之舞 (Dance of Mobile Stability Balls)
*體驗流動抗力球運動並能展演:從學習抗力球肌肉控制與柔軟度中，發展肢
體美感。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能
力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
(四)心靈圖卡/OH CARDS (One of Meditation)/人生探索與自我覺察
*藉由 OH 卡來瞭解生命課題、內我的訊息與物質實相。知識從外在轉向內在，從內心得到答案。使意識向內關照，可以有清明的立足點看懂實際事件。
(五)基礎食品營養與健康
了解如何均衡營養與膳食、如何補充保健食品，讓身體得到充分的能量。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
*提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

syllabi.outline:
壹、教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:提倡[健康存摺]的概念。從心、運動、基礎飲食、睡眠全方位自我照護。
藉由瑜伽之身心修持術，以探索、解放、覺醒、轉化以平衡身心與人生；再透過流動式運動展演體現身心美感；並經歷心靈圖卡遊戲，提升再造現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。配合對食物與保健食品正確飲用，充分幫助身心得到恢復及休息。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)瑜伽(Yoga)與抗力球(Stability Ball ):
*藉由基礎瑜伽體位法配合抗力球運行，加上呼吸法將身心靈連結在一起，產
生之專注力以提升覺察與覺知能力，並體悟身心變化。
*增進肢體柔軟度，達到身心放鬆與休息，產生身體上新的自由，並能體現於
生活中。
*增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二)抗力球( Stability Ball )
其特性因充氣球體使支撐表面不穩定，需要徵招更多肌群來幫助維持平衡，
除了運用於重量訓練、核心肌群訓練，同時還可建立良好的神經肌肉控制，
增進本體感覺能力與動作協調性，是一項多元又有趣的身心鍛鍊器材。
(三)流動抗力球之舞 (Dance of Mobile Stability Balls)
*體驗流動抗力球運動並能展演:從學習抗力球肌肉控制與柔軟度中，發展肢
體美感。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能
力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
(四)心靈圖卡/OH CARDS (One of Meditation)/人生探索與自我覺察
*藉由 OH 卡來瞭解生命課題、內我的訊息與物質實相。知識從外在轉向內在，從內心得到答案。使意識向內關照，可以有清明的立足點看懂實際事件。
(五)基礎食品營養與健康
了解如何均衡營養與膳食、如何補充保健食品，讓身體得到充分的能量。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
*提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

description.en: Gamification is a technique that can stimulate users’ motivation and engagement in various non-game contexts such as education, business, health, workplace, and so on. This course is divided into two parts. The first part provides the theoretical background, consisting of the gamification definition/taxonomy, and behavioral design. In the second part of this course, students will organize a participatory design workshop to gain insights from the stakeholders to develop delightful products and services based on game mechanics.

name.en: Implementation of Business Operation Efficiency Analysis

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於讓同學們瞭解經營績效評估的方法，強調理論與實作並重。首先會介紹資料包絡分析法(DEA)的基本概念，讓同學們對於DEA理論有基本的瞭解，接下來再讓同學們學習如何使用電腦套裝軟體進行實際運算，並探討各種企業經營效率分析上的應用。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to let students understand the methods of business performance evaluation, emphasizing both theory and practice. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic concept of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) so that students can understand DEA theory. Then students will learn how to use computer-packaged software for actual calculations and discuss the application of various business efficiency analyses.

name.en: MySQL for Data Analytics and Business Intelligence

description.zh: 根據 Kaggle Survey2020（全球資料科學家調查），SQL在資料科學家使用的程式語言中，排名第二，僅次於 Python。SQL 是用來查詢與操作資料庫的語言，是數據分析與商業智能的重要工具。本課程以mySQL資料庫為對象，來學習關聯式資料庫的操作與各種SQL語法，它是整體商業智能分析體系的重要技術。在現代商業智慧領域，經常利用SQL資料庫、雲平臺和機器學習等新技術，將資料轉換為有用的見解，提出解決方案以改進企業決策，其應用包括零售葉在內的各種經營管理領域。本課程將幫助同學具有SQL分析數據的能力，此將有助於後續做好商情預測，提出改善方案以輔助企業能抓住市場脈動，進而分析消費者的需求。
description.en: According to Kaggle Survey2020, SQL ranks second among the programming languages used by data scientists, second only to Python. SQL is a language used to query and operate databases, and is an important tool for data analysis and business intelligence. This course takes the mySQL database as the object to learn the operation of the relational database and various SQL syntax, which is an important technology of the overall business intelligence analysis system. In the field of modern business intelligence, new technologies such as SQL databases, cloud platforms, and machine learning are often used to convert data into useful insights and propose solutions to improve corporate decision-making. It is applied to various business management fields including retail leaflets. This course will help students have the ability to analyze data with SQL, which will help to make good business forecasts in the future, propose improvement plans to assist enterprises to grasp the pulse of the market,

syllabi.outline:
資料庫系統與應用課程的目的在研習資料庫設計與管理技術及其在企業的應用。本課程方向包括：資料庫管理系統架構、關聯式資料模式、關聯式資料庫設計理論、關聯查詢最佳化、關聯式資料庫管理系統：以mySQL為例，以實務性方式，培養學生對資料庫系統設計開發之能力。
The objective of this course is to study the techniques of how to design and manage a database system. The topics contained in this course are: database system structure, relational database, E-R model, relational database design, query optimization, relational database management system-MS SQL Server etc. After studying this course, students should be able to design databases and manage database systems.
syllabi.schedule:
chp0.課程簡介
chp1.數據分析的內容包括哪些？
chp2.四種MySQL資料庫的安裝與使用方式：MySQL套件，WorkBench，Azure MySQL，python
chp3.Pyhon讀取SQL資料庫，常用查詢，計算（條件查詢，關鍵字查詢，排序查詢，定點取值）
chp4.生成新的欄位1:基本數學計算，日期取值，字串截取
chp5.生成新的欄位2：CASE...WHEN...THEN...ELSE...END
chp6.子查詢Subquery有四種類型（用到2個查詢，先查詢1，再拿它來查詢另外2）
chp7.資料表的3種合併：水平合併JOIN，垂直合併UNION，關聯合併JOIN(相關欄位合併)
chp8.分群分析，頻數分析，分1群，分2群，交叉分析，樞紐分析
chp9.View檢視表：已經被預處理的資料表，是第2種的資料表(虛擬資料表，視圖(SQL View))

chp13.設定索引鍵Index，資料量很大時才需要設定Index(可以提高資料庫查詢的效率)
chp14.SQL資料視覺化與商業智能，第1種方法：python視覺化
chp15.SQL資料視覺化與商業智能，第2種方法：Power BI，tableau
chp16.建立雲端主機的SQL資料庫
chp17.MySQL資料的『新增，修改，刪除』

description.zh: 建立一個商務網站包括前端網頁與後端伺服器網頁，本課程將介紹前端網頁設計的方法，包括CSS,HTML,JavaScript。網頁的基本框架是Html標籤語法，網頁的樣式設計是CSS的樣式設計，網頁的互動效果是透過JavaScript程式來達成的。由於JavaScript容易理解的特性，史丹佛大學已經將JavaScript取代Java，成為程式設計的入門教材 本課程也會介紹目前網頁的主流：響應性網頁RWD(bootstrap)的設計方法。
description.en: Building a business website includes front-end web pages and back-end server web pages. This course will introduce the methods of front-end web page design, including CSS, HTML, and JavaScript. The basic framework of a webpage is the syntax of Html tags, the style design of the webpage is the style design of CSS, and the interactive effect of the webpage is achieved through JavaScript programs. This course will also introduce the current mainstream of web pages: the design method of responsive web RWD (bootstrap).

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹網站架設與前後端網頁設計，內容包括：網站架設，前端網頁設計(html,javascript)，後端網頁設計(php,mySQL資料庫)，學習目前網頁的主流，進階階網頁設計：響應性網頁RWD(bootstrap)。以及網站架設實務，包括：申請網站空間，自行架設網站的2種方法，申請網域名稱。
  學習html將有助於後續課程的應用，包括：(1).可以處理商業數據截取，經常必須要爬取網路數據，所以必須懂html語法。(2).網頁html的TDK有助於搜尋引擎的SEO排名，SEO是搜尋引擎優化的簡寫，是為了讓網站的搜尋排名變好，提升網站的能見度與流量，進而創造轉單與業績。
  學習javascript將有助於後續課程的應用包括：處理第1方第3方的網站流量分析，這些都必須有能力置入javascript代碼，才能追用戶的使用趨勢，以改進網站流量與行銷。另外Google流量分析證照GA，也要在網頁置入javascript，才能追流量。
  學習目前商業網站的整體架構，包括：前端網頁的技術(html＋javascript)，與後端網頁(資料庫網頁)技術(PHP＋mySQL)，最後將有能力製作自訂的ERP系統
This course will introduce website construction and front-end and back-end web design, including: website construction, front-end web design (html,javascript), back-end web design (php,mySQL database), learning the mainstream of current web pages, advanced web design : Responsive web page RWD (bootstrap). And the practice of setting up a website, including: applying for a website space, two ways to set up a website by yourself, and applying for a domain name (Domain Name).
  Learning html will help the application of subsequent courses, including: (1). Can handle commercial data interception, often must crawl network data, so you must understand html grammar. (2). The TDK of the web page html is helpful to the SEO ranking of the search engine. SEO is the abbreviation of Search Engine Optimization (Search Engine Optimization), which is to improve the search ranking of the website, improve the visibility and traffic of the website, and create conversions. Orders and performance.
  The applications that learning javascript will help subsequent courses include: dealing with 1st party and 3rd party website traffic analysis, all of which must be able to insert javascript codes in order to track user usage trends to improve website traffic and marketing. In addition, Google traffic analysis certificate GA, also need to put javascript in the webpage to track the traffic.
  Learn the overall structure of the current commercial website, including: front-end web technology (html,javascript), and back-end web (database web) technology (PHP,mySQL), and finally have the ability to create a customized ERP system

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域商情預測之應用
name.en: The Application of Artificial Intelligence on Business Forecasting

description.zh:
本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種商情預測的技應用，做好商情預測有利於確保企業發展方向的正確性，也能讓企業更能抓住市場脈動而滿足消費者的需求不會造成太多的庫存堆積，保持市場供需的動態平衡。
本課程規劃所欲培育人才所需之教學目標包括：
（1）學生有能力使用python寫各種商業智能程式，包括使用pandas模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。使用numpy，sklearn機器學習模組來處理迴歸分析問題。使用keras模組來進行深度學習的商業預測應用。
（2）實作多種商情預測專題。
description.en:
This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business forecasts to help students understand the current status of various applications of AI in business forecasts.
The teaching objectives required for cultivating talents in this course planning include:
(1) Students are able to use python to write various business intelligence programs, including using pandas modules for business data analysis and visualization. Use numpy, sklearn machine learning module to handle regression analysis problems. Use keras modules for business forecasting applications of deep learning.
(2) Implement a variety of business forecast topics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種商情預測的技應用，做好商情預測有利於確保企業發展方向的正確性，也能讓企業更能抓住市場脈動而滿足消費者的需求不會造成太多的庫存堆積，保持市場供需的動態平衡。
本課程規劃所欲培育人才所需之教學目標包括：
（1）學生有能力使用python寫各種商業智能程式，包括使用pandas模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。使用numpy，sklearn機器學習模組來處理迴歸分析問題。使用keras模組來進行深度學習的商業預測應用。
（2）實作多種商情預測範例，包括：電商數據分析、市場佔有率分析、市場趨勢分析、細分市場分析、消費者需求分析、店鋪數據化運營的SEO關鍵字詞根與統計、商品推廣方案分析、競品分析、銷售預測、庫存預測。

This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business forecasts to help students understand the current status of various applications of AI in business forecasts.
The teaching objectives required for cultivating talents in this course planning include:
(1) Students are able to use python to write various business intelligence programs, including using pandas modules for business data analysis and visualization. Use numpy, sklearn machine learning module to handle regression analysis problems. Use keras modules for business forecasting applications of deep learning.
(3) Implement a variety of business forecast topics.
syllabi.schedule:
第1週：人工智慧跨域商情預測各種應用的內容與現況，包括：市場需求預測、市場供應預測、市場供求動態預測、企業市場佔有率預測、以及市場價格預測等。

第2週：人工智慧第1步：資料分析之數據截取與查詢（pandas-1）
第3週：數據處理基礎練習，及數據的3種格式：DataFrame，array矩陣，list串列數組
第4週：人工智慧的基礎與數學理論
第5週：人工智慧第2步：機器學習：使用numpy模組來學迴歸分析
ptyhon人工智慧『簡易3步驟』程式寫法(簡易基礎13題)

第6週：機器學習：使用sklearn模組來建立線性/非線性迴歸模型
ptyhon人工智慧『入門6步驟』程式寫法(入門13題，加上:評估model好壞，驗證overfitting，關聯度)

第7週：機器學習：使用sklearn模組來建立多元線性迴歸模型
資料集的視覺化(3種方法)
第8週：期中考
第9週：分類問題的機器學習：建立『邏輯斯模型(logistic regression model)，KNN模型』來預測二元分類問題
第10週：建立『決策樹，隨機森林，支持向量機算法』來預測二元分類問題
第11週：集群分析/分群分析，建立『K-means分群』模型來把『自動分群』
第12週：降維簡化分析(dimension reductoin)，建立『主成份分析PCA』降維模型，來把特徵參數簡化降維
第13週：人工智慧第3步：深度學習：使用keras模組來進行人工智慧預測
第14週：資料預處理，標準化(Standardization), 特徵縮放scaler
第15週：用管道器封裝中間的全部流程：(x-->【管道器pipeline】-->y)
第16週：8種特徵選取feature selection方法
第17週：專案實作：消費者需求分析，用戶流失預測，銷售預測、庫存預測
第18週：期末考

name.zh: 企業經營效率分析實作
name.en: Implementation of Business Operation Efficiency Analysis

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於讓同學們瞭解經營績效評估的方法，強調理論與實作並重。首先會介紹資料包絡分析法(DEA)的基本概念，讓同學們對於DEA理論有基本的瞭解，接下來再讓同學們學習如何使用電腦套裝軟體進行實際運算，並探討各種企業經營效率分析上的應用。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to let students understand the methods of business performance evaluation, emphasizing both theory and practice. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic concept of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) so that students can understand DEA theory. Then students will learn how to use computer-packaged software for actual calculations and discuss the application of various business efficiency analyses.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的目的在於讓同學們瞭解經營績效評估的方法，強調理論與實作並重。首先會介紹資料包絡分析法(DEA)的基本概念，讓同學們對於DEA理論有基本的瞭解，接下來再讓同學們學習如何使用電腦套裝軟體進行實際運算，並探討各種企業經營效率分析上的應用。
The purpose of this course is to let students understand the methods of business performance evaluation, emphasizing both theory and practice. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic concept of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) so that students can understand DEA theory. Then students will learn how to use computer-packaged software for actual calculations and discuss the application of various business efficiency analyses.
syllabi.schedule:
以六個單元為主：
1 課程簡介、師生認識與分組（Course introduction）
2 An introduction to efficiency and productivity analysis
3  Productivity and Efficiency Measurement concepts
4  Efficiency Measurement Using Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA)
5 DEA 軟體操作示範
6 期刊文章選讀(基本DEA在金融業的應用)

description.zh: 透過我國金融體系與相關金融證券交易法規之概述，促使學生瞭解銀行法、證券交易法、信託法與信託業法、金融機構合併法、金融監理一元化等法規之性質、內容、立法目的及原則，進而培養學生明瞭本國有價證券之發行程序、證券交易市場以及證券交易法之責任規範等立法精神與體制，俾能達到融會貫通的境界並因應未來金融市場之競爭與挑戰。
description.en: The objectives of this course are trying to explain Taiwan's financial system and Financial and Securities Exchange Act, to help students recognize the Banking Act, the Securities and Exchange Law, Trust Law and Trust Business Law, Financial Institutions Merger Act, the financial supervision unification. In addition, the nature, content, lawmaking objectives and principles of related legislation will be introduced. The goals of this course will further promote students to understand the procedures for issuing securities, the spirit, responsibility and institutional norms of securities market and the Securities Exchange Act, so that to achieve the state of digest, in response to market competition and financial challenges in the future.

syllabi.outline:
透過我國金融體系與相關金融證券交易法規之概述，促使學生瞭解銀行法、證券交易法、信託法與信託業法等法規之性質、內容、立法目的及原則，進而培養學生明瞭本國有價證券之發行程序、證券交易市場以及證券交易法之責任規範等立法精神與體制，俾能達到融會貫通的境界並因應未來金融市場之競爭與挑戰。
The objectives of this course are trying to explain Taiwan's financial system and Financial and Securities Exchange Act, to help students recognize the Banking Act, the Securities and Exchange Law, Trust Law and Trust Business Law, Financial Institutions Merger Act, the financial supervision unification. In addition, the nature, content, lawmaking objectives and principles of related legislation will be introduced. The goals of this course will further promote students to understand the procedures for issuing securities, the spirit, responsibility and institutional norms of securities market and the Securities Exchange Act, so that to achieve the state of digest, in response to market competition and financial challenges in the future.

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作﹐包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段﹐避免口語用字寫字的陋習﹐使所作之文章能掌握其涵意﹐亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

(1)上課請於簽到本內親簽名座位表，請勿代簽。

(3)整學期繳交六次手寫 300 字稿紙之心得報告（字稿紙手寫寫滿， 不用刻意空行），並將報告拍照成 pdf檔或 jpg檔，於上課當日至隔日下午17 點前(第三周開始)，上傳至網路 i 學園，完成簽名&報告即得總成績 5 分。 
(4) 心得報告繳交除6次外，每多寫一份加總成績 3 分，至多可多繳三份報告。
(5) 上課後一周內，由主持邀請老師之研究室同學製作心得檔案，於中走廊張貼海報，檔案經指導教授審閱修正後，請將電子檔傳楊先生信箱，製作同學將總成績另行加分。
二、請假規則：（於系網列印填寫專討用請假單）

(2)病假：請於事後一周內填妥請假單，並檢附就診證明，請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。

(6)本學期欲提出寒畢同學，需事先登記上台報告論文，方能申請提出口試。

name.en: MySQL for Data Analytics and Business Intelligence

description.zh: 根據 Kaggle Survey2020（全球資料科學家調查），SQL在資料科學家使用的程式語言中，排名第二，僅次於 Python。SQL 是用來查詢與操作資料庫的語言，是數據分析與商業智能的重要工具。本課程以mySQL資料庫為對象，來學習關聯式資料庫的操作與各種SQL語法，它是整體商業智能分析體系的重要技術。在現代商業智慧領域，經常利用SQL資料庫、雲平臺和機器學習等新技術，將資料轉換為有用的見解，提出解決方案以改進企業決策，其應用包括零售葉在內的各種經營管理領域。本課程將幫助同學具有SQL分析數據的能力，此將有助於後續做好商情預測，提出改善方案以輔助企業能抓住市場脈動，進而分析消費者的需求。
description.en: According to Kaggle Survey2020, SQL ranks second among the programming languages used by data scientists, second only to Python. SQL is a language used to query and operate databases, and is an important tool for data analysis and business intelligence. This course takes the mySQL database as the object to learn the operation of the relational database and various SQL syntax, which is an important technology of the overall business intelligence analysis system. In the field of modern business intelligence, new technologies such as SQL databases, cloud platforms, and machine learning are often used to convert data into useful insights and propose solutions to improve corporate decision-making. It is applied to various business management fields including retail leaflets. This course will help students have the ability to analyze data with SQL, which will help to make good business forecasts in the future, propose improvement plans to assist enterprises to grasp the pulse of the market,

syllabi.outline:
資料庫系統與應用課程的目的在研習資料庫設計與管理技術及其在企業的應用。本課程方向包括：資料庫管理系統架構、關聯式資料模式、關聯式資料庫設計理論、關聯查詢最佳化、關聯式資料庫管理系統：以mySQL為例，以實務性方式，培養學生對資料庫系統設計開發之能力。
The objective of this course is to study the techniques of how to design and manage a database system. The topics contained in this course are: database system structure, relational database, E-R model, relational database design, query optimization, relational database management system-MS SQL Server etc. After studying this course, students should be able to design databases and manage database systems.
syllabi.schedule:
chp0.課程簡介
chp1.數據分析的內容包括哪些？
chp2.四種MySQL資料庫的安裝與使用方式：MySQL套件，WorkBench，Azure MySQL，python
chp3.Pyhon讀取SQL資料庫，常用查詢，計算（條件查詢，關鍵字查詢，排序查詢，定點取值）
chp4.生成新的欄位1:基本數學計算，日期取值，字串截取
chp5.生成新的欄位2：CASE...WHEN...THEN...ELSE...END
chp6.子查詢Subquery有四種類型（用到2個查詢，先查詢1，再拿它來查詢另外2）
chp7.資料表的3種合併：水平合併JOIN，垂直合併UNION，關聯合併JOIN(相關欄位合併)
chp8.分群分析，頻數分析，分1群，分2群，交叉分析，樞紐分析
chp9.View檢視表：已經被預處理的資料表，是第2種的資料表(虛擬資料表，視圖(SQL View))
chp10.企業『進貨，銷貨，存貨，訂單』的關聯資料庫
chp11.用python寫簡易的『員工銷售資料庫管理系統』
chp12.自定義函數，自己設計自己的計算函數
chp13.設定索引鍵Index，資料量很大時才需要設定Index(可以提高資料庫查詢的效率)
chp14.SQL資料視覺化與商業智能，第1種方法：python視覺化
chp15.SQL資料視覺化與商業智能，第2種方法：Power BI，tableau
chp16.建立雲端主機的SQL資料庫
chp17.MySQL資料的『新增，修改，刪除』

name.en: Intelligent display and sensing with internship (I)

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓同學學習智慧顯示與感測相關的理論與瞭解相關產業動向，除了透過相關產業導師的教導與實地工廠的參訪，讓同學在最短的時間內對台灣智慧顯示與感測有初步的認識，此外，本課程也包含各種液晶元件的實作與其相關光電特性的量測與應用，讓同學能將理論與實務合而為一。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to teach students the theories and related industrial trends of intelligent displays and sensors. This will be achieved through lectures by industry experts and visits to factories, allowing students to gain a basic understanding of the relevant industries in Taiwan within a short period of time. The course will also include hands-on projects focusing on various LCD components and related optoelectronic properties measurement and application. By combining theory and practice, students can gain a comprehensive understanding of intelligent displays and sensors.

name.zh: 科技產品市場定位與策略
name.en: Technology Products Market Positioning and Strategy

description.zh: 本課程在使學生藉由瞭解市場定位與策略跟科技產品發展與運用的領域有著密不可分的關係。課程內容主要藉由當前科技產品發展的相關課題，以及整體環境的概述，讓同學對於產業或企業之科技產品市場定位與策略有一基本的認知，提供同學從科技產品、市場定位、管理策略的不同角度瞭解科技產品於市場上定位及推動發展策略。
description.en: This course is closely related to the field of technology product development and application through understanding market positioning and strategies. The course content mainly provides students with a basic understanding of the market positioning and strategies of technology products in industries or enterprises through the current topics related to the development of technology products and an overview of the overall environment, and provides students with different perspectives on technology products, market positioning, and management strategies. Understand the positioning of technology products in the market and promote development strategies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要讓同學能理論與實務兼具，了解科技產品及服務在市場定位及策略，並快速在工作上即時運用課程設計。首先以全球化的市場觀點，及新科技的運用及發展，接著以企業自身之定位，去了解如何提供消費者及客戶之需求。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容，讓同學學習後，即時在工作上運用。
This course mainly enables students to have both theory and practice, understand the market positioning and strategies of technology products and services, and quickly apply course design at work. First of all, from the perspective of the global market, and the application and development of new technologies, and then from the positioning of the company itself, to understand how to meet the needs of consumers and customers. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with exercises and case studies as the main teaching content, so that students can apply them at work immediately after learning.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略：案例研析
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.
