name.en: Big Data Analytics and Industrial Applications

description.zh: 本課程將介紹大數據分析緣起與理論基礎，大數據分析與企業經營間之獲利關聯，並輔以大數據分析案例讓學員對於大數據應用有更深層的認識與啟發。
description.en: The big data opportunity, extracting insight from an immense volume, variety and velocity of data, in context, beyond what was previously possible, will be addressed in this course. Applications for big data analytics could include smarter healthcare, multi-channel, finance, computer log analysis, homeland security, traffic control, telecom, search quality, manufacturing, trading analytics, fraud and risk, retailing, among others.

syllabi.outline: 隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，我們已經處於大數據時代，如何處理與儲存大數據、如何從大數據中，探勘有用的知識，成為近年來熱門的研究議題。本課程內容尚包括如何處理與分析大數據、如何更進一步從大數據分析發展市場行銷與顧客關係管理策略，大數據各種案例實務探討等。
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: 大數據簡介
Week 2-3: 大數據分析與實務應用
Week 4: 大數據管理概念
Week 5-6: 大數據管理之方法與策略
Week 7-8: 資料探勘簡介
Week 9-10: 資料探勘之方法介紹I
Week 11-12: 資料探勘之方法介紹 II
Week 13: 大數據分析的平台與環境
Week 14: 大數據行銷實務
Week 15-16: 大數據分析應用與其實務個案討論
Week 17-18: 大數據分析與實務期末報告與討論
syllabi.assessment:
案例研討 30%
課程參與 (思考並參與討論) 50%
期末報告 20%
syllabi.materials:
(1) 「大數據」，麥爾荀伯格、庫基耶著，林俊宏譯，天下文化出版，2014。
(2) 「雲端時代的殺手級應用 – 海量資料分析」，胡世忠著，天下雜誌出版，2013。

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline: 企業創新與研究是促成經營策略成功之不可或缺的部分。資通訊科技日新月益。現今資訊科技系統已成為企業中的重要部份。本課程的主要目標在廣泛的介紹使用更新進的資訊科技所促成的企業創新。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週 資訊科技與企業創新的介紹
第二週 創新的來源、類型與模式、標準戰爭與主流設計
第三週 進入時機、組織的策略方向、選擇創新專案
第四週 合作策略、保護創新
第五週 組織創新、新產品開發過程之管理
第六週 管理新產品開發團隊、制定不屬策略

作業50%
專案報告 25%
課堂參與 22%

name.zh: 企業數位轉型與優化研討

description.zh: 世界各區域經濟快速發展，面對高度競爭的趨勢，數位轉型是項關鍵議題。本課程將使EMBA學生了解數位轉型與優化相關趨勢，並透過一些成功案例探討數位轉型對企業產生之效益，希望透過本課程之研討，EMBA學生可以將成功案例經驗及所學應用至所屬公司或企業。
description.en: With the expeditious development in regional economic activities and more competition across countries, enterprise digital transformation is an important topic. The aim of this course is to comprehend the latest digital transformation issues and potential benefits to enterprise. Case studies and experience sharing are critical in this course.

description.en: This course provides an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory and their applications on the real-world decision problems. Students will learn about the problem identification and modeling, the modeling and estimation of the associated uncertainty, and modeling and evaluation of the utility function.

description.en: The need for information-based support for managers is increasing as the modern management imperatives of reach and to meet their organization's goals. Information management function provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Topic of learning: Acquiring strategic advantage through information systems. Supporting managers and executives through IS applications. Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications. Attaining and practicing technological leadership. This course is taught by HBS cases.

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。

description.en: The General Principle of the Civil Law serves to introduce the common concept and fundamental principle of the Civil Law.  In short, the General Principle of the Civil Law predominates as a learning basis for the whole Civil Law and all legal study.  Through learning on the General Principle of the Civil Law, students can be familiar with the model of legal thought and the framework of norm.  This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

description.zh:
無論就量而言或就質而言，債編均為民法中最為重要之部分。本課程旨在向修課同學作民法債編之概括介紹，包括債編總論及債編各論。再者，此一介紹包含下列四個重點：
一、民法債編之背景及理論
二、民法債編之解釋
三、民法債編於案例事實之適用
四、民法債編與民法其他部分及民事訴訟法之結合
參與本課程乃理解民法債編及民法整體之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en:
"Obligations" is the most important part of the Civil Law, not only in quantity but in quality. This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Obligations", including "General Provisions for Obligations" and "Kinds of Obligations". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 
1. Background and theories of "Obligations".
2. Interpretation of "Obligations".
3. Application of "Obligations" to the facts.
4. Combination of "Obligations", other parts of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.
Attending this course is the critical step to understanding "Obligations" and the Civil Law as a whole, and it benefits participants a lot.

description.zh: 本課程將以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程序後實體」原則先就「程序審查」部分介紹專利申請之程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件，先申請原則、發明單一性及優先權。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

description.zh: 商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce.A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof.A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others.A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act.The discussion in the course covers theory and examples，to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students.

description.zh: 本課程將深入我國專利法，同時簡介美國及大陸專利法。本課程內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件及要求、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫。其他內容尚包括簡介專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程、法院及智慧財產局之角色以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法之關係。
description.en: This course will go through R.O.C. (Taiwan) patent law in detail, and introduce to the U.S. and China patent laws. Topics will mainly include patent filing, patentable subject matter, patent conditions and requirements, patent examination procedure, patent enforcement, patent infringement assessment, patent search, and patent drafting. Other topics include introduce to patent litigation procedure, patent administrative suit procedure, the roles of the court and the Intellectual Property Office and the relationship between patent law and other Intellectual Property laws.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過案例研析介紹智慧財產權之理論與實務問題。課程進行的方式是邀請學界或實務界專家學者，以演講的方式講解相關智慧財產權案例所涉法律問題，並安排參訪智慧財產權實務單位（如專利事務所、智慧財產局、智慧財產法院等），讓同學們得以一窺智慧財產權實務工作的全貌，以達實務與理論相輔相成的功效。
description.en: The course offers introduction to the practice and theory knowledge of Intellectual Property by case study . The course is conducted through lectures of practical subject . It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the practice of Intellectual Property is performed in our country .

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在透過案例研析介紹智慧財產權之理論與實務問題，授課內容將以貼近生活和商業活動的「商標法」為主軸，並針對相應主題補充著作權、專利權及營業秘密等智慧財產法律知識。於學期中邀請數次學界或實務界專家學者，以專題講座方式講授實務案例，以達實務與理論相輔相成的功效。

This course aims to introduce the theory and practical issues of intellectual property rights through case studies. The course will primarily focus on "Trademark Law," which is closely related to everyday life and business activities. Additionally, it will supplement the knowledge of intellectual property laws, such as copyright, patent rights, and trade secrets, on relevant topics. Throughout the semester, several experts and scholars from academia or the industry will be invited to give special lectures on practical cases, aiming to achieve a complementary effect between theory and practice.

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:. Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members. This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright. In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt. In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

syllabi.outline:
二十一世紀的「腦力經濟」最重要的戲規則就是「智慧財產權」，同時也是WTO會員必須遵守的重要規範之一；為配合本校為頂尖科技大學，有強調技術發展之傳統，課程內容以與技術特性最為相關的「專利法」為主軸，並於相應主題帶入著作權、商標權及營業秘密等重要智慧財產之觀念，以建構出智慧財權產之整體知識。

One of the most important rules in the 21st-century "knowledge economy" is intellectual property rights, which is also a crucial requirement for WTO members to comply with. To align with our university's emphasis on technological development as a top-tier technology institution, the course content focuses on "Patent Law," which is highly relevant to technology. Additionally, concepts related to copyright, trademark rights, and trade secrets, which are significant aspects of intellectual property, will be integrated into relevant topics to construct a comprehensive understanding of intellectual property rights.

description.zh:
法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。
有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
description.en: Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta."  Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law.  This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion.  Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

syllabi.outline: Law is the rules for social life. Focusing on real-world cases, the course of Law and Social Life aims to help non-law students have a clear view of the Taiwanese legal system. Also, this course aims to help the students comply with the law and understand the ways in which they can secure their rights. Professors teaching this course make use of a series of judgments to make students be familiar with the legal rules. This course covers the fundamental concepts and knowledge of a number of law subjects, ranging from civil code, criminal code, administrative law, and business law to intellectual property law and procedural law.

description.zh:
近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民及企業協力推動社區及產業發展。
大學社會責任工作主要是透過社會創新，解決社會問題，來實踐社會責任所謂社會創新，就是用創新的方法來解決社會問題，產生「社會影響力」（Social Impact），並設法改變處在社會問題「當中的人」以及與這個人有關的「社會情境」（social context），來產生長久的社會影響
本課程，將向同學生講解社會責任基本觀念，以介紹學社會責任的理念構想與實踐經驗，並移地教學，地方場域問題作為主題報告討論素材等方式，來增強學生進行社會創新的態度、認知和行為。
description.en: In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

syllabi.outline: 近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民協力推動社區及產業發展。本課程將先向同學生說明大學社會責任之意涵，並以「能源轉型與公民參與」為主題，結合移地教學，讓同學認識當代能源轉型下的公正轉型課題，從而展開大學社會責任與社會創新的探索和行動。

description.en: In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

syllabi.outline:
人類是群居的動物，此等群性衍生出群育需求，也孕育出群體角色分化的社會生活。當多數人面臨相同問題，產生同樣需求時，人群會產生如何組織、領導，以匯集眾人成一體來群策群力的需求。社會需要有領導者，來讓大眾群策群力的發展社會，而為社會培養未來的領導者，正是大學的使命之一。

為了培植大學生社會領導素養，與時俱進的發展出相關的學習途徑，例如學生社團、勞作教育、服務學習以及近年來興起的大學社會責任工作等等其中，社團以共同志趣聚集組織的成員，讓學生透過社群生活以及學習行動，連結社會網絡，實踐落實社會責任，是培育大學生社會領導素養的重要途徑

本課程將結合本校親善大使的社團運作，規劃安排講座研習以及實際操作領導作業，將社會責任觀念帶給同學，引導同學觀察社會、關心社會、投入社會責任工作。修課者需要參與講座研習以及實際操作作業，學習過程中會有大量密切的人際合作交流互動,歡迎對社會領導﹑社會責任等行動實踐有興趣之同學修習

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

Information management function provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications. Attaining and practicing technological leadership. This course is taught by HBS cases.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
description.en: English Description	Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

name.en: Mindfulness for Leadership and Stress Reduction

description.zh:
現代人工作壓力大，許多上班族都有壓力、失眠、焦慮等問題。醫學也發現，身體許多疾病甚至癌症也都和情緒、壓力有關。
目前，已經證實正念減壓：可以降低壓力與焦慮，疲勞，降低員工的職業倦怠程度和離職率。提升睡眠品質，增強疫系統，提升專注力，提高領導效能，提升大腦功能與創造力，促進幸福感。滿意度，情緒管理能力、創造力、與人際溝通能力，提高工作績效。改善了個人健康、工作與家庭生活！因此，目前歐美和國內的各大企業紛紛引入正念課程，以提高員工和企業績效。
description.en:
There are so many people with the high stress in the workplace. It’s demonstrated that practicing mindfulness can bring improvements in both physical and psychological symptoms as well as positive changes in health, attitudes, and behaviors. 
The advantages of integrating mindfulness in the workplace including:higher brain functioning;reduced work-related stress, anxiety, depression, fatigue, and psychological distress .Improves job performance, greater job satisfaction, and decreasing turnover and burnout.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 本課程藉由邀請校內外之社會、政治、經濟、文化等專家學者與莘莘學子們進行相互交流，透過「全球議題」、「文化學習」等主題之進階探討，培養學生世界公民之意識，重新定位自己，以適應全球化生活與培養終身競爭力。修習本課程之學生需於學期中規劃辦理一場國際型實務展演活動，邀校內國際生及本國生共襄盛舉，達到實質國際人才互動。
description.en: We invite the domestic speakers, as the outstanding scholars of cross-cultural communication, to share their knowledge and experiences with students. By exploring the global issues such as social, cultural, political or economic studies, the course makes students learn further about the world, and inspires students to strengthen their independent thinking and global perspective.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

name.en: Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering

description.zh: 衛星科技與工程導論的課程將介紹衛星系統及次系統基礎知識，以培養具有從事衛星任務設計之基礎能力。課程內容包括：衛星基本原理，衛星設計與製造，衛星運行與維護，衛星通訊與遙測應用，衛星發展趨勢。
description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

description.zh: 本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU基礎架構，ARM CPU指令集，ARM之C語言工具，ARM 發展環境，開發電路板，模擬器，Linux驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，分散式網路架構，以及應用實例。
description.en: This course introduces small single-board computers serving as embedded systems and explains the architecture of X86 and ARM CPUs. This lecture will present the history of the ARM development environment, emulators, distributed network architectures, and industrial applications of ARM architecture. In the course, students learn to install Linux on development boards and write software to communicate with ARM processors. The exercises involve setting commands for the ARM cores and receiving signals from our embedded systems using C language tools.

專利權部份：
壹、保護創新：1. 如何透過專利保護科技創新、2. 專利的迷思。
貳、專利與創新：1. 如何由需求或靈感取得創新、2. 如何使創新轉化為實質專利 3. 如何從專利撰寫演化出創新。
參、專利概念與規法：1. 我國專利體系介紹、2. 專利相關法規之介紹、3. 專利取得的流程、4. 發明專利實體審查基、5. 專利說明書及圖示的撰寫格式、6. 何謂發明單一性及優先權的使用。
肆、專利說明書搜尋及閱讀：1. 各國專利的搜尋引擎、2. 專利工具的使用、3. 閱讀專利說明書。
伍、專利說明書的撰寫與申請：1. 專利說明書撰寫之重要 2. 專利說明書之格式 3. 專利說明書之撰寫技巧。
陸、專利戰略與佈局：1. 商戰專利佈局模式、2. 專利舉發實務、3. 專利舉發方式、4. 專利舉發程序、5. 專利舉發策略運用、6. 舉發撤銷要件。
柒、專利侵害及訴訟實例：1. 從案例中學習專利侵害的攻防與法院訴訟的爭點、2.專家演講(法官，技審官，審查官，律師) 邀請領域的專家分享實務經驗。

syllabi.outline:
Course Description: 
	This course offers an in-depth exploration into patent analytics. Participants will traverse topics such as research methodologies specific to patents, foundational aspects of patent law, the pivotal role of semiconductors in patenting, keyword-centric patent searches complemented by pertinent case studies, the integration of linguistics and logic in understanding patents, the practical applications of ChatGPT, and the utility of Natural Language Processing in patent data analysis.

Course Topics:
1.	Research Methodology in Patent Analytics:
	•	Overview of innovation trends
	•	Analyzing McKinsey and Gartner reports for patent insights
2.	Basics of Patent Law:
	•	Intellectual Property: Understanding the Basics
	•	What makes an invention patentable?
	•	Constructing and analyzing a patent claim
	•	Understanding patent structures
	•	The thin line between innovation and non-obviousness
	•	Crafting an effective patent strategy
3.	Semiconductors and Their Importance in Patenting:
	•	Introduction to semiconductor processes, manufacturing, and devices
	•	Deep dive into VLSI design, IP, MCU, CPU, GPU, firmware, OS, and software
	•	A look at solid-state devices
	•	Advanced Process Technologies (Refer to Advanced-Process-Technologies.pdf for detailed insights)
4.	Keyword-driven Patent Search & Case Studies:
	•	Patent cases on advanced devices: Planar FET, FinFET, GAA
	•	Patent cases involving AI methodologies
5.	Language, Logic, and Meaning in Patent Analysis:
	•	Introduction to linguistics in patent analysis (Reference: https://chowkafat.net/Lingtopic.html)
	•	Basics of semantics and its importance in patent comprehension
	•	Deep dive into formal semantics and generalized quantifier theory
	•	Deciphering the logical form and structure in patents
	•	Introduction to propositional logic and its application in patent analysis
	•	Unraveling predicate logic in patent contexts
6.	Practical Applications using ChatGPT:
	•	Using ChatGPT for instructional language and problem-solving in patent analytics
	•	Case study: Constructing a GAA using ChatGPT
	•	ChatGPT in research methodologies and patent search
7.	Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Patent Analysis:
	•	Understanding word embedding and word vectors
	•	Techniques for determining similarity in patent documents using NLP

description.zh:
本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。
本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。
本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en:
This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.
This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

description.en: This course is intended for university-level EFL writing students with the aim of increasing their fluency in English writing. To achieve this goal, students in this course will have ample opportunities to write varying types of English paragraphs, for instance, paragraphs of definition and paragraphs focusing on cause and effect relationships. In addition, they will have plenty of opportunities to write various kinds of short English essays, including descriptions, narratives, and argumentative writings.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。 課程規劃主要著重在"設計方法"以及"設計思維(Design Thinking)的實際操作演練;希望透過本課程讓同學們以互動體驗實作的方式來建構設計概念發展的模式。 課程內容包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫及實作等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discussion.

說故事與腳本企劃作為互動系大二視覺傳達組的必修課程，旨在訓練同學創意的敘事方式與多媒體腳本企畫執行。在課程大綱中。本學期課程的實務專題預計以USR專案: 原住民部落安居構築與綠色樂業推動計畫；南投仁愛鄉賽德克東岸部落之耆老口述歷史故事影像化和災後心理支持app腳本企畫兩大專題，在課程中藉由多次與部落耆老訪談和USR團隊專任助理的資料提供協助、讓同學們實作影片敘事與app腳本企畫。

本課程鏈結SDG11所探討的永續城市與社群及SDG15-保育陸域生態的主題。授課教師本身為USR- 原住民部落安居構築與綠色樂業推動計畫的共同主持人，負責第三期USR 賽德克東岸部落的互動行銷規畫與實踐項目，然2023年8月初的卡努風災導致土石流導致我們的場域家園毀損嚴重，因此本USR計畫將調整執行方向到災害應變和復原。故此次課程亦將以” 災後部落居民心理支持app”作為專題，預計在課程中開闢兩個講次談SDG11/15相關的概念和東岸部落的災前災後生態復育，另安排一次東岸部落的據點觀察(移地教學)及三週當災害來臨 app討論和實作課程實施。

The course involves developing the ability to identify issues, evaluate strategic options and understand the organizational process by which strategies get formed and executed. It builds on the knowledge gained in functional area courses and uses case studies and projects to improve students' analytical and decision-making skills. Prerequisite: Must be taken in last semester or with permission of the Graduate Advisor.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

syllabi.outline: This course is designed to improve your listening and reading competence in English. You should be able to learn how to enhance your listening for each part and your reading speed. After taking this course, you will be able to acquire the competence and useful strategies on dealing with each part of the TOEIC test. You are also expected to get a score above 550. Please pay attention to the skills related to the TOEIC test. There will be two-round full skill in-class training by midterm and by final respectively. Should you have any questions, feel free to ask during the lecture.

name.zh: 半導體材料檢測技術及原理

description.zh: 本課程將探討半導體材料之表面化學性質之分析技巧、以及界面和分子間引力之量測方法、表面形態分析、晶相結構分析以及電磁性質量測之技術和其原理。並針對半導體材料的特性，實際操作拉曼及FTIR顯微鏡、原子力顯微鏡、x光光電能譜、以及材料晶相、機械、電磁特性相關設備。
description.en: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the Raman/FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, x-ray photoelectric spectrometer. Furthermore, instruments to measure crystalline, micro-mechanical, and electrical properties specifically for semiconductor materials will also be introduced.

syllabi.outline: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, reology meter on the semiconductor materials.
syllabi.schedule:
1-3 :  X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis and its theory fundamentals
4-6 :  Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) analysis and its theory fundamentals
7-9 : Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) analysis and its theory fundamentals
10-11 : Raman spectroscopy analysis and its theory fundamentals
12-13 :  Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis and its theory fundamentals
14-17 : Theory and the applications of x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS)
18: Practice and results discussion

45% Final examination
10% Reports

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程之學習目標是要讓學生的技能持續進步，不因課業而荒廢，學生必須每星期五至企業實習1天。若學生無法媒合到企業，則須回到原來培訓單位，協助訓練選手，或以暑假至企業實習。
description.en: The learning goal of this course is to allow students to continue to improve their skills, not to be abandoned by the coursework. Students must intern for 1 day every Friday to the enterprise. If students cannot match to the enterprise, they must return to the original training unit to help training the other athletes, or take an internship to the enterprise during the summer vacation.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生必須利用暑假至機械、車輛、冷凍空調相關機構實習，參與校外合作企業或研發機構所提供之訓練，學習專業技術之運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核。學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，再由指導教師依據學生之心得報告及現場訪評，撰寫實習成果報告交給系上保存，並給予評分。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to improve students' practical ability. Students must use summer vacation to practice in machinery, vehicles, refrigeration and air conditioning related institutions, participate in training provided by off-campus cooperative enterprises or R&D institutions, and learn the operation of professional technology. After the internship period expires, the internship institution must issue an internship certificate and performance assessment. Students must write an internship experience report, and then the instructor will write the internship achievement report to the department for preservation and score based on the student's experience report and on-site interview and evaluation.

description.zh:
1.安排至企業實習，每星期五實習一天。
2.參加國手選拔，到企業、原培訓單位、或職訓中心實習。
3.回原培訓單位，協助訓練選手，經驗傳承。
description.en:
1. Arrange for internship in companies, on every Friday.
2. Participate in the selection of national players, and practice in enterprises, original training units, or vocational training centers.
3. Return to the original training unit to help train the players and transfer their experience.

description.en: This course aims to introduce the concept, methodology, and certifications of offshore wind mechatronics standard. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of offshore wind mechatronics certification.

This course aims to introduce the concept, methodology, and certifications of offshore wind mechatronics standard. The object is to provide a fundamental understanding upon offshore wind so that the students can quickly apply what they have learned to solve quality and standard problems. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of offshore wind mechatronics certification.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 互動設計專注於使用情境相關課題，包括多元感覺的產品語意、資訊與功能的整體設計。顧及使用者的需求、使用者的心理和使用者的認知特性；將所有參與互動的操作及顯示單元，透過視覺、觸覺及聽覺等多元感覺的整合設計。使得使用者容易理解。
description.en: This course provides study of interaction design related topics on Product Semantics, Information and Function. With emphasis on User Interface integration and Usability Testing, psychology and cognitive proactive, the course will be characterized by inter-disciplinary on multi-median. This is where the user easy understanding applies and interacts with the product.

syllabi.schedule: Each student is responsible for presenting an usability excerpt from the text Designing with the Mind in Mind (DMiM). These are five-minute presentations, only five slides. They will be scheduled throughout the semester, and the calendar will be posted in advance on the Blackboard.Include website examples that refer to specific useful guidelines in the designated chapter.
syllabi.assessment:
1. As a lecture course, attendance is essential. The learning environment is the collaborative work of the creative process, with regular feedback. The role of the teacher is to guide you through this process. Outside work is sometimes necessary during the research phases, but apart from that, you are expected to attend each class for the entire class time. Plagiarism is dealt with in accordance with NTUTs academic standards and policies on fraud and plagiarization. Any copy of the work of another student or of information without proper citation is unacceptable. The student manual details the acts considered to be plagiarism, the channels through which they are treated, and their consequences.
2. Your final rating will be calculated on the basis of the scale below; the scoring criteria listed in the course syllabus. 
Discovery 5 Points 
Exploration; Generation + 10 Points 
Evaluation Phase with wireframes; documentation + 10 Points 
Test Plan; Validation + 20 Points Final Design + 15 Points 
Final Documentation & Presentation + 10 Points 
5 Slides 5 Minutes Presentations + 5 Points 
Participation, Quiz, Homework + 15 points = 100 Points 
No grades will be discussed by e-mail. No extensions will be granted unless a medical note or an email from your academic advisor is provided. In general, incomplete course grades are not granted without the agreement of the academic dean. Three absences will result in the loss of a final class; six absences will result in failure.

description.zh:
本課程旨在教授學生如何運用創意編程和視覺化電腦圖形技術，將資料及音訊數據轉換為可視化之2D或3D視覺內容，藉以增進資料及音訊之閱聽體驗。課程進行中，學生將習得多種基於演算法之視覺表現方式，以滿足設計層面中富含躍動感、平衡感以及美感之體驗需求，活用創意編程與新媒體技術來創建更生動、更具有影響
力的動靜態視聽影像。
description.en: This course aims to teach students how to utilize the knowledge from data science and computer graphics technology to represent data and audio into visualized 2D/3D representations, which gives rise to enhanced experiences of reading and listening. Students will learn a variety of programming skills to design visual representation based on algorithms to deliver dynamic, balanced and aesthetic experiences. With the help of creative coding and new media technology, more vivid and influential static and dynamic visual and audio experiences will be generated.

name.zh: 多感官回饋技術應用與設計

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度,帶領同學進行多感官回饋技術的實作及實驗。從實作及實驗中學生將了解不同回饋技術在應用面上的可能性及其設計考量,並學習人機互動系統的啟發式評估、沉浸式量表、半結構式訪談,從而剖析及理解人機互動系統的表現(程式語言:C++)。此外本課程將以小組實習方式來進行,期望藉由合作學習和雛型製作來強化學生跨領域提案之創新能力。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to guide students to implement and experiment with multisensory feedback technologies from an application and design perspective. Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies in terms of application and design considerations, and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). In addition, this course will take the form of group exercises in the innovative ability to strengthen students' cross-field proposals through cooperative learning and prototyping skill.

第六週

期中考週    (Midterm)

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

description.zh: 本課程旨在深入介紹統計技術和最佳化概念，藉以輔助管理之決策。課程涵蓋統計學及最佳化相關主題，包括描述性統計、相關分析、抽樣和估計、概率分布、假設檢驗、回歸模型、實驗設計和線性規劃。通過課程學生還將獲得統計和最佳化軟件（如LINGO和Excel）的實際操作經驗。修習課程之學生將具備應用統計和最佳化工具處理實務問題之技能和知識，使其能夠基於數量方法之做出決策及管理。
description.en: This course aims to offer an in-depth understanding of statistical techniques and optimization concepts for making informed management decisions. The course provides a comprehensive overview of key topics in statistics, including descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, sampling and estimation, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, regression models, design of experiments, and linear programming. Students will also gain practical experience in statistical and optimization software such as LINGO and Excel through interactive tutorials. On completion of this course, students would be able to equip with the skills and knowledge needed to apply statistical and optimization tools to real-life situations, allowing them to make informed decisions based on quantitative methods.

name.en: The Application of Computer in Construction Management

description.zh: 本課程主要自營建工程專案之觀點，介紹一些常用營建專案管理方法之基本原理及其在電腦上之應用實例。課程內容將包含營建專案之進度、成本、品質等基本管理概念與營建管理理論於專案管理之初步應用，使學生能實際地學習如何將電腦應用在營建工程專案管理(內容包括：工程排程、成本估算與控制、電腦模擬、與工程風險管理分析等方法)。
description.en: This course will provide students with the computational fundamental skills necessary to plan and manage the construction management (such as schedule, cost, and quality management) using related computer project management software or system packages. Students will learn to mix and match available resources in the most efficient combinations to complete projects on time and within budget. Furthermore, the student may utilize computational programming to efficiently plan and execute municipal infrastructure programs (simulations and analysis) and support contractors’ decisions in constrained projects.

syllabi.outline:
This course will provide students with the computational fundamental skills necessary to plan and schedule the entire construction process and familiarize them with computer project management software packages. Students will learn to mix and match available resources in the most efficient combinations to complete projects on time and within budget. Furthermore,
the student may utilize computational programming to efficiently plan and execute municipal infrastructure programs and support contractors’ decisions on high risk and constrained projects.
syllabi.schedule:
1. Computer-based Project Management in Construction
2. The application of Construction Computer-based Project Management
3. The application of Visual Basic Application in Excel
4. Construction Management System - Introduction (P6 and Project 2003)
5. Web-based Construction Management System 
6. The applications of BIM in Construction Management
7. Construction automations for Construction Management
8. Special Topics in Construction Management Information
syllabi.assessment:
1. Attendance and class participation (10%)
2. Homework (40%)
3. Final report presentation (20%) and final report (30%)
syllabi.materials: 1. Related reports and documents.

description.zh: 本課程藉由邀請校內外之社會、政治、經濟、文化等專家學者與莘莘學子們進行相互交流，透過「生命倫理」、「社會公義」、「科技倫理」等主題之進階探討，增進學生公民意識與行動，並能關心在地與全球道德議題，促進個人、社會、自然與世界等多元層面的發展。
description.en: We invite the outstanding speakers, as the outstanding scholars of moral education, to share their knowledge and experiences with students. By exploring the social issues such as bioethics, social justice and technical ethics, the course cultivates students civic awareness, and inspires students to concern about local and global moral issues, which can formulate an advanced development of individuals, society, nature and the world.

description.en:

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域大數據分析之應用
name.en: AI Applications in Big Data Analytics

description.zh: 本課程將使用時下最新生成式人工智慧工具介紹人工智慧原理及其於大數據分析及智慧計算之應用，進行數據預處理，建立並優化訓練模型。課程內容包括監控生產線上各種數據，如產品品質、生產效率等。通過即時警報和提示，幫助管理人員快速識別並解決問題。藉由學習和分析過往的故障記錄和維修日誌，預測和診斷產設備，提供相應的維護建議。幫助企業實現定期維護和檢修，從而減少設備故障率和生產停機時間。進行自動識別和分類缺陷，並提供改進建議，從而提高產品品質和生產效率。
description.en: This course makes use of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) tools of generative artificial intelligence (AI) to introduce the principles of artificial intelligence and its applications in big data, including data preprocessing, model building, and AI model hyper-parameterization. The course focuses on various types of production-related data. By monitoring shop floor real-time data, production engineers may quickly identify and resolve abnormalities. By learning and analyzing past failure records and maintenance logs, the system may predict and diagnose production errors and provide predictive schedules for equipment maintenance. It helps companies to find a better balance between equipment failure occurrence and production scheduled downtime. The course includes applications in automatic pattern identification, recognition, and classification to assist decision-makers in improving product quality and production efficiency.

description.zh: 本課程將使用時下最新生成式人工智慧工具介紹人工智慧原理及其於大數據分析及智慧計算之應用，進行數據預處理，建立並優化訓練模型。課程內容包括監控生產線上各種數據，如產品品質、生產效率等。通過即時警報和提示，幫助管理人員快速識別並解決問題。藉由學習和分析過往的故障記錄和維修日誌，預測和診斷產設備，提供相應的維護建議。幫助企業實現定期維護和檢修，從而減少設備故障率和生產停機時間。進行自動識別和分類缺陷，並提供改進建議，從而提高產品品質和生產效率。
description.en: This course makes use of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) tools of generative artificial intelligence (AI) to introduce the principles of artificial intelligence and its applications in big data, including data preprocessing, model building, and AI model hyper-parameterization. The course focuses on various types of production-related data. By monitoring shop floor real-time data, production engineers may quickly identify and resolve abnormalities. By learning and analyzing past failure records and maintenance logs, the system may predict and diagnose production errors and provide predictive schedules for equipment maintenance. It helps companies to find a better balance between equipment failure occurrence and production scheduled downtime. The course includes applications in automatic pattern identification, recognition, and classification to assist decision-makers in improving product quality and production efficiency.

description.zh: 本課程中包含下列主題：1.簡介；2.電子商店的行銷策略；3.電子商店的建   置；4. 電子商店的經營與管理；5. 電子商店的法律問題；6.案例介紹；7.結論。
description.en: In the course, the following topics will be discussed：1.Overview of EC；2.The marketing strategies of EC；3.How to install an EC；4.The management of EC；5.The current problems of EC；6.Cases study；7.Conclusion。

syllabi.outline:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在學習智慧營運管理的基本觀念與應用。課程內容包括：(1) 智慧營運管理基本概念、(2)大數據分析與營運管理、(3)人工智慧與營運管理、(4)物聯網與營運管理、(5)智慧製造與營運管理、(6)智慧物流管理、(7)智慧供應鏈管理、(8) 智慧生產規劃與排程、(9)永續營運管理。
description.en: This course will introduce basic concept and application of advanced operation management. The topics addressed in this course include: (1) Basic concept and application of intelligent operations management, (2) Big data analytic and operations management, (3) Artificial intelligence and operations management, (4) IoT and operations management, (5) Smart manufacturing and operations management, (6) Intelligent logistic management, (7) Intelligent supply chain management, (8) Intelligent production planning and scheduling, (9)Sustainable operations management.

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

description.zh:
本課程以『超跑人生』的思維，提供學生從現在開始，即提前佈署規劃未來的學習課程，內容涵蓋生活成長、法學知識、運動健康及生命故事分享等多面向的單元主題。
  本課程師資將聘任具備專業學術能力，並擁有豐富經驗的學者專家，藉由教師的專業與實務經驗，和學員共同分享與討論，激發更多的思考與促進學習。

syllabi.outline:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

description.zh: 我們的事業甚至人生成功與否，不是建立在我們獲得與貢獻多少，而是在獲得與付出的過程中，我們是否樂在其中。能否在此過程中進行創意性思考，無疑是決定我們是否樂在其中的關鍵。本課程至少包括下述和「創意思考」相關的課題：它的神經科學基礎，它的心理學方法，它在哲學與邏輯上的認識論基礎，如何培養創意思考的基因，如何區別個人進行與在團體中運用創意思考，等等。本課程將進行系列的理論與個案探討，使學習者不僅知道什麼是「創意思考」，更要能夠進行創意思考。
description.en: Whether our careers and even our lives are successful or not is contingent not just upon the results we produce, but also upon whether we enjoy the activity of achieving those results.  To achieve this goal, we need to be able to think creatively.  The course hence covers at least the following topics relevant to “Creative Thinking”: its neuroscientific basis, its psychological methods, the epistemic foundation in both philosophy and logic, the development of the gene of creative thinking, the difference between thinking creatively as an individual and in a group, etc.  The course will proceed with a series of close studies of theories and practical cases, so that the participants of the course will not only know 'what is creative thinking', but also be able to think creatively.

description.zh: 資料科學為最熱門的職業之一，各行各業對於數據分析的人才需求正在蓬勃發展，本課程在於培育從事資料科學或機器學習的人員來發展相關知識和技能。課程內容以線性代數、機率、統計學等工程數學為理論學習基礎，操作Python作為資料科學的實作工具，包括其相關Python基礎語法、各種資料型態、數據 可視化、開源工具等。接著學習利用Python取得數據資料，進而操作各種迴歸 分析來手動分析數據資料，並實作梯度遞減，決策樹等最佳化演算方法。最後則是介紹機器學習、深度學習等最新的AI演算方法來分析大數據並輔助決策。
description.en: Data Science has been ranked as one of the hottest professions and the demand for data practitioners is booming. This course is designed to develop people engaged in data science or machine learning to develop relevant knowledge and skills. You will understand how data science works based on mathematics, such as linear algebra, probability and statistics. Python is the best tool to learn how to conduct data science analyze data. Learn the basic language skills, common data types, visualization tools and extended modules for data grabbing and regression analysis. Gradient decent and decision tree for optimization will be covered. Finally, AI algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning, are introduced how data help in decision making.

syllabi.outline:
由於雲端運算的快速發展，大量資料收集與儲存技術已成瓶頸，大數據技術與管理提供一套具延展性與容錯能力的分散儲存與計算架構, 能有效處理大量複雜數據資料的儲存與運算。 本課程除介紹現有的大數據生態與趨勢，並針對目前軟硬體架構的處理瓶頸，提供系統組態與部署、服務層級協定、監控與管理等系統性規劃的解決方案，並導入跨領域的工程管理科學知識。課程簡扼論述大數據技術與管理的重要，並在Hadoop生態系統中，以Cloudera Hadoop為應用範例，實作說明其重要性。 課程內容包括：大數據的概念、應用生態與趨勢、Hadoop硬體規格與基礎架構規劃、叢集組態與部署、叢集服務層級協定、叢集監控與管理、相關生態技術、業界案例說明與專案研習討論。此外，由於MapReduce運算過程可能耗費太多磁碟I/O，為了能進一步提升大數據處理的效率，課程亦將介紹基於記憶體運算的Spark架構，包括:Spark API、RDD、Data Frame等; 並且以常見的資料探勘應用範例，包括: 分類、分群等，來說明Spark叢集的運作、Spark與Hadoop的差異。
The course will introduce Apache Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major components including: Big Data (BD) in demand and its application trend, Core technologies of Hadoop for BD management, Hadoop Administration and management tool, Hadoop cluster deployment, YARN applications plus MapReduce, Hadoop cluster hardware and software, Introduction of Hadoop ecosystem projects, HDFS configuration for high availability (HA), Hadoop security, Cluster resource scheduling , hardware configuration, industrial case studies, forum/project discussion, etc.. In addition, due to the major bottleneck of “shuffle and sort” in MapReduce that affects the performance of Hadoop, we will also introduce the memory-based distributed framework Spark. The topics include: Spark API, RDDs, Data Frames. The most common data mining applications including classification and clustering will be introduced to show the differences between Hadoop and Spark.

syllabi.outline:
This is an applied science course that examines how the application of big data can enhance technical and functional capabilities and how the big data processing efficiency can be facilitated and monitored to achieve well-defined objectives.
As it is well known that an optimized result made by Artificial Intelligence (AI) could not be significantly achieved without big data. Nowadays, there are a wide variety of data type (mostly non-structured ones) in different applications, and we are generating much more data and faster than ever before. Thus, big data applications are impacting our daily life. However, there are problems using existing techniques to accommodate most of our interests. For example, accessing the data from disk in distributed systems and getting data to the processors are among the typical bottlenecks. 
This course is designed to not only introduce Big Data application and trend with Hadoop, but also its processing technology and ecosystems which are capable of eliminating the bottlenecks by its unique methods for storing and processing data per common application scenario. In addition, the course provides the platforms for students’ paper reading, group/squad discussion, co-work assignment, case studies and presentation.
The course will introduce Apache Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major components including: Big Data (BD) in demand and its application trend, Core technologies of Hadoop for BD management, Hadoop Administration and management tool, Hadoop cluster deployment, YARN applications plus MapReduce, Hadoop cluster hardware and software, Introduction of Hadoop ecosystem projects, HDFS configuration for high availability (HA), Hadoop security, Cluster resource scheduling , hardware configuration, industrial case studies, forum/project discussion, etc.. In addition, due to the major bottleneck of “shuffle and sort” in MapReduce that affects the performance of Hadoop, we will also introduce the memory-based distributed framework Spark. The topics include: Spark API, RDDs, Data Frames. The most common data mining applications including classification and clustering will be introduced to show the differences between Hadoop and Spark.

description.en: This course aims to introduce major research issues and current trends in language studies. Possible topics include, but are not limited to, the following: (1) applied linguistics: pragmatics, discourse analysis, sociolinguistics, corpus linguistics and phraseology; (2) foreign language teaching: L2 acquisition/SLA, technology and English education, content-based instruction and multi-/cross-cultural issues in English education; (3)ESP research and teaching: technical writing, English for business/tourism/medicine/technology/management, and innovations in ESP curriculum design; (4) translation studies: theory and practice of translation and interpretation, translation and interpretation teaching, translation and technology, audiovisual translation and news translation; (5) bilingual education and bilingualism: English medium instruction (EMI), content and language integrated learning (CLIL) and bilingual teacher development.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子製造程序（其中最主要者為積體電路之製造程序）。首先說明製造方法上之三個 主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 先修課程：物理或負責教授同意。不可壓縮流體、質量不滅、非黏性流體之運動、柏努力定律、線性及角動量定理及其應用、渦流與勢流、黏性流、納維爾－史脫克斯方程式及應用、管中壓力頭損失及增加、邊界層與分離升力與阻力及雷諾方程式之應用。
description.en: Incompressible fluid, mass conservation, invoiced flow, Bernoulli principle, linear, angular momentum conservation and application, vortex, and potential flow, Navier-Stoke equation, pressure loss, boundary layer flow, separation flow, lift and drag, Reynold analogy and applications.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

syllabi.schedule:
學生為了完成資料分析相關技術與工具之學習，將完成以下單元主題:
1. 資料蒐集與資料特性的分析了解
2. 資料前處理
3. 資料分類 (classification) 
4. 資料分群 (clustering)
5. 資料分析結果之解讀與分析探討
6. 分析結果呈現
syllabi.assessment:
根據學生所收集整理之資料，以及分析結果報告，評估其:
1. 創新性
2. 分析方法之效果 (如: 準確率等)
3. 實用性
4. 分析報告完整性
syllabi.materials:
依學習主題需要，參閱相關教科書，與線上教材或教學影片及範例等。
如: 資料探勘相關教科書:
Jiawei Han, Jian Pei, and Hanghang Tong, Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques, 4th ed., Morgan Kaufmann Publishers, Oct. 2022.

description.zh: 為培養學生自主學習能力，透過學生自發性蒐集資料擬定研究主題，由學生自行建構課程內容，從中學習規劃與執行專案實務，培育學生在特定主題研究中，學習到團隊合作、溝通表達、思考批判與問題解決等能力，由教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。本課程的評量以書面報告或口頭報告進行。
description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

name.zh: 彈性工時學期校外實習

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，工時可彈性安排週間但每週不得低於32小時。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(flexible working hours and 32 hours at least per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗光電產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

A graduate-level course covering the topics of analytical spectroscopies. Examples from modern chemical
research will be discussed to illustrate the basic concepts and instrumentation of analytical spectroscopies. This
course is an elective course for chemistry graduate students in either the M.S. or the Ph.D. program.
There is no required text for this course. The following books may be used as references:
Instrumental Analysis, R. M. Granger, et al (2017); Modern spectroscopy, 4th Ed., J. M. Hollas (2004); Basic
atomic and molecular spectroscopy, J. M. Hollas (2002); Spectra of atoms and molecules, P. F. Bernath (1995).
Slides for the lectures will be distributed to students after the classes.
syllabi.schedule:
10/5 1 3 Development & applications of nanoparticles with unique optical properties
10/6 2 3 Interaction between EM radiation with molecules
10/11 3 3 Electronic spectroscopy: UV-vis; AA; AES; Fluorescence

10/16 5 3 IR & Raman;
10/17 6 3 Mass spectrometry

本課程由台積電訓練中心(位於台中)提供課程設備，實際授課內容視該期可用設備由台積電調整。每一梯次受訓四天，每天課程範例如下：
Day 1
1.System overview
2.Mainframe configuration
3.Process module
4.Utility connection
5.Sub system
6.Safety
7.Tool on site inspection

Day 2
1.RF delivery system
2.Gas delivery system
3.Pressure servo system
4.ESC system
5.Backside He system
6.Temperature system
7.Chamber design evolution
8.EPD system introduction
9.Software operation overview

Day 3
1.S/W operation main platform
2.S/W operation processmodule
3.S/W operation data access
4.Mainframe outline
5.Mainframe service function
6.Mainframe maintenance
7.Maintenance practice and certification

Day 4
1.Chamber outline and PM preparation
2.Process kits disassembling
3.Process kits cleaning and inspection
4.Process kits installation
5.PM practice

原則上周六早上6點由本校出發，課程結束約六點由台中出發返校。統一提供交通運輸。遲到無法等待，視同缺課。
syllabi.assessment:

name.zh: 校務研究：教育場域數據分析實作
name.en: Institutional research: the application of data science in education

description.zh: 校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
description.en: Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

syllabi.schedule:
第1週	教育場域：教務、學務、研發體系與職能介紹
第2週	校務研究分析項目與工作內容綜覽：教務、學務、研發、空間規劃
第3週	校務研究分析軟體工作環境介紹及其功能定位(Stata、Python、Gephi、QGIS、Netlogo)
第4週	教育內部場域數據性質介紹：數值、文字紀錄、聲音、人群關係、人員移動路線
第5週	教育外部相關場域數據的取得：API介接服務與操作
第6週	資料清理與資料調處
第7週	資料垂直串接與水平整併
第8週	資料視覺化製作
第9週	期中報告：撰寫資料視覺化分析報告
第10週	教育方案效果評估技術I：倍差法、綜合控制法
第11週	教育方案效果評估技術II：斷點迴歸法、傾向分數配對法
第12週	進階專題I：地理空間分析(GIS)在教育場域的應用分析
第13週	進階專題II：社會關係網絡(SNA)在教育場域的應用分析
第14週	進階專題III：自然語言處理(NLP)在教育場域的應用分析
第15週	進階專題IV：代理人模型(ABM)在教育場域的應用分析
第16週	學期課程總複習
第17週	期末專題報告
第18週	期末專題報告
syllabi.assessment:
	課堂討論參與15%
以學生在課堂中參與討論情形做為考核指標。
	出席15%
以學生出席率作為考核指標。
	報告(期中報告：資料視覺化報告) 30%
以學生為單位向校務部門主管呈現資料視覺化的結果，並說明重要發現。
	專題(期末專題報告) 40%
以小組為單位向校務部門主管呈交校務研究數據分析報告，並以口頭方式報告重要發現。
syllabi.materials:
1.	彭森明(2013)，高等教育校務研究的理念與應用，高等教育
2.	黃榮村、周懷樸、林世昌(2018)，臺灣校務研究理論與技術，高等教育
3.	Howard, R. D., McLaughlin, G. W., & Knight, W. E. (2012). The handbook of institutional research. John Wiley & Sons.
4.	Angrist, J. D., & Pischke, J. S. (2009). Mostly harmless econometrics: An empiricist's companion. Princeton university press.
5.	Wilensky, U., & Rand, W. (2015). An introduction to agent-based modeling: modeling natural, social, and engineered complex systems with NetLogo. Mit Press.
6.	Bird, S., Klein, E., & Loper, E. (2009). Natural language processing with Python: analyzing text with the natural language toolkit. O'Reilly Media, Inc.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期、或寒假(可跨學期)至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之校外研發機構的實務研究總累計時數不得低於320小時(於(跨)學期中、暑期、或寒假期間)，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究成果報告予指導教授並彙交所屬系所保存。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the regular semester term or the summer/winter break, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on-site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students finish the requirements, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates in accordance with the real performance on site. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents which will be deposited in the graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office, showing what they have actually learned and accomplished with this work/research experience.
